[ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: scan_chain|BIST|ATPG|boundary_scan|JTAG|combined|none — promote to reference product]

attributes.name: emulation_platform
attributes.description: Hardware emulation platform used for pre-silicon software bring-up and system-level verification (e.g., 'Cadence Palladium Z2', 'Synopsys ZeBu', 'Mentor Veloce'). Null if emulation is not in scope for this plan.

attributes.name: fault_coverage_target_pct
attributes.description: Target stuck-at and transition fault coverage percentage for ATPG-generated test patterns. Typically 99%+ for automotive/safety-critical designs per IATF 16949 and ISO 26262. Drives DFT insertion effort and scan chain architecture decisions.

attributes.name: fault_injection_campaign_planned
attributes.description: Indicates whether a structured fault injection campaign is planned as part of this verification plan to validate safety mechanisms per ISO 26262. True for ASIL-B and above designs. Drives resource allocation for fault simulation infrastructure.

attributes.name: fmeda_document_reference
attributes.business_glossary_term: Failure Mode Effects and Diagnostic Analysis (FMEDA) Document ID
attributes.description: Reference identifier of the linked FMEDA document in the PLM system. The FMEDA quantifies diagnostic coverage and safe failure fraction for ISO 26262 hardware metrics compliance. Null for non-safety designs.

tag_set.value: Failure Mode Effects and Diagnostic Analysis (FMEDA) Document ID

attributes.name: formal_verification_tool
attributes.description: EDA tool used for formal property checking and equivalence checking (e.g., 'Synopsys VC Formal', 'Cadence JasperGold', 'OneSpin 360'). Null if formal verification is not part of the plan methodology.

attributes.name: fpga_prototype_platform
attributes.description: FPGA prototyping board or platform used for early software validation and system integration testing (e.g., 'Xilinx VCU128', 'Intel Stratix 10 GX', 'Aldec HES-US-440'). Null if FPGA prototyping is not in scope.

attributes.name: functional_coverage_target_pct
attributes.description: Target functional coverage closure percentage required for verification sign-off (e.g., 99.50 for 99.5%). Defined in the verification plan and tracked against actual coverage results from simulation regression runs. A key tapeout readiness gate metric.

attributes.name: ip_reuse_count
attributes.description: Number of third-party or internal IP cores integrated into this design that require verification waivers or pre-verified IP sign-off. Impacts the scope of the verification plan and the testbench architecture for IP interface compliance.

attributes.name: iso26262_asil_decomposition
attributes.business_glossary_term: ISO 26262 Automotive Safety Integrity Level (ASIL) Decomposition Description
attributes.description: Description of the ASIL decomposition strategy applied to this design per ISO 26262 Part 9. Documents how a higher ASIL requirement is decomposed into two independent lower-ASIL sub-elements (e.g., 'ASIL D decomposed to ASIL B + ASIL B'). Mandatory for automotive safety-critical IC designs.

tag_set.value: ISO 26262 Automotive Safety Integrity Level (ASIL) Decomposition Description

attributes.name: last_updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp of the most recent modification to this design verification plan record. Used for change tracking, PLM synchronization, and incremental data pipeline processing in the Databricks Silver Layer.

attributes.name: pdk_version
attributes.description: Version of the foundry-provided PDK used in this design and verification environment. The PDK defines the design rules, device models, and standard cell libraries. Verification must be validated against the correct PDK version to ensure DFM compliance.

attributes.name: plan_end_date
attributes.description: Planned completion date for all verification activities and sign-off, aligned with the tapeout schedule. A key TTM (Time to Market) planning date. Slippage triggers NRE (Non-Recurring Engineering) cost impact analysis.

attributes.name: plan_name
attributes.description: Descriptive human-readable name for the verification plan, typically including the IC design project name and verification phase (e.g., 'SoC-X5 Full-Chip Functional Verification Plan v2.1'). Used in dashboards, reports, and PLM document management.

attributes.name: plan_number
attributes.description: Externally-known, human-readable identifier for the verification plan, typically assigned by the PLM system (e.g., Oracle Agile PLM or Siemens Teamcenter). Format: DVP-<PROJECT_CODE>-<YEAR>-<SEQ>. Used in cross-functional communications, tapeout checklists, and audit trails.

attributes.name: plan_start_date
attributes.description: Planned start date for verification activities as defined in the project schedule. Used for milestone tracking, resource planning, and TTM (Time to Market) analysis.

attributes.name: plan_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the verification plan document. Drives workflow approvals and tapeout gate readiness. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: draft|in_review|approved|active|on_hold|closed|cancelled — promote to reference product]

attributes.name: plan_version
attributes.description: Version identifier of the verification plan document following semantic versioning (e.g., '1.0', '2.3', '3.1.2'). Incremented upon each approved revision cycle in the PLM system. Critical for traceability to tapeout sign-off.

attributes.name: regression_run_frequency
attributes.description: Planned frequency at which the regression suite is executed. Continuous integration runs on every RTL commit; nightly runs are scheduled overnight; milestone-triggered runs occur at defined project gates; on-demand runs are manually initiated.

attributes.name: regression_suite_name
attributes.description: Name of the primary regression test suite defined in this verification plan (e.g., 'SoC_Full_Regression_v3', 'CPU_Smoke_Suite'). The regression suite defines the set of simulation tests run nightly or at milestone gates to track coverage progress.

attributes.name: safety_criticality_level
attributes.business_glossary_term: Automotive Safety Integrity Level (ASIL) / Safety Integrity Level (SIL) Classification
attributes.description: Functional safety classification of the IC design per ISO 26262 (automotive ASIL) or IEC 61508 (industrial SIL). Drives the rigor of fault injection campaigns, FMEDA linkage, and safety mechanism coverage targets within the verification plan. Non-safety designs are tagged 'non_safety'. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: ASIL_A|ASIL_B|ASIL_C|ASIL_D|SIL_1|SIL_2|SIL_3|non_safety — promote to reference product]

tag_set.value: Automotive Safety Integrity Level (ASIL) / Safety Integrity Level (SIL) Classification

attributes.name: safety_mechanism_coverage_target_pct
attributes.description: Target percentage of identified safety mechanisms that must be verified through simulation, formal analysis, or fault injection campaigns. Required for ISO 26262 hardware verification sign-off. Null for non-safety designs.

attributes.name: scan_chain_count
attributes.description: Number of scan chains defined in the DFT architecture for this design. Determines ATPG test time, test data volume, and ATE (Automatic Test Equipment) channel requirements. A key DFT planning parameter.

attributes.name: signoff_approved
attributes.description: Indicates whether all verification sign-off criteria have been met and formal approval has been granted to proceed to tapeout. True only after all coverage targets, regression pass rates, and safety requirements are satisfied.

attributes.name: signoff_criteria_description
attributes.description: Textual description of the complete set of criteria that must be satisfied before verification sign-off is granted and tapeout is authorized. Includes coverage closure thresholds, zero-open-critical-bug requirement, regression pass rate, and formal proof completion.

attributes.name: signoff_date
attributes.description: Actual date on which verification sign-off was formally approved. Null until sign-off is granted. Used for tapeout readiness confirmation and post-silicon correlation analysis.

attributes.name: simulation_tool
attributes.description: Primary EDA simulation tool assigned for RTL and gate-level simulation (e.g., 'Synopsys VCS', 'Cadence Xcelium', 'Mentor Questa'). Determines the simulation environment configuration, license requirements, and regression infrastructure.

attributes.name: tapeout_target_date
attributes.description: Target date for GDSII tapeout submission to the foundry. The verification plan must achieve all sign-off criteria before this date. Drives the verification schedule and milestone gate definitions.

attributes.name: target_process_node
attributes.description: Semiconductor fabrication process node for which this design is targeted (e.g., '5nm', '7nm', '28nm', '180nm'). Influences PDK selection, timing constraints, and DFM rule applicability within the verification plan.

attributes.name: testbench_architecture
attributes.description: Structural architecture of the simulation testbench. UVM_layered follows the standard UVM agent/scoreboard/coverage hierarchy; directed uses manually written test vectors; constrained_random uses SystemVerilog randomization; cocotb uses Python-based co-simulation; SystemC uses transaction-level modeling. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: UVM_layered|directed|constrained_random|hybrid|cocotb|SystemC — promote to reference product]

attributes.name: toggle_coverage_target_pct
attributes.description: Target toggle coverage percentage for all RTL signals, ensuring each net transitions both 0→1 and 1→0 during simulation. Used as a DFT readiness indicator and a structural verification completeness metric.

attributes.name: verification_methodology
attributes.description: Primary pre-silicon verification methodology employed for this plan. UVM (Universal Verification Methodology) is the industry-standard constrained-random simulation approach; formal uses mathematical property checking; emulation uses hardware accelerators; FPGA_prototyping uses field-programmable gate arrays for early software bring-up. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: UVM|formal|emulation|FPGA_prototyping|hybrid|mixed_signal — promote to reference product]

products.name: package_compatibility
products.description: Represents the compatibility relationship between an IC design project and a package type. Each record links one ic_design_project to one package_type and stores attributes that are specific to that pairing, such as required die pitch, thermal budget, and qualification status.. Existence Justification: Engineering maintains a Design‑Package Compatibility matrix that records which package types are qualified for each IC design project. Each matrix entry captures required die pitch, thermal budget, and qualification status, and both a design project can be linked to multiple package types and a package type can serve many design projects.

domains.name: process

products.name: recipe
products.description: Detailed equipment-level process recipe defining all controllable parameters for a specific unit process step on a specific tool class. Captures recipe name, version, tool class, chamber configuration, and all process parameter setpoints organized by process type: implant conditions (species, energy, dose, tilt, twist, beam current, anneal recipe), deposition conditions (method such as LPCVD/PECVD/ALD/PVD/EPI, target material, thickness, temperature, pressure, precursor flows, RF power, deposition rate, uniformity spec), etch conditions (type, chemistry, gas flows, pressure, RF source/bias power, etch rate, selectivity, CD bias, endpoint detection), CMP conditions (slurry, pad, platen pressure, carrier speed, table speed, endpoint detection, removal target, post-CMP clean, uniformity spec), and lithography conditions (scanner, wavelength, NA, sigma, illumination mode, resist type/thickness, exposure dose, focus offset, develop process, bake temperatures, OPC rule set reference). Includes recipe approval status, effective date range, qualification linkage, and full revision history. Sourced from Applied Materials SmartFactory MES and Camstar MES recipe management modules. SSOT for ALL equipment-level process parameters and conditions; no separate condition products exist — all process-type-specific parameters are attributes within this unified recipe entity.

products.name: lot_process_run
products.description: Transactional record of a wafer lot executing a specific process step on a specific piece of equipment. Captures lot ID reference, process step reference, equipment ID, operator ID, actual start and end timestamps, actual recipe used, chamber ID, lot disposition (pass/hold/scrap), and any in-line measurement results collected at that step. This is the core WIP tracking event for process engineering analysis. SSOT boundary: process domain owns the process-step-level execution record for engineering analysis; fabrication domain owns the lot lifecycle (lot creation, split, merge, hold, scrap, ship) and overall WIP status. products.name: spc_control_chart
products.description: Statistical Process Control (SPC) control chart definition and complete measurement history for a monitored process parameter at a specific process step. Chart definition captures chart type (Xbar-R, Xbar-S, EWMA, CUSUM, IMR), monitored parameter name, control limits (UCL, LCL, UWL, LWL), target value, sample size, sampling frequency, chart owner, and current chart status. Measurement detail (header+line pattern) captures all individual data points: measured value, measurement timestamp, lot reference, wafer number, site coordinates, measurement tool ID, chart rule violations triggered (Western Electric rules, Nelson rules), and resulting process action (none, warning, OCAP triggered). Implements SEMI E10 and JEDEC SPC guidelines. Sourced from KLA ICOS and in-line metrology tools. SSOT for all SPC monitoring definitions and measurement data in the process domain.

Captures Cp, Cpk, Pp, Ppk indices, mean, standard deviation, sample count, evaluation window start/end dates, specification limits (USL, LSL), target value, capability status (capable/marginal/incapable), and trend direction. products.name: opc_rule_set
products.description: Optical Proximity Correction (OPC) rule set and MEEF characterization record for a specific lithography layer and technology node. Captures OPC model version, target layer name, technology node, lithography wavelength (EUV/DUV), scanner NA, illumination mode, rule set file reference, process bias tables, assist feature rules, qualification status, and complete MEEF characterization (MEEF value per feature type, pitch, CD target, process window DOF/EL, sigma illumination, NA, wavelength, measurement methodology). MEEF parameters are integral attributes of the OPC rule set as they characterize mask-to-wafer CD transfer fidelity within the OPC model context. Managed in conjunction with Synopsys and Cadence EDA OPC flows. SSOT for all OPC, MEEF, and lithography proximity correction data used in mask data preparation and CD tolerance specification.

attributes.description: Risk level associated with deploying the qualified process to production: low (minimal risk), medium (moderate risk with mitigation), high (significant risk requiring close monitoring), critical (severe risk requiring executive approval).

attributes.name: sign_off_date
attributes.description: Date when the qualification results were formally signed off and approved.

attributes.name: sign_off_engineer_name
attributes.description: Name of the process engineer or technical authority who signed off on the qualification results.

attributes.name: start_date
attributes.description: Date when the qualification program officially started or is planned to start.

attributes.name: target_completion_date
attributes.description: Planned or target date for completion of the qualification program.

attributes.name: target_cpk
attributes.description: Target process capability index (Cpk) that must be achieved for qualification to pass. Typical semiconductor requirement is Cpk >= 1.33.

attributes.name: target_yield_percent
attributes.description: Target wafer yield percentage that must be achieved for qualification to pass.

attributes.name: wafer_count
attributes.description: Total number of wafers planned or executed for the qualification program.

products.name: change_notification
products.description: Process Change Notification (PCN) record documenting a planned or executed change to a qualified process flow, recipe, material, or equipment configuration that may affect product performance or reliability. Captures PCN number, change type (process, material, equipment, design), affected products, change description, risk assessment, customer notification requirements, implementation date, and approval status. Managed through Oracle Agile PLM and SAP QM change management workflows.
products.reference: JEDEC JESD46 PCN / SEMI PCN Standard

attributes.name: change_notification_id
attributes.description: Primary key for change_notification

attributes.name: change_process_flow_id
attributes.description: FK to process.process_flow.process_flow_id — Process change notifications document changes to qualified process flows. This FK enables impact analysis of changes on production flows.

attributes.name: fabrication_process_flow_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the primary process flow impacted by this change notification.

attributes.name: fabrication_technology_node_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the technology node impacted by this change, such as 7nm, 5nm, or 3nm process technology.

attributes.name: ic_catalog_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to product.ic_catalog. Business justification: Change notifications affect particular IC products; essential for the Product Change Impact Assessment.

attributes.name: primary_change_process_flow_id
attributes.business_glossary_term: Affected Process Flow Internal Id (Foreign Key)
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to process.process_process_flow. Business justification: Change notifications affect a specific process flow; an internal FK provides direct reference within the process domain.

tag_set.value: Affected Process Flow Internal Id (Foreign Key)

attributes.name: process_qualification_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to process.process_qualification. Business justification: Process changes often trigger re-qualification. This FK links the change notification to the associated qualification record.

attributes.name: process_step_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to process.process_step. Business justification: Process Change Notifications (PCNs) affect specific process steps. This FK links the PCN to the affected step, enabling step-level change impact analysis.

attributes.name: process_technology_node_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to process.process_technology_node. Business justification: PCNs are associated with specific technology nodes. This FK links the change notification to the affected technology node.

attributes.name: research_program_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to research.program. Business justification: Change notifications are routed to the owning research program to evaluate impact on program milestones and compliance.

attributes.name: actual_implementation_date
attributes.description: Actual date when the process change was implemented in production manufacturing.

attributes.name: affected_customer_list
attributes.description: List of customer names or identifiers who have products affected by this change and require notification per contractual agreements.

attributes.name: affected_equipment_list
attributes.description: List of manufacturing equipment tools or tool sets impacted by this process change, including tool IDs or model numbers.

attributes.name: affected_material_list
attributes.description: List of raw materials, chemicals, gases, or consumables that are being changed or affected by this process modification.

attributes.name: affected_product_list
attributes.description: Comma-separated list or description of product families, part numbers, or device types impacted by this process change.

attributes.name: approval_date
attributes.description: Date when the process change notification received final internal approval to proceed.

attributes.name: approval_status
attributes.description: Internal approval status from engineering, quality, and management stakeholders for proceeding with the process change.

attributes.name: approved_by
attributes.description: Name or identifier of the person or role who provided final approval for the process change notification.

attributes.name: attachments
attributes.description: References to supporting documentation such as technical specifications, test reports, FMEA analyses, customer communications, or qualification data associated with this PCN.

attributes.name: change_classification
attributes.description: Impact classification of the change: major (requires customer approval and qualification), minor (notification required but no requalification), or notification_only (informational, no customer action required).

attributes.name: change_description
attributes.description: Detailed description of the process change including what is being changed, why the change is necessary, and the technical details of the modification.

attributes.name: change_reason
attributes.description: Business or technical justification for the change, such as yield improvement, cost reduction, obsolescence mitigation, reliability enhancement, or regulatory compliance.

attributes.name: change_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the process change notification in the approval and implementation workflow. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: draft|pending_approval|approved|customer_notified|implemented|cancelled|rejected — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: change_title
attributes.description: Brief descriptive title summarizing the nature of the process change.

attributes.name: change_type
attributes.description: Category of change being notified: process (recipe or flow modification), material (raw material or chemical change), equipment (tool or configuration change), design (mask or layout change), facility (fab site or cleanroom change), or supplier (vendor or subcontractor change).

attributes.name: cost_impact
attributes.description: Assessment of the financial impact of the process change including implementation costs, ongoing cost savings or increases, and return on investment.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the process change notification record was first created in the system.

attributes.name: customer_approval_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether explicit customer approval is required before implementing the change, typically for major changes affecting form, fit, function, or reliability.

attributes.name: customer_notification_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether customer notification is required per contractual agreements, regulatory requirements, or change impact assessment.

attributes.name: cycle_time_impact_hours
attributes.description: Expected change in manufacturing cycle time resulting from the process change, measured in hours (positive for increase, negative for reduction).

attributes.name: environmental_impact
attributes.description: Description of any environmental, health, or safety impacts resulting from the process change, including changes to hazardous material usage or waste generation.

attributes.name: fab_site_code
attributes.description: Code identifying the fabrication facility or site where the process change will be implemented.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the process change notification record was last updated or modified.

attributes.name: last_time_buy_date
attributes.description: Final date for customers to place orders for products manufactured using the old process before the change is implemented.

attributes.name: last_time_ship_date
attributes.description: Final date for shipping products manufactured using the old process before transitioning to the new process.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Additional comments, observations, or context related to the process change notification.

attributes.name: notification_date
attributes.description: Date when affected customers were formally notified of the pending process change.

attributes.name: owner_engineer_name
attributes.description: Name of the process engineer or technical owner responsible for managing this change notification through implementation.

attributes.name: owner_organization
attributes.description: Department or organizational unit responsible for the process change, such as Process Engineering, Equipment Engineering, or Quality Assurance.

attributes.name: pcn_number
attributes.description: Business identifier for the process change notification, typically formatted as PCN-NNNNNN. Used for external communication and tracking.

attributes.name: planned_implementation_date
attributes.description: Target date for implementing the process change in production manufacturing.

attributes.name: qualification_completion_date
attributes.description: Date when all qualification and validation activities for the process change were successfully completed.

attributes.name: qualification_status
attributes.description: Status of the qualification and validation activities required to verify that the process change does not adversely affect product quality or reliability.

attributes.name: regulatory_impact
attributes.description: Assessment of whether the process change affects compliance with regulatory requirements such as RoHS, REACH, ITAR, EAR, or automotive quality standards (IATF 16949).

attributes.name: risk_assessment
attributes.description: Evaluation of potential risks associated with the change including impact on product performance, reliability, quality, and manufacturability. May reference Failure Mode and Effects Analysis (FMEA) results.

attributes.name: risk_level
attributes.description: Overall risk rating assigned to this change based on potential impact to product quality, reliability, and customer operations.

attributes.name: yield_impact_percent
attributes.description: Expected or measured change in manufacturing yield resulting from the process change, expressed as a percentage point change (positive for improvement, negative for degradation).

products.name: yield_loss_event
products.description: Transactional record of a yield loss event identified at a specific process step or inspection point for a wafer lot. Captures lot reference, process step, yield loss mode (parametric, systematic, random, electrical), defect density, affected die count, estimated yield impact, root cause category, corrective action reference, and resolution status. Primary input to yield optimization workflows and SPC out-of-control action plans (OCAPs).
products.reference: SEMI Yield Management / ITRS Yield Enhancement

attributes.name: yield_loss_event_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the yield loss event record. Primary key.

attributes.name: account_id
attributes.description: Reference to the customer for whom the affected wafer lot is being fabricated. Used for customer-specific yield reporting and quality metrics.

attributes.name: ar_invoice_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to invoice.ar_invoice. Business justification: Yield Loss Charge Invoice records the invoice that compensates the customer for a specific yield loss event.

attributes.name: capa_record_id
attributes.description: Reference to the corrective action or OCAP (Out of Control Action Plan) initiated in response to this yield loss event. Links to corrective action tracking system.

attributes.name: cost_center_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.cost_center. Business justification: Yield loss events are charged to the responsible cost center to quantify financial impact in loss‑analysis reports.

attributes.name: excursion_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to process.excursion. Business justification: Yield loss events are often associated with process excursions. This FK links the yield loss event to the triggering excursion for root cause traceability.

attributes.name: fab_tool_id
attributes.description: Reference to the fabrication equipment or tool associated with the process step where the yield loss occurred. Used for equipment-specific yield trending and FMEA.

attributes.name: fabrication_process_step_id
attributes.description: Reference to the specific process step at which the yield loss was identified. Links to process step master data.

attributes.name: fabrication_technology_node_id
attributes.description: Reference to the technology node (process generation) for the affected wafer lot. Used for node-specific yield trending and benchmarking.

attributes.name: fabrication_wafer_lot_id
attributes.description: Reference to the wafer lot in which the yield loss event was detected. Links to fabrication wafer lot master data.

attributes.name: inspection_point_id
attributes.description: Reference to the inspection or metrology point where the yield loss was detected. May be inline or offline inspection station.

attributes.name: order_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to order.order. Business justification: Needed for Customer Yield Impact report linking each yield loss event directly to the affected sales order for compensation calculations.

attributes.name: process_flow_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to process.process_flow. Business justification: Yield loss events occur within a specific process flow. This FK enables process flow-level yield loss reporting and optimization.

attributes.name: process_step_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to process.process_step. Business justification: Yield loss events are identified at specific process steps. This FK is critical for step-level yield loss analysis and root cause investigation.

attributes.name: recipe_id
attributes.description: Reference to the process recipe or run card that was active when the yield loss event occurred. Used for recipe-specific yield correlation and optimization.

attributes.name: research_project_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to research.project. Business justification: Yield loss events on research wafers are reported to the responsible research project for root‑cause analysis and budget impact.

attributes.name: sku_id
attributes.description: Reference to the IC design product or device family being fabricated on the affected wafer lot. Used for product-specific yield analysis and customer impact assessment.

attributes.name: spc_control_chart_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to process.spc_control_chart. Business justification: Yield loss events are often triggered by SPC rule violations. The spc_rule_violation field on yield_loss_event indicates this relationship. Linking to the SPC chart enables traceability.

attributes.name: affected_die_count
attributes.description: Number of individual die on the wafer affected by this yield loss event. Used to calculate yield impact and prioritize corrective actions.

attributes.name: assigned_to
attributes.description: Name or identifier of the engineer or team assigned to investigate and resolve the yield loss event. Used for workload management and escalation.

attributes.name: coolant_flow_rate_lpm
attributes.description: Coolant flow rate observed.

attributes.name: coolant_reclaim_rate_percent
attributes.description: Coolant reclaim percentage.

attributes.name: coolant_waste_volume_liters
attributes.description: Coolant waste volume generated.

attributes.name: cooling_duration_seconds
attributes.description: Duration of cooling observed.

attributes.name: cooling_energy_consumption_kwh
attributes.description: Energy consumed by cooling.

attributes.name: cooling_method
attributes.description: Cooling method applied.

attributes.name: cooling_optimization_enabled_flag
attributes.description: Whether cooling optimization was active.

attributes.name: cooling_optimization_mode
attributes.description: Cooling optimization option in effect.

attributes.name: cooling_process_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether a cooling process is associated.

attributes.name: cooling_ramp_rate_celsius_per_min
attributes.business_glossary_term: Cooling Ramp Rate Celsius Per Min
attributes.description: Measured cooling ramp-down rate.

tag_set.value: Cooling Ramp Rate Celsius Per Min

attributes.name: cpk_value
attributes.description: Process capability index (Cpk) calculated at the time of the yield loss event. Indicates how well the process is centered and controlled relative to specification limits. Values below 1.33 typically indicate process capability issues.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this yield loss event record was first created in the system. Format: yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX. Used for audit trail and data lineage.

attributes.name: defect_density_per_cm2
attributes.description: Measured defect density for this yield loss event, expressed as defects per square centimeter of wafer area. Used for SPC trending and yield modeling.

attributes.name: defect_size_nm
attributes.description: Measured or estimated size of the defect in nanometers. Critical for determining defect criticality and kill ratio at advanced technology nodes.

attributes.name: defect_type
attributes.description: Specific defect type or signature identified during inspection or test. Examples include scratch, particle, void, short, open, bridging, residue, etc. May reference defect classification taxonomy.

attributes.name: detection_method
attributes.description: Method or technique used to detect the yield loss event. Indicates whether detected via inline inspection, offline inspection, electrical test, parametric test, visual inspection, or metrology measurement.

attributes.name: disposition_action
attributes.description: Disposition decision for the affected wafer lot following yield loss event investigation. Continue indicates lot proceeds to next step; rework indicates reprocessing required; scrap indicates lot rejected; quarantine indicates lot held pending further analysis; use as is indicates lot accepted with deviation; return to vendor indicates supplier material issue.

attributes.name: estimated_yield_impact_percent
attributes.description: Estimated percentage point impact on wafer yield attributable to this event. Calculated from affected die count and total die per wafer. Used for yield loss Pareto analysis.

attributes.name: event_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the yield loss event was detected or recorded. Format: yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX.

attributes.name: fab_site_code
attributes.description: Code identifying the fabrication facility where the yield loss event occurred. Used for multi-site yield benchmarking and site-specific trending.

attributes.name: investigation_start_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when root cause investigation of the yield loss event was initiated. Format: yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this yield loss event record was last updated. Format: yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX. Used for audit trail and change tracking.

attributes.name: layer_name
attributes.description: Name of the process layer or mask level at which the yield loss event occurred. Examples include M1, M2, POLY, CONTACT, VIA1, etc. Aligns with GDS layer naming convention.

attributes.name: lot_hold_applied
attributes.description: Indicates whether a lot hold was placed on the affected wafer lot as a result of this yield loss event. True if hold applied; false if no hold applied.

attributes.name: measured_cooling_temperature_celsius
attributes.description: Measured temperature during/after cooling.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-form text field for additional comments, observations, or context related to the yield loss event. May include investigation findings, lessons learned, or special handling instructions.

attributes.name: reported_by
attributes.description: Name or identifier of the engineer, operator, or automated system that reported or logged the yield loss event. Used for accountability and follow-up.

attributes.name: resolution_status
attributes.description: Current status of the yield loss event resolution workflow. Open indicates newly detected; under investigation indicates active RCA; root cause identified indicates RCA complete; corrective action implemented indicates fix deployed; closed indicates event resolved; deferred indicates event accepted or postponed.

attributes.name: resolution_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the yield loss event was resolved and closed. Format: yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX. Used to calculate mean time to resolution (MTTR) for yield events.

attributes.name: root_cause_category
attributes.description: High-level classification of the root cause of the yield loss event. Equipment indicates tool-related issues; material indicates incoming material defects; process indicates recipe or parameter issues; human indicates operator error; environmental indicates cleanroom or facility issues; design indicates layout or design rule issues.

attributes.name: root_cause_description
attributes.description: Detailed narrative description of the identified or suspected root cause of the yield loss event. Populated during root cause analysis and investigation.

attributes.name: severity_level
attributes.description: Business severity classification of the yield loss event based on yield impact, affected volume, and customer impact. Critical indicates immediate action required; major indicates significant yield impact; minor indicates localized impact; negligible indicates minimal business impact.

attributes.name: spc_rule_violation
attributes.description: Identification of the SPC control chart rule that was violated and triggered this yield loss event. Examples include Western Electric rules, Nelson rules, or custom SPC rules. Used to link yield events to process control violations.

attributes.name: wafer_position_x_mm
attributes.description: X-coordinate position on the wafer where the yield loss event was detected, in millimeters from wafer center. Used for spatial yield analysis and wafer mapping.

attributes.name: wafer_position_y_mm
attributes.description: Y-coordinate position on the wafer where the yield loss event was detected, in millimeters from wafer center. Used for spatial yield analysis and wafer mapping.

attributes.name: waste_elimination_strategy
attributes.description: Waste elimination strategy applied.

attributes.name: waste_heat_recovery_flag
attributes.description: Whether waste heat was recovered.

attributes.name: yield_loss_mode
attributes.description: Classification of the yield loss mechanism. Parametric indicates out-of-spec electrical parameters; systematic indicates repeatable defect patterns; random indicates sporadic defects; electrical indicates functional failures; particle indicates contamination; pattern indicates lithography or etch issues; edge indicates wafer edge exclusion. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: parametric|systematic|random|electrical|particle|pattern|edge — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

products.name: defect_inspection_result
products.description: Wafer-level defect inspection result record from in-line inspection tools (KLA brightfield/darkfield scanners, e-beam inspection) captured at process engineering inspection steps for process monitoring and excursion detection. Captures wafer lot reference, inspection step, tool ID, inspection recipe, total defect count, defect density (defects/cm²), defect map file reference, defect classification breakdown by type and size, nuisance filter applied, and disposition. SSOT boundary: process domain owns in-line defect inspection results used for process monitoring, SPC, and excursion detection during manufacturing; quality domain owns outgoing quality inspection, reliability defect analysis, and customer-reported defect records. Sourced from KLA 29xx/39xx series and Applied Materials SEMVision.
products.reference: KLA ICOS / SEMI M1 Defect Inspection

attributes.name: defect_inspection_result_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the defect inspection result record. Primary key.

attributes.name: employee_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the operator or automated system that initiated the inspection.

attributes.name: excursion_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to process.excursion. Business justification: Defect inspection results that detect excursions should link to the excursion record. The excursion_detected flag on defect_inspection_result indicates this relationship.

attributes.name: fab_tool_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the inspection equipment used (e.g., KLA 29xx/39xx series, Applied Materials SEMVision). Tool asset identifier from equipment master.

attributes.name: fabrication_technology_node_id
attributes.description: Reference to the technology node (process generation) for which this inspection was performed, e.g., 7nm, 5nm, 3nm.

attributes.name: fabrication_wafer_lot_id
attributes.description: Reference to the wafer lot that was inspected. Links to the fabrication wafer lot being monitored.

attributes.name: ic_catalog_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to product.ic_catalog. Business justification: Defect inspection results are analyzed per IC product for the Defect Analysis per Product report.

attributes.name: inspection_point_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to process.inspection_point. Business justification: Defect inspection results are collected at specific inspection points. This FK links the result to the inspection point definition, enabling inspection point-level defect analysis.

attributes.name: inspection_recipe_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the inspection recipe or program used to configure the tool for this inspection run. Defines sensitivity, scan area, and detection parameters.

attributes.name: lot_process_run_id
attributes.description: FK to process.lot_process_run.lot_process_run_id — Defect inspection results are captured during or after a specific lot process run at an inspection step. This FK enables defect-to-process correlation.

attributes.name: process_flow_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to process.process_flow. Business justification: Defect inspection results are collected within a specific process flow context. This FK enables process flow-level defect density tracking.

attributes.name: process_step_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to process.process_process_step. Business justification: Defect inspection results are tied to a specific process step; adding internal FK enables step‑level analysis.

attributes.name: sampling_plan_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to process.sampling_plan. Business justification: Defect inspections are conducted according to a sampling plan. This FK links the inspection result to the governing sampling plan.

attributes.name: wafer_id
attributes.description: Reference to the specific wafer within the lot that was inspected.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this defect inspection result record was first created in the system.

attributes.name: crystal_defect_count
attributes.description: Number of defects classified as crystal originated particles (COPs) or intrinsic silicon defects.

attributes.name: defect_density_per_cm2
attributes.description: Calculated defect density expressed as defects per square centimeter of inspected wafer area. Key metric for process monitoring and Statistical Process Control (SPC).

attributes.name: defect_map_file_format
attributes.description: Format of the defect map file: KLARF (KLA Results File), CSV, XML, or proprietary vendor format.

attributes.name: defect_map_file_path
attributes.description: File system path or URI to the defect map file (typically KLARF or proprietary format) containing spatial coordinates and attributes of all detected defects.

attributes.name: defect_size_bin_large_count
attributes.description: Number of defects in the large size bin (typically > 0.5 µm or tool-specific threshold).

attributes.name: defect_size_bin_medium_count
attributes.description: Number of defects in the medium size bin (typically 0.1-0.5 µm or tool-specific threshold).

attributes.name: defect_size_bin_small_count
attributes.description: Number of defects in the small size bin (typically < 0.1 µm or tool-specific threshold).

attributes.name: disposition
attributes.description: Disposition decision based on inspection results: pass (within spec), fail (exceeds limits), review (requires engineering review), hold (lot placed on hold), or rework (requires reprocessing).

attributes.name: excursion_detected
attributes.description: Indicates whether a process excursion was detected based on defect density or count exceeding Statistical Process Control (SPC) limits.

attributes.name: inspected_area_cm2
attributes.description: Total wafer surface area inspected, measured in square centimeters. Used to calculate defect density.

attributes.name: inspection_at_step
attributes.description: FK to process.process_process_step.process_process_step_id — Defect inspections occur at specific process steps in the flow. Step reference provides manufacturing context for defect analysis.

attributes.name: inspection_mode
attributes.description: Inspection coverage mode: full wafer scan, die sampling, edge exclusion, or hot spot targeted inspection.

attributes.name: inspection_status
attributes.description: Current status of the inspection run: completed (inspection finished successfully), in_progress (inspection running), failed (tool error), or aborted (inspection cancelled).

attributes.name: inspection_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the defect inspection was performed. Primary business event timestamp for this inspection result.

attributes.name: inspection_type
attributes.description: Type of inspection technology used: brightfield scanner, darkfield scanner, e-beam inspection, optical inspection, or macro inspection.

attributes.name: killer_defect_count
attributes.description: Number of defects classified as killer defects (defects large enough or critical enough to cause die failure).

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this defect inspection result record was last modified or updated.

attributes.name: layer_name
attributes.description: Name of the process layer being inspected (e.g., Metal1, Poly, Contact, Via2). Identifies the fabrication layer in the stack.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text notes or comments about the inspection results, anomalies, or follow-up actions required.

attributes.name: nuisance_defect_count
attributes.description: Number of defects classified as nuisance (false positives or non-yield-impacting detections filtered by nuisance filter).

attributes.name: nuisance_filter_applied
attributes.description: Indicates whether a nuisance filter was applied to remove false positives or non-critical defects from the reported count.

attributes.name: nuisance_filter_version
attributes.description: Version identifier of the nuisance filter algorithm or rule set applied during this inspection.

attributes.name: particle_defect_count
attributes.description: Number of defects classified as particles (foreign material on wafer surface).

attributes.name: pattern_defect_count
attributes.description: Number of defects classified as pattern defects (lithography or etch anomalies in the circuit pattern).

attributes.name: residue_defect_count
attributes.description: Number of defects classified as residue (chemical or material residue remaining after processing).

attributes.name: review_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether engineering review is required based on defect count, type, or pattern analysis.

attributes.name: review_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the engineering review was completed.

attributes.name: reviewed_by

attributes.name: scratch_defect_count

attributes.name: spc_control_limit_lower

attributes.description: Lower control limit for defect density used in SPC monitoring.

attributes.name: spc_control_limit_upper

attributes.description: Upper control limit for defect density used in SPC monitoring. Excursions above this limit trigger alerts.

attributes.name: total_defect_count

attributes.name: process_flow_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to process.process_flow. Business justification: Metrology measurements are taken within a specific process flow context. This FK enables process flow-level metrology reporting.

attributes.name: process_step_id

attributes.name: cooling_optimization_enabled_flag
attributes.description: Whether cooling optimization is enabled for this step/recipe.

attributes.name: cooling_optimization_mode
attributes.description: Cooling optimization option selected (e.g., energy_min, throughput_max, balanced).

attributes.name: cooling_process_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this step/recipe includes a cooling process stage.

attributes.name: cooling_ramp_rate_celsius_per_min
attributes.business_glossary_term: Cooling Ramp Rate Celsius Per Min
attributes.description: Controlled cooling ramp-down rate.

tag_set.value: Cooling Ramp Rate Celsius Per Min

attributes.name: cooling_target_temperature_celsius
attributes.description: Target wafer/chamber temperature after cooling.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this etch condition record was first created in the system. Format: yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX.

attributes.name: critical_dimension_bias_nm
attributes.description: Expected change in critical dimension (CD) due to the etch process in nanometers. Positive value indicates CD growth, negative indicates CD shrinkage. Used for Optical Proximity Correction (OPC) and Design for Manufacturability (DFM).

attributes.name: effective_end_date
attributes.description: Date when this etch condition is retired or superseded. Null if still active. Format: yyyy-MM-dd.

attributes.name: effective_start_date
attributes.description: Date when this etch condition becomes effective and available for production use. Format: yyyy-MM-dd.

attributes.name: endpoint_detection_method
attributes.description: Method used to detect the completion of the etch process. Options include time-based, Optical Emission Spectroscopy (OES), laser interferometry, mass spectrometry, or none for over-etch strategies.

attributes.name: etch_method
attributes.description: Specific etch method or technology used. For dry etch: Reactive Ion Etch (RIE), Inductively Coupled Plasma (ICP), Capacitively Coupled Plasma (CCP). For wet etch: immersion or spray.

attributes.name: etch_rate_angstrom_per_minute
attributes.description: Target etch rate for the primary material in angstroms per minute. Key process parameter for throughput and uniformity control.

attributes.name: etch_time_seconds
attributes.description: Duration of the etch process in seconds. May be time-based or endpoint-detection-based depending on the process control strategy.

attributes.name: etch_type
attributes.description: Classification of the etch process as either dry etch (plasma-based: RIE, ICP, CCP) or wet etch (chemical immersion).

attributes.name: etchant_chemistry
attributes.description: The chemical composition of the etchant used. For dry etch: gas mixture (e.g., CF4/O2, SF6/O2, Cl2/BCl3). For wet etch: liquid chemistry (e.g., HF, BOE, H3PO4).

attributes.name: fab_site_code
attributes.description: Code identifying the fabrication facility where this etch condition is qualified and used. Supports multi-site manufacturing operations.

attributes.name: is_baseline_condition
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether this is the baseline or reference etch condition for the process step. True if this is the standard condition, False otherwise.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this etch condition record was last updated or modified. Format: yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for additional notes, comments, or special instructions related to the etch condition. Used for operational guidance and knowledge capture.

attributes.name: over_etch_percent
attributes.description: Percentage of additional etch time beyond endpoint detection to ensure complete material removal. Expressed as a percentage of the main etch time.

attributes.name: owner_organization
attributes.description: Organizational unit or department responsible for this etch condition (e.g., FEOL Process Engineering, BEOL Integration).

attributes.name: primary_gas_flow_sccm
attributes.description: Flow rate of the primary etch gas in standard cubic centimeters per minute (SCCM). Applicable to dry etch processes.

attributes.name: process_category
attributes.description: Classification of the etch step within the fabrication flow: Front End of Line (FEOL) for gate patterning, Middle of Line (MOL) for contact/via etch, or Back End of Line (BEOL) for metal etch.

attributes.name: profile_angle_degrees
attributes.description: Target sidewall angle of the etched feature in degrees from vertical. 90 degrees indicates perfectly vertical (anisotropic) etch. Critical for device performance and yield.

attributes.name: qualification_date
attributes.description: Date when the etch condition was formally qualified and approved for production use. Format: yyyy-MM-dd.

attributes.name: qualification_status
attributes.description: Current qualification and approval status of the etch condition. Indicates whether the condition is ready for production use or still under development.

attributes.name: recipe_version
attributes.description: Version identifier for the etch recipe. Used for change control and traceability when recipe parameters are updated.

attributes.name: rf_bias_power_watts
attributes.description: RF power applied to the substrate electrode (bias power) in watts. Controls ion energy and directionality for anisotropic etching.

attributes.name: rf_source_power_watts
attributes.description: RF power applied to the plasma source coil or electrode in watts. Controls plasma density and etch rate in ICP and CCP systems.

attributes.name: secondary_gas_flow_sccm
attributes.description: Flow rate of the secondary or carrier gas in standard cubic centimeters per minute (SCCM). Used for process tuning and selectivity control.

attributes.name: selectivity_ratio
attributes.description: Ratio of etch rate of the target material to the etch rate of the underlying or masking material. Critical for process control and preventing over-etch damage.

attributes.name: substrate_temperature_celsius
attributes.description: Temperature of the wafer substrate during the etch process in degrees Celsius. Affects etch rate, selectivity, and profile control.

attributes.name: target_cd_nm
attributes.description: Target critical dimension after etch in nanometers. Defines the intended feature size for the etched structure.

attributes.name: target_layer
attributes.description: The specific layer or material being etched (e.g., polysilicon, oxide, nitride, metal1, metal2, via1, contact). Identifies the layer in the device stack.

attributes.name: target_material
attributes.description: The material composition of the target layer being etched (e.g., silicon, silicon dioxide, silicon nitride, tungsten, copper, aluminum, titanium nitride).

attributes.name: tool_class
attributes.description: Classification or family of etch equipment for which this condition is designed (e.g., Applied Materials Centura, Lam Research Kiyo, Tokyo Electron Tactras).

attributes.name: uniformity_target_percent
attributes.description: Target uniformity of etch depth or CD across the wafer, expressed as a percentage (1-sigma or 3-sigma). Lower values indicate better uniformity.

attributes.name: waste_elimination_strategy
attributes.description: Waste elimination strategy (e.g., heat_recovery, coolant_reclaim, lean_idle_shutdown).

attributes.name: waste_heat_recovery_flag
attributes.description: Whether waste heat is recovered/reused.

products.name: cmp_condition
products.description: Chemical Mechanical Planarization (CMP) process condition master record defining slurry chemistry, pad type, platen pressure, carrier speed, table speed, endpoint detection method, target removal amount, post-CMP clean recipe, and within-wafer uniformity spec. Covers STI CMP, ILD CMP, W-plug CMP, Cu damascene CMP, and barrier CMP steps across FEOL, MOL, and BEOL.

attributes.name: cmp_condition_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the CMP process condition master record. Primary key.

attributes.name: fabrication_technology_node_id
attributes.description: Reference to the technology node (process geometry) for which this CMP condition is qualified, such as 7nm, 5nm, 3nm FinFET or GAA nodes.

attributes.name: ic_catalog_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to product.ic_catalog. Business justification: CMP conditions are maintained per IC product for the CMP Process Specification and quality control.

attributes.name: process_flow_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to process.process_flow. Business justification: CMP conditions are defined within a specific process flow context. This FK links the condition to the process flow it supports.

attributes.name: process_step_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to process.process_step. Business justification: CMP conditions apply to specific CMP process steps. This FK links the condition to the step where it is used, enabling step-level condition management.

attributes.name: recipe_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to process.recipe. Business justification: CMP conditions are implemented via equipment recipes. This FK links the CMP condition to the specific recipe that implements it.

attributes.name: substance_inventory_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to compliance.substance_inventory. Business justification: CMP slurry chemicals are regulated; linking condition to substance inventory supports substance reporting and safety.

attributes.name: carrier_speed_rpm
attributes.description: Rotational speed of the wafer carrier head during CMP processing, measured in revolutions per minute. Affects relative velocity and material removal uniformity.

attributes.name: cmp_step_type
attributes.description: Classification of the CMP process step based on the material and layer being planarized. STI (Shallow Trench Isolation) for FEOL, ILD (Inter-Layer Dielectric) for MOL/BEOL, W-plug for tungsten contact fill, Cu damascene for copper interconnect, barrier for barrier metal removal. attributes.name: condition_code
attributes.description: Unique alphanumeric code assigned to this CMP condition for tracking and reference in Manufacturing Execution System (MES) and process control systems.

attributes.name: condition_name
attributes.description: Human-readable name or identifier for this CMP process condition, typically including the CMP step type and target layer.

attributes.name: conditioner_type
attributes.description: Type of diamond conditioning disk or brush used to maintain pad surface texture and porosity during CMP processing. Conditioning prevents pad glazing and maintains consistent removal rates.

attributes.name: conditioning_frequency
attributes.description: Schedule for pad conditioning operations, such as ex-situ (between wafers), in-situ (during polishing), or time-based intervals. Maintains pad performance and removal rate stability.

attributes.name: coolant_flow_rate_lpm
attributes.description: Coolant flow rate in liters per minute.

attributes.name: coolant_recirculation_flag
attributes.description: Whether coolant is recirculated to reduce waste.

attributes.name: coolant_reclaim_rate_percent
attributes.description: Percentage of coolant reclaimed/recycled.

attributes.name: coolant_waste_volume_liters
attributes.description: Volume of coolant waste generated.

attributes.name: cooling_duration_seconds
attributes.description: Duration of the cooling stage.

attributes.name: cooling_energy_consumption_kwh
attributes.description: Energy consumed by the cooling process.

attributes.name: cooling_medium
attributes.description: Cooling medium used (e.g., DI water, helium backside, chilled nitrogen).

attributes.name: cooling_method
attributes.description: Cooling method applied (e.g., convective, conductive, cryogenic, water-cooled chuck).

attributes.description: Whether cooling optimization is enabled for this step/recipe.

attributes.description: Cooling optimization option selected (e.g., energy_min, throughput_max, balanced).

attributes.name: cooling_target_temperature_celsius
attributes.description: Target wafer/chamber temperature after cooling.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this CMP condition record was first created in the system.

attributes.name: defect_density_spec_per_wafer
attributes.description: Maximum allowable number of CMP-induced defects per wafer, including scratches, particles, residue, and surface damage. Measured by post-CMP inspection tools.

attributes.name: cmp_condition_description
attributes.description: Detailed textual description of this CMP process condition, including special considerations, application scope, and any unique characteristics or constraints.

attributes.name: dishing_spec_angstrom
attributes.description: Maximum allowable depression or dishing in metal features (copper lines, tungsten plugs) after CMP, measured in angstroms. Excessive dishing degrades electrical performance and reliability.

attributes.name: effective_end_date
attributes.description: Date when this CMP condition version was superseded or retired from production use. Null for currently active conditions.

attributes.name: effective_start_date
attributes.description: Date when this CMP condition version became active and available for production use.

attributes.name: endpoint_detection_method
attributes.description: Technology used to determine when the target material removal amount has been achieved. Optical methods detect reflectivity changes, motor current monitors torque variations, time-based uses fixed duration, acoustic detects friction changes, eddy current senses metal thickness.

attributes.name: equipment_class
attributes.description: Classification of CMP tool type qualified for this condition, such as rotary single-wafer, linear, or orbital polisher. Different tool architectures may require condition adjustments.

attributes.name: erosion_spec_angstrom
attributes.description: Maximum allowable thinning of dielectric material in dense pattern areas relative to isolated areas, measured in angstroms. Erosion affects metal line height uniformity and interconnect reliability.

attributes.name: fab_site_code
attributes.description: Identifier of the fabrication facility where this CMP condition is qualified and used. Enables multi-site process tracking and technology transfer.

attributes.name: is_baseline_condition
attributes.description: Indicates whether this is the baseline or reference CMP condition for this step type and technology node. Baseline conditions serve as the standard for process capability and yield comparisons.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this CMP condition record was most recently updated or modified.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Additional notes, comments, or observations related to this CMP condition, including troubleshooting guidance, known issues, or optimization opportunities.

attributes.name: owner_organization
attributes.description: Engineering organization or department responsible for maintaining and updating this CMP process condition.

attributes.name: pad_product_name
attributes.description: Commercial product name or part number of the CMP polishing pad as designated by the vendor.

attributes.name: pad_type
attributes.description: Classification and material composition of the CMP polishing pad, including hardness, porosity, groove pattern, and surface texture characteristics that affect removal rate and uniformity.

attributes.name: pad_vendor
attributes.description: Manufacturer or supplier of the CMP polishing pad used in this process condition.

attributes.name: platen_pressure_psi
attributes.description: Downforce pressure applied by the wafer carrier to the polishing pad surface, measured in pounds per square inch. Critical parameter controlling removal rate and within-wafer uniformity.

attributes.name: polish_time_seconds
attributes.description: Target duration of the CMP polishing step in seconds, from wafer contact with pad to endpoint detection or time-based completion.

attributes.name: post_cmp_clean_recipe
attributes.description: Cleaning process recipe applied immediately after CMP to remove slurry residue, particles, and contaminants from the wafer surface. Typically includes brush scrubbing, chemical rinse, and DI water rinse steps.

attributes.name: process_layer
attributes.description: Manufacturing layer classification indicating whether this CMP step occurs in Front End of Line (FEOL), Middle of Line (MOL), or Back End of Line (BEOL) processing.

attributes.name: qualification_date
attributes.description: Date when this CMP condition successfully completed qualification testing and was approved for production use.

attributes.name: qualification_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of this CMP condition in the process qualification workflow. Draft conditions are under development, under qualification are being validated, qualified have passed testing, production approved are released for volume manufacturing, suspended are temporarily disabled, obsolete are retired.

attributes.name: qualified_by_engineer_name
attributes.description: Name of the process engineer responsible for qualifying and approving this CMP condition for production use.

attributes.name: removal_rate_angstrom_per_min
attributes.description: Expected rate of material removal during CMP processing, measured in angstroms per minute. Determined by slurry chemistry, pad type, pressure, and speed parameters.

attributes.name: selectivity_ratio
attributes.description: Ratio of removal rates between the target material and underlying stop layer or adjacent materials. High selectivity ensures controlled polishing without excessive removal of barrier or dielectric layers.

attributes.name: slurry_chemistry_type
attributes.description: Chemical composition classification of the CMP slurry used in this condition, including abrasive type (silica, ceria, alumina), pH level, and chemical additives for selectivity and removal rate control.

attributes.name: slurry_flow_rate_ml_per_min
attributes.description: Target volumetric flow rate of CMP slurry delivered to the polishing pad surface during processing, measured in milliliters per minute.

attributes.name: slurry_product_name
attributes.description: Commercial product name or part number of the CMP slurry as designated by the vendor.

attributes.name: slurry_vendor
attributes.description: Manufacturer or supplier of the CMP slurry chemical used in this process condition.

attributes.name: table_speed_rpm
attributes.description: Rotational speed of the CMP platen table holding the polishing pad, measured in revolutions per minute. Combined with carrier speed determines relative motion and removal characteristics.

attributes.name: target_layer_name
attributes.description: Specific layer or film stack being planarized by this CMP process, such as oxide, nitride, metal layer designation (M1, M2, etc.), or via layer.

attributes.name: target_removal_amount_angstrom
attributes.description: Specified thickness of material to be removed during the CMP process, measured in angstroms. Critical for achieving target post-CMP film thickness and planarity.

attributes.name: version_number
attributes.description: Version identifier for this CMP condition record, incremented when process parameters are modified. Enables change tracking and process history analysis.

attributes.name: wafer_to_wafer_uniformity_spec_percent
attributes.description: Maximum allowable variation in average material removal between wafers processed under this condition, expressed as a percentage. Ensures consistent lot-level processing.

attributes.name: waste_elimination_strategy
attributes.description: Waste elimination strategy (e.g., heat_recovery, coolant_reclaim, lean_idle_shutdown).

attributes.name: waste_heat_recovery_flag
attributes.description: Whether waste heat is recovered/reused.

attributes.name: within_wafer_uniformity_spec_percent
attributes.description: Maximum allowable variation in material removal across the wafer surface, expressed as a percentage. Calculated as (max - min) / (2 * mean) * 100. Critical for device performance uniformity.

products.name: litho_condition
products.description: Photolithography process condition master record for a specific layer and technology node. Captures scanner model, wavelength (EUV 13.5nm / DUV 193nm / 248nm), NA, sigma (inner/outer), illumination mode (dipole, quadrupole, freeform), resist type, resist thickness, exposure dose, focus offset, develop process, bake temperatures, and associated OPC rule set reference. Critical for CD control and overlay performance.

products.name: ocap_action
products.description: Out-of-Control Action Plan (OCAP) action record triggered when an SPC rule violation or process excursion is detected. Captures the triggering SPC event reference, OCAP procedure reference, action type (hold lot, notify engineer, adjust recipe, escalate), assigned engineer, action timestamp, resolution description, lot disposition, and root cause classification. Implements the corrective response workflow for process excursions per IATF 16949 and SEMI SPC guidelines.
products.reference: SEMI SPC OCAP / IATF 16949 Corrective Action

attributes.name: primary_ocap_employee_id

attributes.name: primary_spc_control_chart_id

attributes.name: process_step_id

attributes.description: Date and time when the OCAP action was formally initiated in response to the detected excursion.

attributes.name: action_status

attributes.name: action_type

attributes.name: affected_wafer_count

attributes.name: assigned_organization

attributes.name: closure_notes

attributes.name: containment_action_flag

attributes.name: corrective_action_description

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: System timestamp when the OCAP action record was first created in the manufacturing execution system.

attributes.name: customer_notification_date
attributes.description: Date when the customer was notified about the process excursion and its potential impact on product quality.

attributes.name: customer_notification_required_flag

attributes.name: detection_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the SPC rule violation or process excursion was detected by the control chart monitoring system.

attributes.name: escalation_level
attributes.description: Level of management escalation required for the OCAP action based on severity and business impact.

attributes.name: escalation_required_flag
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether the OCAP action required escalation to senior engineering or management due to severity or complexity.

attributes.name: excursion_severity
attributes.description: Severity classification of the process excursion based on the magnitude of deviation from control limits and potential impact on product quality.

attributes.name: fab_site_code
attributes.description: Code identifying the fabrication facility where the process excursion occurred and the OCAP action was executed.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: System timestamp when the OCAP action record was last updated or modified.

attributes.name: lot_disposition
attributes.description: Final disposition decision for the affected wafer lot after OCAP action completion (e.g., released to next step, held for further investigation, scrapped).

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Additional notes, comments, or observations related to the OCAP action that provide context for future reference and continuous improvement.

attributes.name: ocap_procedure_reference
attributes.description: Reference number or identifier of the documented OCAP procedure that defines the corrective response workflow for this type of excursion.

attributes.name: preventive_action_description
attributes.description: Detailed description of preventive actions implemented to reduce the likelihood of similar excursions occurring in the future.

attributes.name: priority_level
attributes.description: Priority level assigned to the OCAP action based on the severity of the process excursion and its potential impact on yield and quality.

attributes.name: resolution_time_minutes
attributes.description: Total elapsed time in minutes from excursion detection to OCAP action completion. Key metric for evaluating effectiveness of corrective response.

attributes.name: response_time_minutes
attributes.description: Elapsed time in minutes from excursion detection to OCAP action initiation. Key metric for evaluating responsiveness of the quality control system.

attributes.name: root_cause_classification
attributes.description: High-level classification of the root cause identified during OCAP investigation (e.g., equipment drift, recipe deviation, material variation). attributes.name: spc_rule_violated

attributes.name: verification_method
attributes.description: Method used to verify the effectiveness of the corrective action (e.g., SPC monitoring, metrology inspection, yield analysis).

attributes.name: verification_result

attributes.name: verification_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the effectiveness of the corrective action was verified.

products.name: process_technology_node

Serves as the top-level classification anchor for process flows, OPC rule sets, and process capability records. References SSOT: fabrication.fabrication_technology_node

attributes.name: product_process_node_id

attributes.name: technology_control_plan_id

attributes.name: application_scope

attributes.name: baseline_yield_target_percent

attributes.name: euv_layer_count

attributes.name: fab_site_code

attributes.name: feol_layer_count

attributes.description: Number of process layers in the Front End of Line, covering transistor formation steps.

attributes.name: gate_pitch_nm
attributes.description: Gate pitch in nanometers, representing the distance between adjacent transistor gates in the Front End of Line (FEOL). Key dimension for transistor density.

attributes.name: introduction_year
attributes.description: Calendar year when this technology node was first introduced or qualified for production.

attributes.name: is_baseline_node
attributes.description: Indicates whether this is the baseline or reference technology node for a given generation. Used for comparison and benchmarking purposes.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this technology node record was last modified or updated.

attributes.name: lithography_type

attributes.name: metal_layer_count
attributes.description: Total number of metal interconnect layers in the Back End of Line (BEOL) stack for this technology node.

attributes.name: minimum_metal_pitch_nm
attributes.description: Minimum metal interconnect pitch in nanometers, representing the smallest distance between adjacent metal lines in the Back End of Line (BEOL).

attributes.name: node_code
attributes.description: Standardized alphanumeric code for the technology node used across systems and documentation.

attributes.name: node_generation
attributes.description: Generation classification of the technology node (e.g., Gen 1, Gen 2, Gen 3, Advanced Node, Mature Node, Legacy Node).

attributes.name: node_name
attributes.description: Human-readable name of the technology node (e.g., 5nm, 3nm, 7nm, 28nm, 65nm, 90nm). This is the primary business identifier for the process generation.

attributes.name: notes

attributes.name: owner_engineer_name
attributes.description: Name of the process engineer or engineering manager responsible for this technology node definition and maintenance.

attributes.name: owner_organization
attributes.description: Organization or department responsible for managing and maintaining this technology node (e.g., Process Engineering, Advanced Technology Development).

attributes.name: pdk_version

attributes.name: production_readiness_status
attributes.description: Current production readiness state of the technology node. Research: early R&D phase. Development: active development. Qualification: undergoing process qualification. Pilot: pilot production runs. Production: full production ready. Mature: established high-volume production. EOL (End of Life): being phased out. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: research|development|qualification|pilot|production|mature|eol — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: qualification_date

attributes.name: qualification_status
