attributes.name: supports_multi_patterning
attributes.description: Indicates whether this technology node requires or supports multi-patterning lithography techniques (e.g., double patterning, triple patterning, quadruple patterning) to achieve target dimensions.

attributes.name: target_performance_improvement_percent
attributes.description: Target percentage improvement in performance (speed/frequency) compared to the previous technology node generation. Part of PPA (Power Performance Area) metrics.

attributes.name: target_power_efficiency_improvement_percent
attributes.description: Target percentage improvement in power efficiency compared to the previous technology node generation. Part of PPA (Power Performance Area) metrics.

attributes.name: target_transistor_density_per_mm2
attributes.description: Target transistor density in millions of transistors per square millimeter for this technology node. Key metric for comparing node scaling and integration capability.

attributes.name: wavelength_nm
attributes.description: Primary lithography wavelength in nanometers (e.g., 193nm for DUV, 13.5nm for EUV). Critical parameter for resolution and patterning capability.

products.name: excursion
products.description: Process excursion record capturing any significant out-of-spec, out-of-control, or yield-impacting condition detected during wafer manufacturing that requires formal engineering investigation. Encompasses all yield loss events as a unified excursion type. Captures excursion detection source (SPC, inspection, metrology, electrical test), affected lot list, process step, excursion severity (minor/major/critical), yield loss mode (parametric, systematic, random, electrical), defect density, affected die count, estimated yield impact, detection timestamp, containment actions taken, root cause category, corrective action reference, investigation status, and final disposition. Serves as the single parent investigation record for all process-related yield and excursion events. Distinct from individual OCAP actions which are the immediate corrective responses. SSOT for process excursion and yield loss tracking; quality domain owns outgoing quality excursions and customer returns.

attributes.name: excursion_id
attributes.description: Primary key for excursion

attributes.name: employee_id
attributes.description: Reference to the process engineer responsible for investigating and resolving this excursion. Links to employee or engineer master data.

attributes.name: fab_tool_id
attributes.description: Reference to the manufacturing equipment where the excursion occurred. Links to equipment master data.

attributes.name: fabrication_process_step_id
attributes.description: Reference to the specific process step where the excursion was detected. Links to process step master data.

attributes.name: fabrication_technology_node_id
attributes.description: Reference to the technology node of the affected product. Links to technology node master data.

attributes.name: fabrication_wafer_lot_id
attributes.description: Reference to the primary wafer lot affected by this excursion. Links to the fabrication wafer lot master data.

attributes.name: ic_catalog_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to product.ic_catalog. Business justification: Excursions are recorded per IC product to assess impact; required for the Excursion Impact Report.

attributes.name: process_flow_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to process.process_flow. Business justification: Excursions occur within a specific process flow context. This FK enables process flow-level excursion reporting and yield impact analysis.

attributes.name: process_step_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to process.process_step. Business justification: Process excursions occur at specific process steps. This FK is critical for root cause analysis and step-level excursion tracking. No existing FK from excursion to process_step.

attributes.name: research_project_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to research.project. Business justification: Excursions on wafers derived from a research project must be logged to the project for risk tracking and corrective action.

attributes.name: spc_control_chart_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to process.spc_control_chart. Business justification: Excursions are often detected via SPC chart violations. Linking excursion to the triggering SPC chart enables traceability from excursion back to the monitoring chart.

attributes.name: affected_die_count
attributes.description: Estimated total number of die units affected by this excursion. Used for financial impact assessment and customer notification.

attributes.name: affected_lot_count
attributes.description: Total number of wafer lots affected by this excursion event. Used for impact assessment and containment scope determination.

attributes.name: affected_wafer_count
attributes.description: Total number of individual wafers affected by this excursion across all lots. Used for yield impact calculation.

attributes.name: containment_action_taken
attributes.description: Immediate containment actions taken upon excursion detection. Describes steps such as lot hold, equipment quarantine, process parameter adjustment, or rework initiation.

attributes.name: containment_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when containment actions were completed. Used to measure response time and containment effectiveness.

attributes.name: corrective_action_reference
attributes.description: Reference number or identifier for the corrective action plan. Links to the formal corrective and preventive action (CAPA) system or Out-of-Control Action Plan (OCAP) record.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this excursion record was first created in the system. Audit trail for record creation.

attributes.name: customer_notification_required
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether customer notification is required for this excursion. True if the excursion impacts shipped product or customer-specific quality requirements.

attributes.name: customer_notification_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when customer was notified of the excursion. Used for compliance tracking and customer relationship management.

attributes.name: defect_density_per_cm2
attributes.description: Measured defect density in defects per square centimeter for the affected wafers. Key metric for yield impact assessment.

attributes.name: detection_source
attributes.description: Source system or method that detected the excursion event. Indicates whether the excursion was identified through Statistical Process Control (SPC), inspection, metrology measurement, electrical test, operator observation, or automated monitoring system.

attributes.name: detection_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the excursion was first detected. Represents the business event time of excursion identification.

attributes.name: disposition
attributes.description: Final disposition decision for the affected material. Determines whether lots are released, reworked, scrapped, returned, or require additional review.

attributes.name: disposition_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the final disposition decision was made. Marks the completion of the excursion investigation and material release decision.

attributes.name: estimated_financial_impact_usd
attributes.description: Estimated financial impact of the excursion in US dollars. Includes scrap cost, rework cost, yield loss, and potential customer claims.

attributes.name: estimated_yield_impact_percent
attributes.description: Estimated percentage point impact on wafer yield due to this excursion. Calculated based on defect density, affected area, and historical correlation data.

attributes.name: excursion_number
attributes.description: Business identifier for the excursion event. Human-readable reference number used for tracking and communication across engineering teams.

attributes.name: excursion_type
attributes.description: Classification of the excursion event. Categorizes whether the excursion is due to out-of-specification parameters, out-of-control process conditions, yield loss, excessive defect density, parametric drift, or equipment fault.

attributes.name: investigation_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the excursion investigation. Tracks progression from initial detection through root cause analysis to closure.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this excursion record was last updated. Audit trail for tracking investigation progress and status changes.

attributes.name: lower_control_limit
attributes.description: Lower control limit from the Statistical Process Control (SPC) chart at the time of excursion detection. Used to determine out-of-control conditions.

attributes.name: measured_value
attributes.description: Actual measured value of the parameter that triggered the excursion. Used for root cause analysis and process capability assessment.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Additional notes, comments, or observations related to the excursion investigation. Captures engineering insights and lessons learned.

attributes.name: owner_organization
attributes.description: Engineering organization or department responsible for this excursion. Examples include Process Integration, Lithography, Etch, Thin Films, or Metrology.

attributes.name: parameter_name
attributes.description: Name of the process parameter that triggered the excursion. Examples include critical dimension (CD), film thickness, overlay, resistance, or other measured characteristics.

attributes.name: root_cause_category
attributes.description: High-level classification of the root cause. Categories include equipment malfunction, material variation, process recipe issue, human error, environmental condition, or unknown pending investigation.

attributes.name: root_cause_description
attributes.description: Detailed description of the identified root cause. Captures engineering analysis findings and technical explanation of the excursion mechanism.

attributes.name: severity_level
attributes.description: Severity classification of the excursion impact. Minor excursions require monitoring, major excursions require corrective action, and critical excursions require immediate containment and investigation.

attributes.name: spc_rule_violated
attributes.description: Specific Statistical Process Control (SPC) rule that was violated to trigger the excursion. Examples include Western Electric rules, Nelson rules, or custom fab-specific control rules.

attributes.name: specification_lower_limit
attributes.description: Lower specification limit for the parameter. Used to determine out-of-specification conditions and product quality impact.

attributes.name: specification_upper_limit
attributes.description: Upper specification limit for the parameter. Used to determine out-of-specification conditions and product quality impact.

attributes.name: target_value
attributes.description: Target specification value for the parameter. Used to calculate deviation magnitude and assess excursion severity.

attributes.name: unit_of_measure
attributes.description: Unit of measure for the parameter values. Examples include nanometers (nm), angstroms, ohms, degrees Celsius, or other engineering units.

attributes.name: upper_control_limit
attributes.description: Upper control limit from the Statistical Process Control (SPC) chart at the time of excursion detection. Used to determine out-of-control conditions.

attributes.name: yield_loss_mode
attributes.description: Classification of the yield loss mechanism. Parametric indicates parameter drift, systematic indicates repeatable pattern defects, random indicates sporadic defects, electrical indicates functional test failures, none indicates no yield impact detected.

products.name: doe_experiment
products.description: Design of Experiments (DOE) record for process optimization and characterization studies. Captures experiment title, process step under study, DOE type (full factorial, fractional factorial, RSM, Taguchi), factors and levels, response variables, wafer split plan, run order, statistical analysis method, key findings, recommended setpoint changes, and process window characterization results. Supports process capability improvement, new technology node development, and recipe optimization.
products.reference: SEMI DOE / IEEE Design of Experiments

attributes.name: doe_experiment_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the DOE experiment record. Primary key for the DOE experiment entity.

attributes.name: ar_invoice_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to invoice.ar_invoice. Business justification: DOE NRE Billing links a design‑of‑experiments project to the invoice that charges the customer for the NRE work.

attributes.name: employee_id
attributes.description: Reference to the process engineer responsible for designing, executing, and analyzing the DOE experiment.

attributes.name: fab_site_id
attributes.description: FK to fabrication.fab_site

attributes.name: fabrication_process_step_id
attributes.description: Reference to the specific process step under study in this DOE experiment (e.g., photolithography, etch, deposition, implant).

attributes.name: fabrication_technology_node_id
attributes.description: Reference to the technology node (e.g., 7nm, 5nm, 3nm) for which this DOE experiment is being conducted.

attributes.name: ic_catalog_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to product.ic_catalog. Business justification: DOE experiments are conducted for a specific IC product; results feed the DOE Results per Product analysis.

attributes.name: process_flow_id

attributes.name: process_qualification_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to process.process_qualification. Business justification: DOE experiments are often conducted as part of a process qualification program. This FK links the experiment to the qualification it supports.

attributes.name: process_step_id
attributes.description: FK to process.process_process_step.process_process_step_id — DOE experiments study specific process steps. The step reference identifies what is being optimized.

attributes.name: actual_completion_date
attributes.description: Actual date when the DOE experiment was completed, including all runs, analysis, and final reporting.

attributes.name: actual_start_date
attributes.description: Actual date when the DOE experiment began wafer processing and data collection.

attributes.name: analysis_software
attributes.description: Software tool or platform used for DOE design and statistical analysis (e.g., JMP, Minitab, Design-Expert, R, Python).

attributes.name: approval_date
attributes.description: Date when the DOE experiment plan or results were formally approved.

attributes.name: approval_status
attributes.description: Approval status of the DOE experiment plan and results by management or technical review board.

attributes.name: baseline_cpk
attributes.description: Process capability index (Cpk) measured before the DOE experiment, serving as the baseline for comparison.

attributes.name: blocking_factor
attributes.description: Factor used to group experimental runs into blocks to control for known sources of variation (e.g., different lots, different days, different chambers).

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the DOE experiment record was first created in the system.

attributes.name: doe_type
attributes.description: Statistical design methodology used for the experiment. Full factorial explores all factor combinations; fractional factorial reduces runs; RSM optimizes response surfaces; Taguchi focuses on robustness; Plackett-Burman screens many factors efficiently; Central Composite designs for quadratic models.

attributes.name: experiment_number
attributes.description: Business identifier for the DOE experiment, typically a human-readable code used for tracking and reference across engineering teams.

attributes.name: experiment_objective
attributes.description: Detailed description of the business and technical objectives of the DOE experiment, including the problem statement, hypothesis, and expected outcomes.

attributes.name: experiment_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the DOE experiment. Tracks progression from planning through execution to completion. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: planned|in_progress|data_collection|analysis|completed|cancelled|on_hold — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: experiment_title
attributes.description: Descriptive title of the DOE experiment that summarizes the objective and scope of the study.

attributes.name: factor_count
attributes.description: Number of independent variables (factors) being studied in the DOE experiment. Each factor represents a process parameter that may influence the response variables.

attributes.name: factor_levels
attributes.description: Description of the levels (values) tested for each factor in the experiment. Typically includes low, medium, and high settings or specific numerical values.

attributes.name: factor_list
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of factors (independent variables) being studied, such as temperature, pressure, dose, time, gas flow rate, power, etc.

attributes.name: interaction_effects
attributes.description: Description of any significant interaction effects between factors, where the effect of one factor depends on the level of another factor.

attributes.name: key_findings
attributes.description: Summary of the main conclusions from the DOE experiment, including significant factors, interactions, optimal settings, and process insights.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the DOE experiment record was last updated or modified.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Additional notes, observations, or comments related to the DOE experiment, including any deviations from plan, special conditions, or lessons learned.

attributes.name: owner_organization
attributes.description: Engineering organization or department responsible for the DOE experiment (e.g., Process Integration, Lithography, Etch, Thin Films).

attributes.name: planned_completion_date
attributes.description: Planned date for the DOE experiment to complete all runs, analysis, and reporting.

attributes.name: planned_start_date
attributes.description: Planned date for the DOE experiment to begin wafer processing and data collection.

attributes.name: post_doe_cpk
attributes.description: Process capability index (Cpk) measured after implementing the DOE recommendations, demonstrating the improvement achieved.

attributes.name: primary_response_variable
attributes.description: The main response variable of interest for optimization or characterization in this DOE experiment.

attributes.name: process_capability_improvement
attributes.description: Quantitative or qualitative assessment of process capability improvement achieved through the DOE experiment, such as Cpk improvement, defect reduction, or yield enhancement.

attributes.name: process_window_lower_limit
attributes.description: Lower boundary of the acceptable process window for key factors, defining the range within which the process remains stable and meets specifications.

attributes.name: process_window_upper_limit
attributes.description: Upper boundary of the acceptable process window for key factors, defining the range within which the process remains stable and meets specifications.

attributes.name: recommended_setpoints
attributes.description: Optimal or recommended process parameter settings derived from the DOE analysis to achieve desired response variable targets.

attributes.name: replication_count
attributes.description: Number of times each experimental condition is replicated to assess measurement variability and improve statistical power.

attributes.name: response_variable_count
attributes.description: Number of dependent variables (responses) being measured in the DOE experiment. Response variables are the outcomes being optimized or characterized.

attributes.name: response_variable_list
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of response variables being measured, such as Critical Dimension (CD), uniformity, defect density, yield, thickness, etch rate, etc.

attributes.name: run_count
attributes.description: Total number of experimental runs (treatment combinations) planned or executed in the DOE study.

attributes.name: run_order_strategy
attributes.description: Strategy used to sequence experimental runs. Randomization minimizes bias; blocking controls for known sources of variation; center point replication assesses curvature and repeatability.

attributes.name: significant_factors
attributes.description: List of factors that were statistically significant in affecting the response variables, based on the analysis results.

attributes.name: statistical_analysis_method
attributes.description: Statistical techniques applied to analyze the DOE results, such as ANOVA, regression analysis, main effects plots, interaction plots, contour plots, or optimization algorithms.

attributes.name: wafer_count
attributes.description: Total number of wafers allocated to the DOE experiment across all runs and splits.

attributes.name: wafer_split_plan
attributes.description: Description of how wafers are allocated across different experimental conditions, including split assignments, replication strategy, and randomization approach.

attributes.name: yield_impact_percent
attributes.description: Estimated or measured impact on wafer yield resulting from the DOE experiment and implementation of recommended changes, expressed as a percentage change.

attributes.name: cooling_process_id
attributes.description: Primary key for cooling_process

attributes.name: process_flow_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to process.process_flow. Business justification: Cooling processes are part of a process flow. This FK links the cooling process to the process flow it belongs to, enabling flow-level cooling process management.

attributes.name: process_step_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to process.process_step. Business justification: Cooling processes occur at specific process steps. This FK links the cooling process to the step where it is applied.

attributes.name: backside_gas_pressure_torr
attributes.description: Pressure of the backside cooling gas in Torr. Controls thermal coupling between the wafer and the electrostatic chuck or susceptor during cooling.

attributes.name: backside_gas_type
attributes.description: Type of gas used for backside wafer cooling (e.g., helium backside gas for electrostatic chuck cooling). Affects thermal conductance between wafer and chuck.

attributes.name: chamber_pressure_mtorr
attributes.description: Process chamber pressure in millitorr during the cooling step. Relevant for vacuum-based cooling processes where heat transfer is pressure-dependent.

attributes.name: change_notification_number
attributes.description: Reference number of the process change notification (PCN) or engineering change order (ECO) that introduced or last modified this cooling process definition.

attributes.name: compatible_tool_ids
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of equipment tool IDs on which this cooling process is qualified to run. Used for dispatch and scheduling validation until a formal tool-allocation link is established.

attributes.name: condensation_risk_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this cooling process carries a risk of moisture condensation on the wafer surface, requiring dew-point monitoring or nitrogen purge protocols.

attributes.name: coolant_flow_rate_slm
attributes.description: Nominal flow rate of the coolant medium in standard liters per minute (SLM). Governs heat transfer efficiency and uniformity across the wafer surface.

attributes.name: coolant_medium
attributes.description: The physical medium used to transfer heat away from the wafer or substrate during the cooling process. Determines material compatibility and contamination risk. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: nitrogen|air|helium|chilled_water|deionized_water|liquid_nitrogen|co2 — promote to reference product]

attributes.name: coolant_pressure_kpa
attributes.description: Nominal coolant delivery pressure in kilopascals (kPa). Out-of-spec pressure can cause non-uniform cooling or equipment damage.

attributes.name: cooldown_duration_sec
attributes.description: Nominal duration in seconds for the cooling process to bring the wafer from process exit temperature to the target temperature. Used for cycle time planning and scheduling.

attributes.name: cooling_rate_c_per_sec
attributes.description: Nominal rate of temperature decrease in degrees Celsius per second. Critical for stress management in thin-film layers and preventing wafer warpage.

attributes.name: cpk_target
attributes.description: Minimum acceptable process capability index (Cpk) for the cooling process temperature control. Typically ≥1.33 for production qualification.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this cooling process record was first created in the system. Supports audit trail and data lineage requirements.

attributes.name: effective_date
attributes.description: Date from which this version of the cooling process definition is authorized for production use. Supports change control and process history tracking.

attributes.name: ehs_classification
attributes.description: EHS risk classification for this cooling process based on chemical, cryogenic, and electrical hazard assessment. Drives safety training and PPE requirements.

attributes.name: electrostatic_chuck_required_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether an electrostatic chuck (ESC) is required to maintain wafer contact and thermal coupling during the cooling process.

attributes.name: energy_consumption_kwh
attributes.description: Estimated energy consumption in kilowatt-hours per wafer lot for this cooling process. Used for fab energy management, sustainability reporting, and cost modeling.

attributes.name: equipment_type
attributes.description: Class or type of equipment on which this cooling process is executed (e.g., 'Cooling Station', 'Load Lock', 'Cluster Tool Cool Module'). Used for equipment compatibility matching.

attributes.name: expiry_date
attributes.description: Date after which this cooling process version is no longer authorized for production use. Null indicates no planned expiry.

attributes.name: hazardous_gas_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the cooling process uses hazardous gases (e.g., cryogenic nitrogen, CO2) requiring special handling, PPE, and environmental health and safety (EHS) controls.

attributes.name: initial_temperature_c
attributes.description: Expected wafer temperature in degrees Celsius at the start of the cooling process (i.e., exit temperature from the preceding process step). Used to validate thermal budget compliance.

attributes.name: max_cooldown_duration_sec
attributes.description: Maximum allowable cooldown duration in seconds before the process is flagged as out-of-spec. Exceeding this value triggers an equipment alarm and process review.

attributes.name: max_cooling_rate_c_per_sec
attributes.business_glossary_term: Max Cooling Rate C Per Sec
attributes.description: Maximum permissible cooling rate in degrees Celsius per second to prevent thermal shock, wafer cracking, or film delamination.

tag_set.value: Max Cooling Rate C Per Sec

attributes.name: next_requalification_date
attributes.description: Scheduled date for the next mandatory requalification of this cooling process. Derived from qualification_date plus requalification_interval_days but stored for scheduling system integration.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for process engineers to record observations, known issues, deviations, or supplementary guidance related to this cooling process.

attributes.name: owner_engineer_name
attributes.description: Full name of the process engineer responsible for maintaining and qualifying this cooling process. PII — must be masked in non-production environments per VREQ-050.

attributes.name: particle_size_threshold_nm
attributes.description: Minimum particle size in nanometers counted toward the particle specification. Defines the sensitivity of post-cooling particle inspection.

attributes.name: particle_spec_count
attributes.description: Maximum allowable particle adder count on the wafer surface after the cooling process. Exceeding this value triggers a process qualification review.

attributes.name: process_code
attributes.description: Externally-known alphanumeric code uniquely identifying this cooling process definition within the process engineering library. Used in traveler documents and process specifications.

attributes.name: process_description
attributes.description: Detailed narrative description of the cooling process, including its purpose, integration context within the process flow, and any special handling requirements.

attributes.name: process_name
attributes.description: Human-readable name of the cooling process (e.g., 'Post-CMP Wafer Cool', 'Post-Etch Rapid Cool'). Used in process flow documentation and operator instructions.

attributes.name: process_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the cooling process definition. Controls whether the process may be scheduled on production equipment.

attributes.name: process_step
attributes.description: The semiconductor manufacturing step after which this cooling process is applied (e.g., 'Post-CMP', 'Post-Etch', 'Post-Implant', 'Post-Anneal'). Defines integration context.

attributes.name: process_type
attributes.description: Classification of the cooling mechanism employed. Determines equipment compatibility and safety protocols. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: forced_convection|natural_convection|cryogenic|liquid_nitrogen|chilled_water|peltier|radiative — promote to reference product]

attributes.name: qualification_date
attributes.description: Date on which this cooling process was most recently qualified for production use. Used to track qualification currency and schedule requalification.

attributes.name: qualification_status
attributes.description: Current process qualification status indicating whether this cooling process has passed all required qualification tests for production use.

attributes.name: requalification_interval_days
attributes.description: Number of days between mandatory requalification runs for this cooling process. Drives the process maintenance schedule.

attributes.name: safety_interlock_required_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether safety interlocks (e.g., over-temperature shutoff, gas flow interlock) are mandatory for this cooling process per SEMI S2 safety guidelines.

attributes.name: spc_chart_type
attributes.description: Type of SPC control chart applied to monitor this cooling process. Determines the statistical method used for process control and out-of-control detection.

attributes.name: substrate_material
attributes.description: Material composition of the wafer substrate for which this cooling process is designed. Different materials have distinct thermal conductivity and expansion coefficients.

attributes.name: target_temperature_c
attributes.description: Nominal target wafer or substrate temperature in degrees Celsius that the cooling process must achieve before the wafer is released to the next process step.

attributes.name: technology_node
attributes.description: Semiconductor technology node (e.g., '7nm', '14nm', '28nm') for which this cooling process is qualified. Determines applicability to specific product families.

attributes.name: temperature_lower_limit_c
attributes.description: Lower control limit for wafer temperature in degrees Celsius. Wafers below this limit may indicate over-cooling, triggering condensation risk checks.

attributes.name: temperature_upper_limit_c
attributes.description: Upper control limit for wafer temperature in degrees Celsius. Wafers exceeding this limit trigger a process hold or alarm condition.

attributes.name: thermal_budget_c_sec
attributes.description: Integrated thermal exposure (temperature × time) in degree-Celsius-seconds allocated to this cooling step within the overall process thermal budget. Constrains dopant diffusion and film integrity.

attributes.name: uniformity_spec_pct
attributes.description: Maximum allowable temperature non-uniformity across the wafer surface expressed as a percentage. Directly impacts device performance and yield.

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this cooling process record was last modified. Supports change tracking, audit trail, and incremental data pipeline processing.

attributes.name: version_number
attributes.description: Version identifier of this cooling process recipe definition (e.g., '1.0', '2.3'). Tracks process revisions and supports change control traceability.

attributes.name: wafer_size_mm
attributes.description: Nominal wafer diameter in millimeters for which this cooling process is qualified (e.g., 200, 300, 450). Determines applicability to specific fab lines.

attributes.name: supersedes_cooling_process_id
attributes.description: Self-referencing FK on cooling_process (supersedes_cooling_process_id)

products.name: cooling_optimization_run
products.description: Master reference table for cooling_optimization_run. Referenced by cooling_optimization_run_id.

attributes.name: cooling_optimization_run_id
attributes.description: Primary key for cooling_optimization_run

attributes.name: cooling_condition_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to process.cooling_condition. Business justification: Cooling optimization runs test specific cooling conditions. This FK links the optimization run to the cooling condition being evaluated.

attributes.name: cooling_process_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to process.cooling_process. Business justification: Cooling optimization runs are conducted to optimize a specific cooling process. This FK links the optimization run to the cooling process being optimized.

attributes.name: employee_id
attributes.description: Reference to the process engineer responsible for designing, executing, and analyzing this cooling optimization run. Used for accountability, knowledge management, and escalation routing.

attributes.name: fab_tool_id
attributes.description: Reference to the specific process equipment unit on which the cooling optimization run is conducted. Links to the equipment master for tool specifications and maintenance history.

attributes.name: lot_id
attributes.description: Reference to the wafer lot processed during the cooling optimization run. Enables correlation of cooling parameters with lot-level yield and electrical performance outcomes.

attributes.name: process_flow_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to process.process_flow. Business justification: Cooling optimization runs are conducted within a specific process flow context. This FK links the optimization run to the process flow it supports.

attributes.name: process_step_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to process.process_step. Business justification: Cooling optimization runs are conducted for a specific process step. This FK links the optimization run to the step being optimized.

attributes.name: program_id
attributes.description: Reference to the technology development or product program under which this cooling optimization run is conducted. Enables program-level aggregation of cooling optimization activities and resource tracking.

attributes.name: recipe_id
attributes.description: Reference to the process recipe used during the cooling optimization run. The recipe defines the baseline process parameters against which cooling modifications are evaluated.

attributes.name: backside_gas_pressure_torr
attributes.description: Pressure of the backside cooling gas applied between the wafer and chuck, measured in Torr. Optimizing backside gas pressure improves wafer-to-chuck thermal conductance and wafer temperature uniformity.

attributes.name: backside_gas_type
attributes.description: Type of gas used for backside wafer cooling (typically helium) to enhance thermal contact between the wafer and chuck. Backside gas pressure and type are critical parameters in electrostatic chuck cooling optimization.

attributes.name: baseline_wafer_temp_c
attributes.description: Wafer temperature measured under the pre-optimization (baseline) cooling configuration, in degrees Celsius. Provides the reference point against which optimization improvements are measured.

attributes.name: best_iteration_number
attributes.description: Iteration number within this run that yielded the optimal cooling performance result as defined by the optimization objective. Used to trace back to the specific parameter set that should be adopted.

attributes.name: chuck_temp_actual_c
attributes.description: Measured actual temperature of the chuck during the cooling optimization run, in degrees Celsius. Deviation from setpoint indicates cooling system performance and is a key optimization metric.

attributes.name: chuck_temp_setpoint_c
attributes.description: Target temperature setpoint for the electrostatic or mechanical chuck that holds the wafer during processing, in degrees Celsius. Chuck temperature directly controls wafer thermal uniformity and process outcomes.

attributes.name: coolant_flow_rate_lpm
attributes.description: Volumetric flow rate of the coolant during the optimization run, measured in liters per minute (LPM). A primary optimization variable controlling heat removal capacity from the process chamber or chuck.

attributes.name: coolant_inlet_temp_c
attributes.description: Temperature of the coolant at the inlet to the cooling system during the run, measured in degrees Celsius. A key optimization parameter that sets the baseline thermal boundary condition.

attributes.name: coolant_outlet_temp_c
attributes.description: Temperature of the coolant at the outlet of the cooling system during the run, measured in degrees Celsius. The delta between inlet and outlet temperatures quantifies heat absorbed from the process.

attributes.name: coolant_pressure_kpa
attributes.description: Operating pressure of the coolant circuit during the cooling optimization run, measured in kilopascals (kPa). Pressure affects flow rate, heat transfer efficiency, and system integrity.

attributes.name: coolant_type
attributes.description: Type of cooling medium used in the optimization run (e.g., deionized water, perfluorocarbon fluid, chilled water, nitrogen gas, helium gas). Determines heat transfer characteristics and compatibility with process chemistry.

attributes.name: cooling_system_efficiency_pct
attributes.description: Ratio of useful heat removed to total energy input for the cooling system during the run, expressed as a percentage. Measures the thermodynamic efficiency of the cooling configuration and supports energy optimization.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this cooling optimization run record was first created in the system. Audit trail field for data lineage and compliance purposes.

attributes.name: defect_density_per_cm2
attributes.description: Measured defect density on wafers processed during the cooling optimization run, expressed as defects per square centimeter. Used to correlate cooling parameter changes with defect generation and process quality.

attributes.name: doe_design_name
attributes.description: Name or identifier of the Design of Experiment (DOE) design matrix used for this cooling optimization run (e.g., Box-Behnken, Central Composite, L9 Taguchi). Applicable when run_type is design_of_experiment.

attributes.name: energy_consumption_kwh
attributes.description: Total electrical energy consumed by the cooling system during the optimization run, measured in kilowatt-hours (kWh). Supports energy efficiency analysis and sustainability reporting for fab operations.

attributes.name: equipment_model
attributes.description: Manufacturer model designation of the process equipment used in the cooling optimization run (e.g., ASML NXT:2000i, Applied Materials Centura). Supports equipment-specific parameter benchmarking.

attributes.name: fab_area
attributes.description: Designated fabrication bay or cleanroom area within the fab where the cooling optimization run is executed (e.g., Bay 3A, Litho Bay, Diffusion Area). Used for spatial traceability and equipment grouping.

attributes.name: heat_removal_rate_w
attributes.description: Rate at which heat is removed from the process chamber or wafer by the cooling system during the run, measured in Watts. Quantifies the effective cooling capacity achieved under the optimized parameters.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text engineering notes capturing observations, anomalies, equipment issues, or contextual information relevant to this cooling optimization run. Supports knowledge transfer and root cause analysis.

attributes.name: number_of_iterations
attributes.description: Total number of parameter configuration iterations executed within this cooling optimization run. Tracks the breadth of the parameter space explored and the computational/experimental effort expended.

attributes.name: optimization_algorithm
attributes.description: Statistical or computational method used to explore and optimize the cooling parameter space in this run (e.g., Design of Experiment full factorial, response surface methodology, gradient descent). Determines the experimental design and analysis approach.

attributes.name: optimization_objective
attributes.description: Primary engineering objective driving this cooling optimization run. Defines the optimization criterion used to evaluate parameter configurations and select the optimal cooling setup.

attributes.name: optimization_score
attributes.description: Quantitative score representing the degree of optimization achieved in this run relative to the defined objective function. Higher scores indicate better optimization outcomes; used to compare runs and track improvement over time.

attributes.name: optimized_wafer_temp_c
attributes.description: Wafer temperature achieved under the optimized cooling configuration identified by this run, in degrees Celsius. Compared against baseline to quantify the thermal improvement delivered.

attributes.name: owner_engineer_name
attributes.description: Full name of the process engineer who owns and is accountable for this cooling optimization run. PII-tagged per VREQ-050; must be masked in non-production environments.

attributes.name: process_capability_cpk
attributes.description: Process capability index (Cpk) calculated for the primary cooling parameter (e.g., chuck temperature) during this run. Cpk >= 1.33 is typically required for production qualification; used to assess cooling process stability.

attributes.name: process_chamber_pressure_mtorr
attributes.description: Operating pressure inside the process chamber during the cooling optimization run, measured in millitorr (mTorr). Chamber pressure influences plasma density, etch/deposition rates, and thermal coupling.

attributes.name: qualification_status
attributes.description: Status of the formal qualification process for the optimized cooling parameters identified in this run. Tracks progression from initial optimization through engineering qualification to production release.

attributes.name: recipe_version
attributes.description: Version identifier of the process recipe used during this cooling optimization run. Ensures traceability to the exact recipe revision and supports change management.

attributes.name: recommended_for_production
attributes.description: Indicates whether the optimized cooling parameters identified in this run are recommended for adoption in production process recipes. True = parameters approved for production use; False = further optimization or validation required.

attributes.name: rf_power_w
attributes.description: Radio frequency (RF) power applied to the process chamber during the run, measured in Watts. RF power is a primary heat source in plasma processes and directly determines the cooling load that must be managed.

attributes.name: run_duration_minutes
attributes.description: Total elapsed time of the cooling optimization run from start to end, measured in minutes. Used for equipment scheduling, throughput analysis, and cycle time optimization.

attributes.name: run_end_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the cooling optimization run was completed or terminated. Used with run_start_timestamp to calculate total run duration and equipment utilization.

attributes.name: run_number
attributes.description: Externally-known business identifier for the cooling optimization run, used in engineering documentation, work orders, and cross-team communication. Format: COR-{YYYY}-{NNNNNN}.

attributes.name: run_start_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the cooling optimization run was initiated on the equipment. The principal business event timestamp marking the start of active experimentation.

attributes.name: run_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the cooling optimization run, tracking progression from planning through execution to completion or failure. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: planned|in_progress|completed|aborted|on_hold|failed — promote to reference product]

attributes.name: run_type
attributes.description: Classification of the cooling optimization run by its engineering purpose: baseline characterization, parametric sweep across cooling variables, design of experiment (DOE), validation of optimized parameters, or production monitoring run.

attributes.name: spc_in_control
attributes.description: Indicates whether the cooling process parameters were within Statistical Process Control (SPC) control limits throughout the optimization run. True = all parameters in control; False = one or more SPC violations detected.

attributes.name: technology_node
attributes.description: Semiconductor technology node (process generation) for which this cooling optimization run is performed, expressed in nanometers (e.g., 7nm, 5nm, 3nm). Determines thermal budget constraints and cooling requirements.

attributes.name: temp_improvement_c
attributes.description: Reduction in wafer temperature achieved by the optimized cooling configuration compared to baseline, in degrees Celsius (baseline_wafer_temp_c minus optimized_wafer_temp_c). Key performance indicator for the optimization run.

attributes.name: thermal_resistance_c_per_w
attributes.description: Measured thermal resistance of the cooling interface between the chuck and the wafer, expressed in degrees Celsius per Watt (°C/W). Lower values indicate more efficient heat transfer and are a key optimization target.

attributes.name: thermal_stabilization_time_s
attributes.description: Time required for the cooling system to reach thermal steady state at the target setpoint, measured in seconds. A key optimization metric; shorter stabilization times improve equipment throughput.

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this cooling optimization run record was last modified. Audit trail field supporting change tracking, data lineage, and incremental ETL processing.

attributes.name: wafer_count
attributes.description: Number of wafers included in the cooling optimization run. Determines thermal load and is used to validate cooling capacity under production-representative conditions.

attributes.name: wafer_size_mm
attributes.description: Diameter of the wafers processed in this cooling optimization run, expressed in millimeters (e.g., 200, 300, 450). Wafer size directly impacts thermal mass and cooling system design requirements.

attributes.name: wafer_temp_uniformity_c
attributes.description: Measured peak-to-valley temperature variation across the wafer surface during the run, in degrees Celsius. A primary optimization objective; lower values indicate better thermal uniformity and improved process uniformity.

attributes.name: yield_impact_pct
attributes.description: Estimated or measured change in wafer yield attributable to the cooling optimization, expressed as a percentage. Positive values indicate yield improvement; used to justify cooling optimization investments.

attributes.name: baseline_cooling_optimization_run_id
attributes.description: Self-referencing FK on cooling_optimization_run (baseline_cooling_optimization_run_id)

products.name: cooling_condition
products.description: Master reference table for cooling_condition. Referenced by cooling_condition_id.

attributes.name: cooling_condition_id
attributes.description: Primary key for cooling_condition

attributes.name: alarm_action
attributes.description: Automated or manual action triggered when the cooling condition falls outside its control limits. Defines the response protocol for out-of-spec cooling events.

attributes.name: ambient_temperature_c
attributes.description: Required ambient temperature in degrees Celsius within the process module or mini-environment during the cooling step. Ensures environmental control for sensitive process nodes.

attributes.name: approval_date
attributes.description: Date on which this cooling condition was formally approved by the responsible engineer or process owner for production deployment.

attributes.name: approved_by_name
attributes.description: Full name of the process or quality engineer who formally approved this cooling condition for production use. PII — masked in non-production environments.

attributes.name: chamber_pressure_torr
attributes.description: Process chamber pressure in Torr during the cooling step. Vacuum or controlled-atmosphere conditions affect the cooling rate and prevent contamination.

attributes.name: change_reason
attributes.description: Narrative description of the reason for creating or modifying this cooling condition. Supports process change management and audit trail requirements.

attributes.name: chuck_temperature_c
attributes.description: Set-point temperature of the electrostatic or mechanical chuck in degrees Celsius during the cooling step. Controls wafer backside heat transfer and uniformity.

attributes.name: cleanroom_class
attributes.description: ISO cleanroom classification required for performing this cooling step. Ensures the cooling environment meets contamination control requirements for the target technology node.

attributes.name: condition_code
attributes.description: Externally-known alphanumeric code uniquely identifying this cooling condition within the process engineering system. Used as a human-readable reference across process flows, equipment recipes, and qualification documents.

attributes.name: condition_description
attributes.description: Detailed narrative description of the cooling condition, including its purpose within the process flow, applicable process steps, and any special handling notes.

attributes.name: condition_name
attributes.description: Descriptive name for the cooling condition (e.g., 'Post-Etch Rapid Cool', 'Diffusion Furnace Ramp-Down'). Used in process documentation, traveler sheets, and operator interfaces.

attributes.name: condition_type
attributes.description: Classification of the cooling method applied. Determines the thermal profile and equipment configuration required. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: rapid_cool|slow_cool|controlled_ramp|natural_convection|forced_convection|cryogenic — promote to reference product if additional types are needed]

attributes.name: coolant_flow_rate_slm
attributes.description: Nominal flow rate of the cooling medium in standard liters per minute (SLM). Directly impacts cooling efficiency and uniformity across the wafer surface.

attributes.name: coolant_medium
attributes.description: The cooling medium used to achieve the required thermal profile (e.g., nitrogen purge, forced air, helium backside cooling, chilled water). Determines equipment compatibility and safety requirements.

attributes.name: coolant_pressure_torr
attributes.description: Pressure of the cooling medium in Torr, particularly relevant for helium backside cooling in vacuum process chambers. Affects thermal conductance between wafer and chuck.

attributes.name: cooling_duration_max_sec
attributes.description: Maximum allowable cooling duration in seconds before the wafer is flagged for review. Exceeding this limit may indicate equipment degradation or abnormal thermal load.

attributes.name: cooling_duration_sec
attributes.description: Nominal duration in seconds for the cooling step to reach the target temperature. Used for cycle time planning and equipment scheduling.

attributes.name: cooling_rate_c_per_min
attributes.description: The nominal rate at which temperature is reduced, expressed in degrees Celsius per minute. Controls thermal stress on the wafer and prevents crystal defects or film delamination.

attributes.name: cooling_rate_max_c_per_min
attributes.business_glossary_term: Cooling Rate Max C Per Min
attributes.description: Maximum allowable cooling rate in degrees Celsius per minute. Exceeding this rate risks thermal shock, wafer warpage, or film stress failures.

tag_set.value: Cooling Rate Max C Per Min

attributes.name: cpk_target
attributes.description: Minimum acceptable process capability index (Cpk) for this cooling condition. Typically ≥1.33 for production qualification. Used to assess whether the cooling process is capable of meeting specification limits.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this cooling condition record was first created in the system. Used for audit trail and data lineage tracking.

attributes.name: effective_date
attributes.description: Date from which this cooling condition becomes effective in production process flows. May differ from approval date if a staged rollout is planned.

attributes.name: equipment_type
attributes.description: Type of semiconductor processing equipment for which this cooling condition is defined (e.g., diffusion furnace, RTP system, etch chamber, CVD reactor, track system). Ensures recipe compatibility.

attributes.name: humidity_limit_pct
attributes.description: Maximum allowable relative humidity percentage in the cooling environment. Excessive humidity can cause condensation on cooled wafers, leading to defects.

attributes.name: is_active
attributes.description: Indicates whether this cooling condition is currently active and available for use in process recipes. Inactive conditions are retained for historical traceability but cannot be assigned to new lots.

attributes.name: is_default
attributes.description: Indicates whether this is the default cooling condition for the associated process step and technology node. Used by recipe management systems to auto-assign conditions when no override is specified.

attributes.name: measurement_method
attributes.description: Method used to measure wafer or chuck temperature during the cooling step (e.g., thermocouple, pyrometer, RTD, infrared sensor). Determines measurement accuracy and calibration requirements.

attributes.name: measurement_point
attributes.description: Location on the wafer or equipment where the temperature is measured to determine cooling completion (e.g., wafer center, wafer edge, chuck surface, ambient).

attributes.name: obsolete_date
attributes.description: Date on which this cooling condition was or will be retired from active use. Retained for historical traceability and audit purposes.

attributes.name: owner_engineer_name
attributes.description: Full name of the process engineer responsible for defining, maintaining, and qualifying this cooling condition. PII — masked in non-production environments per VREQ-050.

attributes.name: particle_limit_per_m3
attributes.description: Maximum allowable airborne particle count per cubic meter during the cooling step. Exceeding this limit may cause wafer contamination and yield loss.

attributes.name: pcn_reference
attributes.description: Reference number of the Process Change Notification (PCN) that introduced or last modified this cooling condition. Links to the formal change management record.

attributes.name: process_step
attributes.description: The semiconductor manufacturing process step to which this cooling condition applies (e.g., photolithography, etch, diffusion, implant, deposition, metrology). Aligns the cooling condition to the correct process module.

attributes.name: qualification_date
attributes.description: Date on which this cooling condition was formally qualified for production use. Marks the start of the valid production window.

attributes.name: qualification_status
attributes.description: Current qualification status of this cooling condition for production use. Only 'qualified' conditions may be used in production process flows; others require engineering approval.

attributes.name: recipe_version
attributes.description: Version identifier of the process recipe in which this cooling condition is embedded. Supports recipe change management and traceability to qualification data.

attributes.name: requalification_due_date
attributes.description: Date by which this cooling condition must be requalified to remain valid for production use. Driven by process change notification (PCN) schedules or periodic review cycles.

attributes.name: safety_interlock_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether a safety interlock must be engaged during this cooling step (e.g., chamber door lock, gas flow interlock). Ensures compliance with fab safety protocols.

attributes.name: source_system_code
attributes.description: Code identifying the originating process engineering or manufacturing execution system (MES) from which this cooling condition record was sourced (e.g., Camstar, WorkStream, Promis).

attributes.name: spc_control_chart_type
attributes.description: Type of SPC control chart applied to monitor this cooling condition in production. Determines the statistical method used to detect process drift or out-of-control conditions.

attributes.name: stabilization_time_sec
attributes.description: Required dwell time in seconds after reaching the target temperature to ensure thermal equilibrium before the wafer is transferred to the next process step.

attributes.name: target_temperature_c
attributes.description: The nominal target temperature in degrees Celsius to which the wafer or substrate must be cooled before proceeding to the next process step. Critical for thermal budget management.

attributes.name: technology_node
attributes.description: The semiconductor technology node (e.g., 28nm, 14nm, 7nm, 5nm) for which this cooling condition is qualified. Ensures process compatibility with the target device geometry.

attributes.name: temperature_lower_limit_c
attributes.description: Lower control limit for the cooling endpoint temperature in degrees Celsius. Wafers below this limit may indicate over-cooling, which can cause condensation or thermal stress defects.

attributes.name: temperature_upper_limit_c
attributes.description: Upper control limit for the cooling endpoint temperature in degrees Celsius. Wafers exceeding this limit must be re-cooled or placed on hold per SPC rules.

attributes.name: thermal_budget_c_sec
attributes.description: Integrated thermal budget for the cooling step expressed in degree-Celsius-seconds (°C·s). Used to track cumulative thermal exposure and ensure device junction integrity.

attributes.name: uniformity_spec_pct
attributes.description: Maximum allowable temperature non-uniformity across the wafer surface at the end of the cooling step, expressed as a percentage. Critical for within-wafer process uniformity and yield.

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp of the most recent modification to this cooling condition record. Used for change tracking, SPC monitoring, and data freshness validation.

attributes.name: wafer_material
attributes.description: Substrate material for which this cooling condition is applicable. Different materials have distinct thermal conductivity and expansion coefficients requiring tailored cooling profiles.

attributes.name: wafer_size_mm
attributes.description: Nominal wafer diameter in millimeters for which this cooling condition is defined (e.g., 200, 300, 450). Cooling parameters are wafer-size-dependent due to thermal mass differences.

attributes.name: derived_from_cooling_condition_id
attributes.description: Self-referencing FK on cooling_condition (derived_from_cooling_condition_id)

domains.name: product
domains.description: Authoritative semiconductor product catalog encompassing ICs, SoCs, ASICs, FPGAs, IP cores, and discrete devices. SSOT for product specifications, SKUs, BOM, process node assignments, PPA metrics, product lifecycle status (NPI through EOL), PCN management, and LTB notifications. Integrates with PLM systems.

products.name: ic_catalog
products.description: Master record for all semiconductor products (ICs, SoCs, ASICs, FPGAs, discretes, licensable IP cores). SSOT for product identity, internal/external part numbers, product family assignment, process node, target market, and lifecycle state with full NPI→qualification→production→EOL transition history. Golden record integrated with PLM. Each entry represents a unique silicon design with one or more orderable SKU variants.

attributes.name: ic_catalog_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the IC catalog entry. Primary key for the master record of semiconductor products including ICs, SoCs, ASICs, FPGAs, discretes, and licensable IP cores.

attributes.name: base_currency_id
attributes.description: Foreign key to the shared currency table indicating the base pricing currency for this catalog item.

attributes.name: cost_center_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.cost_center. Business justification: Required for product cost tracking and profitability reporting; each IC is assigned to a cost center for budgeting.

attributes.name: eccn_classification_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to compliance.eccn_classification. Business justification: Required for Export Control: each IC must be linked to its ECCN classification for export compliance reporting.

attributes.name: family_id
attributes.description: FK to product.product_family

attributes.name: packaging_package_type_id
attributes.description: FK to packaging.package_type

attributes.name: primary_ic_process_node_id
attributes.description: FK to product.process_node.process_node_id — Every IC product is manufactured on a specific process node. This is a fundamental product attribute that references the process node master.

attributes.name: product_manager_employee_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to workforce.employee. Business justification: Required for Product Portfolio Management report: each IC catalog entry must have a designated product manager employee.

attributes.name: supplier_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to supply.supplier. Business justification: Procurement process requires linking each IC catalog entry to its primary supplier for sourcing, cost analysis, and compliance tracking.

attributes.name: aec_qualification_level
attributes.description: Specific AEC qualification standard met. Q100: ICs, Q101: Discretes, Q102: Optoelectronics, Q200: Passives. Set to NA if not automotive qualified.

attributes.name: automotive_qualified
attributes.description: Indicates whether the product has passed automotive-grade qualification testing per AEC-Q standards. Required for automotive market. Includes extended temperature, reliability, and quality requirements.

attributes.name: catalog_to_family
attributes.description: FK to product.product_family.product_family_id — Every IC product belongs to a product family in the taxonomy hierarchy. This is the primary classification FK.

attributes.name: country_of_origin
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO country code indicating where the IC was manufactured or substantially transformed. Used for trade compliance, tariffs, and country-of-origin marking requirements.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this IC catalog record was first created in the PLM system. Audit trail for data governance and lineage tracking.

attributes.name: design_type
attributes.description: Design methodology used for IC development. Determines NRE cost, time to market, and flexibility. Full custom offers maximum optimization; standard cell balances speed and cost.

attributes.name: die_size_mm2
attributes.description: Physical die area in square millimeters after final layout. Critical cost driver as it determines dies per wafer and manufacturing yield economics. Part of PPA metrics.

attributes.name: ear_eccn_code
attributes.business_glossary_term: Export Administration Regulations (EAR) Export Control Classification Number (ECCN)
attributes.description: ECCN code assigned under US Export Administration Regulations. Determines export licensing requirements for dual-use items. Format: 3A001.a. EAR99 indicates no specific ECCN.

tag_set.value: Export Administration Regulations (EAR) Export Control Classification Number (ECCN)

attributes.name: eol_announcement_date
attributes.description: Date when EOL was formally announced to customers via Product Change Notification (PCN). Triggers last-time-buy (LTB) planning and customer transition activities.

attributes.name: external_part_number
attributes.description: Customer-facing orderable part number published in datasheets and used for commercial transactions. May differ from internal part number for marketing or legacy reasons.

attributes.name: first_silicon_date
attributes.description: Date when first fabricated silicon wafers were received from the fab for initial testing and validation. Marks start of silicon bring-up phase.

attributes.name: hts_code
attributes.description: US Harmonized Tariff Schedule classification code for customs and import duty determination. Format: 8542.31.0000 for electronic integrated circuits.

attributes.name: internal_part_number
attributes.description: Company-assigned unique part number for internal identification, tracking, and PLM integration. Primary business identifier for the IC design.

attributes.name: is_active
attributes.description: Indicates whether this catalog entry is currently active and available for business operations. False indicates archived or soft-deleted record retained for historical reference.

attributes.name: itar_controlled
attributes.business_glossary_term: International Traffic in Arms Regulations (ITAR) Controlled
attributes.description: Indicates whether the product is subject to ITAR export controls for defense-related articles. True if product requires US State Department export license for international shipment.

tag_set.value: International Traffic in Arms Regulations (ITAR) Controlled

attributes.name: last_ship_date
attributes.description: Final date when product shipments will be made. Marks complete discontinuation of the product. Typically 6-12 months after last-time-buy date to allow for manufacturing lead time.

attributes.name: last_time_buy_date
attributes.description: Final date for customers to place orders before product is discontinued. Typically 6-12 months after EOL announcement. After this date, no new orders are accepted.

attributes.name: lead_free_compliant
attributes.description: Indicates whether the product meets RoHS (Restriction of Hazardous Substances) lead-free requirements. True if compliant with EU RoHS Directive for lead-free solder and materials.

attributes.name: lifecycle_status
attributes.description: Current stage in the product lifecycle from New Product Introduction (NPI) through End of Life (EOL). Governs manufacturing, sales, and support activities. Transitions tracked in status history. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: NPI|Qualification|Production|Mature|EOL_Announced|EOL_Active|Obsolete — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this IC catalog record was last updated. Tracks data currency and change history for audit and synchronization purposes.

attributes.name: npi_phase
attributes.description: Detailed phase within NPI lifecycle for products in pre-production stages. Tracks progress from concept through design, tapeout, silicon bring-up, and qualification. Set to NA for production products. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: Concept|Design|Tapeout|Silicon_Validation|Qualification|Ramp|Production|NA — 8 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: operating_frequency_max_mhz
attributes.description: Maximum clock frequency in MHz at which the IC can reliably operate. Key performance metric for processors, SoCs, and high-speed digital circuits. Part of PPA metrics.

attributes.name: operating_voltage_max_v
attributes.description: Maximum supply voltage in volts for safe operation. Defines upper bound of operating voltage range. Exceeding this may cause device damage or reliability issues.

attributes.name: operating_voltage_min_v
attributes.description: Minimum supply voltage in volts for guaranteed operation. Defines lower bound of operating voltage range for power optimization and battery operation.

attributes.name: pin_count
attributes.description: Total number of external pins or balls on the package. Determines PCB routing complexity, package cost, and I/O capability.

attributes.name: power_max_mw
attributes.description: Maximum power consumption in milliwatts under worst-case operating conditions. Used for thermal design, power supply sizing, and system integration planning.

attributes.name: power_typical_mw
attributes.description: Typical operating power consumption in milliwatts under nominal conditions. Critical PPA metric for mobile, IoT, and battery-powered applications. Measured at specified voltage and frequency.

attributes.name: process_technology
attributes.description: Underlying semiconductor process technology architecture. Examples: CMOS (Complementary Metal-Oxide-Semiconductor), FinFET (Fin Field-Effect Transistor), GAA (Gate All Around), BiCMOS (Bipolar CMOS). [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: CMOS|FinFET|GAA|BiCMOS|SOI|GaN|SiGe — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: product_name
attributes.description: Human-readable marketing name of the IC product used in customer communications, datasheets, and sales collateral.

attributes.name: product_type
attributes.description: High-level classification of the semiconductor product type. Determines design flow, manufacturing process, and business model (silicon vs. licensable IP). [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: IC|SoC|ASIC|FPGA|IP_Core|Discrete|Memory|Analog|Mixed_Signal|RF — 10 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: production_release_date
attributes.description: Date when product was officially released to production status and made available for volume manufacturing and customer orders. Marks end of qualification phase.

attributes.name: reach_compliant
attributes.description: Indicates compliance with EU REACH (Registration, Evaluation, Authorization and Restriction of Chemicals) regulation. Confirms no Substances of Very High Concern (SVHC) above threshold.

attributes.name: rohs_compliant
attributes.description: Indicates full compliance with EU RoHS Directive restricting hazardous substances (lead, mercury, cadmium, hexavalent chromium, PBB, PBDE). Required for European market access.

attributes.name: rtl_language
attributes.description: Hardware description language used for RTL design specification. Verilog and SystemVerilog are industry standard for digital design. Set to NA for analog-only or IP-only products.

attributes.name: tapeout_date
attributes.description: Date when final GDSII design database was released to the fab for mask generation and wafer fabrication. Marks completion of design phase and start of manufacturing.

attributes.name: target_market
attributes.description: Primary market segment or application domain for which the IC is designed. Determines qualification requirements, reliability standards, and regulatory compliance needs. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: Automotive|Consumer|Industrial|Medical|Aerospace|Defense|Telecom|Computing|IoT|AI_ML — 10 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: temperature_grade
attributes.description: Temperature range classification determining qualified operating environment. Commercial: 0-70C, Industrial: -40-85C, Automotive: -40-125C, Military: -55-125C. Critical for market qualification.

attributes.name: transistor_count
attributes.description: Total number of transistors on the die. Key complexity metric for digital ICs and SoCs. Used for design effort estimation and manufacturing complexity assessment.

products.name: sku
products.description: Stock-keeping unit records representing orderable, shippable variants of catalog products. Each SKU captures the specific combination of package type, speed grade, temperature range, voltage variant, and qualification level (commercial, industrial, automotive AEC-Q100/Q101) that constitutes a distinct orderable item. Links to ic_catalog for the parent product definition and to inventory for stock tracking.

attributes.name: sku_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the stock keeping unit record. Primary key for the SKU entity representing a distinct orderable variant of a catalog product.

attributes.name: packaging_package_type_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to packaging.package_type. Business justification: SKU definition must reference the exact package type; required for Packaging Specification report.

attributes.name: pricing_currency_id
attributes.description: Foreign key to the currency for list price and standard cost.

attributes.name: primary_sku_ic_catalog_id
attributes.description: Reference to the parent product definition in the IC catalog. Links this SKU to the base product design and specification.

attributes.name: replacement_sku_id
attributes.description: Reference to the recommended replacement SKU for customers when this SKU reaches end of life. Facilitates design migration and continuity planning.

attributes.name: sales_owner_employee_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to workforce.employee. Business justification: Needed for Sales Forecasting process: each SKU is owned by a sales employee who approves forecasts and pricing.

attributes.name: to_ic_catalog_id
attributes.description: FK to product.ic_catalog.ic_catalog_id — Every SKU is an orderable variant of a catalog product. This is the most fundamental FK in the domain — without it, SKUs are orphaned from their parent product definition.

attributes.name: sku_code
attributes.description: Externally-facing unique alphanumeric code identifying this orderable SKU variant. Used in customer orders, invoices, and supply chain documentation.

attributes.name: country_of_origin
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO country code indicating the country where final manufacturing or substantial transformation occurred. Required for customs documentation.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this SKU record was first created in the system. Audit trail for data lineage and compliance.

attributes.name: customer_part_number
attributes.description: Optional customer-specific part number assigned to this SKU for custom or design-win scenarios. Facilitates customer BOM alignment.

attributes.name: eccn_code
attributes.description: US Bureau of Industry and Security (BIS) Export Administration Regulations (EAR) classification code. Determines export licensing requirements.

attributes.name: eol_announcement_date
attributes.description: Date when Product Change Notification (PCN) was issued announcing the end of life for this SKU. Triggers Last Time Buy (LTB) planning for customers.

attributes.name: halogen_free
attributes.description: Indicates whether this SKU is manufactured without halogen-containing materials (chlorine, bromine compounds). Required for certain environmental certifications.

attributes.name: hts_code
attributes.description: International customs classification code for tariff and duty calculation. Used for cross-border shipments and trade compliance.

attributes.name: introduction_date
attributes.description: Date when this SKU was first made available for customer orders. Marks the transition from NPI to Active lifecycle status.

attributes.name: itar_controlled
attributes.business_glossary_term: International Traffic in Arms Regulations (ITAR) Controlled
attributes.description: Indicates whether this SKU is subject to US ITAR export controls for defense articles. Requires special licensing and handling procedures.

tag_set.value: International Traffic in Arms Regulations (ITAR) Controlled

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this SKU record was most recently updated. Tracks data currency and change history.

attributes.name: last_ship_date
attributes.description: Final date when shipments of this SKU will be fulfilled. Marks the end of product availability and transition to discontinued status.

attributes.name: last_time_buy_date
attributes.description: Final date for customers to place orders for this SKU before discontinuation. Typically 6-12 months after EOL announcement.

attributes.name: lead_time_weeks
attributes.description: Typical manufacturing and delivery lead time in weeks from order placement to shipment. Subject to capacity allocation and supply chain conditions.

attributes.name: lifecycle_status
attributes.description: Current stage in the product lifecycle. NPI (New Product Introduction), Active (full production), Mature (stable demand), Declining (phase-out), EOL Announced (End of Life notice issued), Discontinued (no longer available).

attributes.name: list_price_usd
attributes.description: Published list price in US dollars for this SKU at 1000-unit quantity. Actual transaction prices subject to volume discounts and customer agreements.

attributes.name: manufacturer_part_number
attributes.description: Official manufacturer part number assigned to this SKU. Used for cross-reference with distributor catalogs and customer Bill of Materials (BOM).

attributes.name: minimum_order_quantity
attributes.description: Smallest quantity that can be ordered for this SKU in a single purchase order line. Driven by packaging constraints and economic order quantities.

attributes.name: moisture_sensitivity_level
attributes.description: JEDEC moisture sensitivity classification indicating required storage and handling conditions before reflow soldering. MSL1 (unlimited floor life) to MSL6 (mandatory bake before use). [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: MSL1|MSL2|MSL2a|MSL3|MSL4|MSL5|MSL5a|MSL6 — 8 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: orderable_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this SKU is currently available for new customer orders. May be false during allocation, quality holds, or phase-out periods.

attributes.name: pcn_required_flag
