attributes.description: Indicates whether any changes to this SKU specification, manufacturing process, or supply chain require formal Product Change Notification (PCN) to customers per contractual or regulatory requirements.

attributes.name: pin_count
attributes.description: Total number of electrical pins or balls on the package. Critical for PCB design and routing complexity assessment.

attributes.name: qualification_level
attributes.description: Reliability and qualification standard met by this SKU. AEC-Q100 for automotive ICs, AEC-Q101 for discrete automotive, MIL-STD-883 for military/aerospace.

attributes.name: reach_compliant
attributes.business_glossary_term: Registration Evaluation Authorization and Restriction of Chemicals (REACH) Compliant
attributes.description: Indicates whether this SKU meets EU REACH regulation requirements for chemical substance registration and disclosure.

tag_set.value: Registration Evaluation Authorization and Restriction of Chemicals (REACH) Compliant

attributes.name: rohs_compliant
attributes.description: Indicates whether this SKU meets EU RoHS directive requirements for restricted substances (lead, mercury, cadmium, hexavalent chromium, PBB, PBDE).

attributes.name: shippable_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this SKU is currently authorized for shipment. May be false during quality holds, regulatory blocks, or export restrictions.

attributes.name: speed_grade
attributes.description: Performance binning classification indicating maximum operating frequency or timing specification. Higher grades command premium pricing.

attributes.name: standard_cost_usd
attributes.description: Fully-loaded standard manufacturing cost in US dollars including wafer fabrication, assembly, test, and allocated overhead. Used for margin analysis and inventory valuation.

attributes.name: standard_pack_quantity
attributes.description: Number of units in a standard shipping container (tape and reel, tray, tube). Orders are typically placed in multiples of this quantity.

attributes.name: temperature_range
attributes.description: Qualified operating temperature range classification. Commercial (0-70C), Industrial (-40-85C), Automotive (-40-125C), Military (-55-125C), Extended (-40-105C).

attributes.name: unit_weight_grams
attributes.description: Weight of a single packaged unit in grams. Used for shipping cost calculation and logistics planning.

attributes.name: voltage_variant
attributes.description: Core or I/O voltage specification variant for this SKU. Defines power supply requirements and compatibility with system voltage rails.

products.name: family
products.description: Hierarchical grouping of related IC products into product families and sub-families (e.g., Cortex-class SoCs, automotive MCU family, RF transceiver family). Manages the multi-level product taxonomy used for roadmap planning, pricing strategy, and customer design-in targeting. Supports up to five levels of hierarchy: portfolio → family → sub-family → product → variant.

attributes.name: family_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the product family. Primary key for the product family entity.

attributes.name: base_currency_id
attributes.description: Foreign key to the base reporting currency for this product family.

attributes.name: manager_employee_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to workforce.employee. Business justification: Family Management Dashboard requires linking each product family to its responsible manager employee.

attributes.name: parent_family_id
attributes.description: Reference to the parent product family in the hierarchy. Supports multi-level taxonomy: portfolio → family → sub-family → product → variant. Null for top-level portfolio entries.

attributes.name: profit_center_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.profit_center. Business justification: Product families map to profit centers to attribute revenue and margin in financial statements.

attributes.name: active_pcn_count
attributes.description: Number of active PCNs currently in effect for this product family. Indicates ongoing changes to process, materials, or design that require customer notification and approval.

attributes.name: application_domain
attributes.description: Specific application domain or use case this product family addresses (e.g., Advanced Driver Assistance Systems, Edge AI Inference, 5G Baseband Processing). Used for technical marketing and customer solution mapping.

attributes.name: business_unit
attributes.description: Business unit or division responsible for this product family (e.g., Automotive Solutions, Mobile Computing, IoT and Embedded). Aligns with organizational structure and P&L responsibility.

attributes.name: family_code
attributes.description: Unique alphanumeric code identifying the product family in external systems and customer communications. Used in PLM, ERP, and CRM systems for product taxonomy navigation.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this product family record was first created in the system. Used for data lineage and audit trail.

attributes.name: family_description
attributes.description: Detailed description of the product family including target applications, key features, and market positioning. Used for technical documentation and sales enablement.

attributes.name: design_center_location
attributes.description: Primary design center location responsible for this product family (e.g., San Jose CA, Austin TX, Bangalore India). Used for resource planning and IP ownership tracking.

attributes.name: dfm_score
attributes.description: Design for Manufacturability score (0-100) indicating how well the product family design aligns with manufacturing best practices. Higher scores correlate with better yield and lower manufacturing risk.

attributes.name: dft_coverage_percent
attributes.description: Design for Testability coverage percentage indicating the proportion of circuit nodes accessible for ATPG (Automatic Test Pattern Generation). Higher coverage enables better defect detection during wafer test.

attributes.name: discontinuation_date
attributes.description: Date when this product family was fully discontinued and removed from active catalog. No further production or shipments after this date.

attributes.name: ear_eccn_code
attributes.business_glossary_term: Export Administration Regulations (EAR) Export Control Classification Number (ECCN) Code
attributes.description: Export Control Classification Number under US EAR regulations. Defines export licensing requirements for dual-use technology. Format: category (0-9), product group (A-E), reason for control (001-999).

tag_set.value: Export Administration Regulations (EAR) Export Control Classification Number (ECCN) Code

attributes.name: eda_tool_suite
attributes.description: Primary EDA tool suite used for design and verification of this product family (e.g., Cadence Virtuoso/Innovus, Synopsys Design Compiler/IC Compiler). Defines design methodology and tool licensing requirements.

attributes.name: eol_announcement_date
attributes.description: Date when EOL was announced to customers via PCN (Product Change Notification). Triggers LTB (Last Time Buy) planning and customer migration activities.

attributes.name: fab_site_code
attributes.description: Code identifying the primary fabrication facility for this product family. Links to fab capacity planning, process capability, and supply chain routing.

attributes.name: family_type
attributes.description: Classification of the product family by semiconductor device type. Aligns with industry standard device categories for design, fabrication, and test planning. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: IC|SoC|ASIC|FPGA|IP_Core|Discrete|Mixed_Signal — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: hierarchy_level
attributes.description: Numeric level in the product family hierarchy (1=portfolio, 2=family, 3=sub-family, 4=product, 5=variant). Supports up to five levels of product taxonomy as defined in the product domain.

attributes.name: ip_core_count
attributes.description: Number of reusable IP cores integrated into products in this family. Indicates design complexity and IP licensing requirements. Used for NRE (Non-Recurring Engineering) cost estimation.

attributes.name: itar_controlled_flag
attributes.business_glossary_term: International Traffic in Arms Regulations (ITAR) Controlled Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this product family is subject to ITAR export controls for defense-related technology. Restricts international sales and requires export licensing.

tag_set.value: International Traffic in Arms Regulations (ITAR) Controlled Flag

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this product family record was last updated. Used for change tracking and data synchronization across systems.

attributes.name: lifecycle_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle stage of the product family: Concept (early planning), NPI (New Product Introduction), Active (volume production), Mature (stable production), Phase_Out (declining), EOL (End of Life announced), Discontinued (no longer available). Drives supply chain and customer communication strategies. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: Concept|NPI|Active|Mature|Phase_Out|EOL|Discontinued — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: lithography_type
attributes.description: Photolithography technology used for patterning (EUV Extreme Ultraviolet, DUV Deep Ultraviolet). Impacts design complexity, mask costs, and fab capability requirements.

attributes.name: ltb_date
attributes.description: Final date for customers to place orders before product family is discontinued. Part of EOL process and customer lifecycle management.

attributes.name: modified_by_user
attributes.description: User ID or name of the person who last modified this product family record. Used for audit trail and data governance.

attributes.name: family_name
attributes.description: Business name of the product family (e.g., Cortex-M Series, Automotive MCU Family, RF Transceiver Family). Used in roadmap planning, marketing materials, and customer design-in targeting.

attributes.name: npi_start_date
attributes.description: Date when this product family entered NPI phase. Marks the beginning of qualification, ramp, and early customer shipments. Used for TTM (Time to Market) tracking.

attributes.name: osat_partner
attributes.business_glossary_term: Outsourced Semiconductor Assembly and Test (OSAT) Partner
attributes.description: Name of the OSAT partner responsible for packaging and final test of this product family. Critical for supply chain planning and quality management.

tag_set.value: Outsourced Semiconductor Assembly and Test (OSAT) Partner

attributes.name: package_type
attributes.description: Primary packaging technology for this product family (e.g., WLCSP Wafer-Level Chip Scale Package, BGA Ball Grid Array, QFN Quad Flat No-Lead, CoWoS Chip on Wafer on Substrate, InFO Integrated Fan-Out). Defines assembly process and thermal/electrical characteristics.

attributes.name: pdk_version
attributes.description: Version of the Process Design Kit used for this product family. PDK contains design rules, device models, and technology files required for IC design. Critical for design-to-manufacturing alignment.

attributes.name: process_node_nm
attributes.description: Semiconductor fabrication process node in nanometers (e.g., 5, 7, 14, 28). Defines the manufacturing technology generation and impacts PPA (Power Performance Area) characteristics. Critical for fab capacity planning and yield modeling.

attributes.name: process_technology
attributes.description: Transistor architecture technology used in the process node (FinFET, GAA Gate All Around, Planar, FD-SOI Fully Depleted Silicon On Insulator). Determines electrical characteristics and design rules.

attributes.name: product_line_manager
attributes.description: Name of the product line manager responsible for roadmap, positioning, and lifecycle management of this product family. Business owner for strategic decisions.

attributes.name: qualification_standard
attributes.description: Industry qualification standard this product family must meet (e.g., AEC-Q100 for automotive, MIL-STD-883 for military, JEDEC JESD47 for stress testing). Defines reliability testing requirements.

attributes.name: reach_compliant_flag
attributes.business_glossary_term: Registration Evaluation Authorization and Restriction of Chemicals (REACH) Compliant Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this product family complies with EU REACH Regulation for chemical substance safety. Required for European market sales and supply chain transparency.

tag_set.value: Registration Evaluation Authorization and Restriction of Chemicals (REACH) Compliant Flag

attributes.name: rohs_compliant_flag
attributes.business_glossary_term: Restriction of Hazardous Substances (RoHS) Compliant Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this product family is designed to comply with EU RoHS Directive restricting hazardous substances in electronic equipment. Critical for European market access.

tag_set.value: Restriction of Hazardous Substances (RoHS) Compliant Flag

attributes.name: target_market_segment
attributes.description: Primary market segment this product family targets. Used for roadmap planning, pricing strategy, and customer design-in targeting. Aligns with business unit structure and go-to-market strategy. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: Computing|Mobile|Automotive|AI_ML|IoT|Industrial|Consumer|Networking|Data_Center — 9 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: target_performance_metric
attributes.description: Key performance metric and target value for this product family (e.g., 3.5 GHz clock frequency, 100 TOPS AI performance, 10 Gbps throughput). Used for competitive analysis and roadmap planning.

attributes.name: target_power_mw
attributes.description: Target typical power consumption in milliwatts for this product family. Part of PPA (Power Performance Area) metrics used for competitive positioning and customer design-in evaluation.

attributes.name: target_yield_percent
attributes.description: Target manufacturing yield percentage (good dies per wafer) for this product family at volume production. Used for cost modeling, capacity planning, and fab performance tracking.

attributes.name: typical_die_size_mm2
attributes.description: Representative die size in square millimeters for products in this family. Used for wafer yield modeling, cost estimation, and capacity planning. Actual die sizes may vary by specific product variant.

attributes.name: volume_production_date
attributes.description: Date when this product family achieved volume production status (Active lifecycle). Indicates full manufacturing qualification and capacity availability.

products.name: process_node
products.description: Reference master for semiconductor process technology nodes (e.g., 3nm GAA, 5nm FinFET, 7nm EUV, 28nm HKMG, 180nm BCD). Captures node name, lithography generation (EUV/DUV), foundry source, PDK version, minimum feature size, metal layer count, and qualification status. Used to assign products to manufacturing process capabilities and to track node-level yield and cost baselines.

attributes.name: process_node_id
attributes.description: Primary key for process_node

attributes.name: primary_fab_site_id
attributes.description: Foreign key to the primary fabrication site for this process node.

attributes.name: process_owner_employee_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to workforce.employee. Business justification: Process Qualification tracking assigns a process engineer (owner) to each node; needed for yield and cost reports.

attributes.name: active_product_count
attributes.description: Current count of active product SKUs (ICs, SoCs, ASICs, FPGAs) assigned to this process node. Used for capacity planning and node utilization analysis.

attributes.name: baseline_yield_percent
attributes.description: Expected baseline yield percentage (good dies per wafer) for this process node under standard manufacturing conditions. Used for cost modeling and capacity planning. Confidential manufacturing metric.

attributes.name: cost_per_wafer_usd
attributes.description: Standard manufacturing cost per wafer in USD for this process node. Includes FEOL (Front End of Line), MOL (Middle of Line), and BEOL (Back End of Line) processing costs. Confidential financial data used for product costing and NRE (Non-Recurring Engineering) estimation.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this process node record was first created in the system. Audit trail for data lineage and compliance reporting.

attributes.name: cycle_time_days
attributes.description: Standard manufacturing cycle time in days from wafer start to wafer completion for this process node. Includes all FEOL, MOL, and BEOL processing steps. Critical for TTM (Time to Market) planning.

attributes.name: design_rule_complexity
attributes.description: Qualitative assessment of design rule complexity for DFM (Design for Manufacturability) and DFT (Design for Testability). Higher complexity requires more sophisticated EDA tools and longer design cycles.

attributes.name: environmental_compliance_status
attributes.description: Compliance status with environmental regulations including RoHS (Restriction of Hazardous Substances), REACH (Registration Evaluation Authorization and Restriction of Chemicals), and TSCA (Toxic Substances Control Act). Compliant indicates full adherence; Non-Compliant indicates violations; Under Review indicates pending assessment.

attributes.name: eol_announcement_date
attributes.description: Date when EOL (End of Life) was officially announced for this process node via PCN (Product Change Notification). Triggers LTB (Last Time Buy) planning for affected products. Null if node is still active.

attributes.name: export_control_classification
attributes.description: Export control classification under ITAR (International Traffic in Arms Regulations), EAR (Export Administration Regulations), or BIS (Bureau of Industry and Security) frameworks. Determines international transfer restrictions and CHIPS Act compliance requirements.

attributes.name: foundry_source
attributes.description: The semiconductor foundry or fabrication facility that provides manufacturing capability for this process node. May be internal FAB or external OSAT (Outsourced Semiconductor Assembly and Test) partner.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp of the most recent update to this process node record. Tracks data currency and change history for audit and compliance purposes.

attributes.name: lifecycle_stage
attributes.description: Current lifecycle stage of the process node. NPI (New Product Introduction) indicates initial ramp; Growth indicates volume expansion; Mature indicates stable production; Decline indicates phasing out; EOL (End of Life) indicates discontinued with LTB (Last Time Buy) notifications issued.

attributes.name: lithography_type
attributes.description: Primary lithography technology used for patterning at this process node. EUV (Extreme Ultraviolet Lithography), DUV (Deep Ultraviolet Lithography), I-Line, G-Line, or Mixed for multi-generation processes.

attributes.name: ltb_deadline_date
attributes.description: Final date for customers to place orders for products manufactured on this process node before complete discontinuation. Null if node is not in EOL status.

attributes.name: metal_layer_count
attributes.description: Total number of metal interconnect layers available in the BEOL (Back End of Line) stack for this process node. Higher counts enable more complex routing and integration.

attributes.name: minimum_feature_size_nm
attributes.description: The smallest manufacturable feature dimension in nanometers for this process node. Represents the critical dimension capability and defines the node's resolution limit.

attributes.name: modified_by_user
attributes.description: User identifier or system account that performed the last modification to this record. Supports audit trail and accountability requirements.

attributes.name: multi_patterning_layers
attributes.description: Number of critical layers requiring multi-patterning techniques (double, triple, or quad patterning) to achieve target feature sizes. Zero indicates single-exposure capability. Higher counts increase mask costs and cycle time.

attributes.name: node_code
attributes.description: Standardized alphanumeric code or identifier for the process node used across systems and documentation. Serves as the business key for external references.

attributes.name: node_generation
attributes.description: The technology generation or family classification (e.g., sub-3nm, 5nm-class, 7nm-class, mature node). Groups nodes by manufacturing era and capability tier.

attributes.name: node_name
attributes.description: Human-readable name of the semiconductor process technology node (e.g., 3nm GAA, 5nm FinFET, 7nm EUV, 28nm HKMG, 180nm BCD). This is the industry-standard designation for the manufacturing process generation.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for additional technical notes, special considerations, design guidelines, or process-specific information not captured in structured fields. Used by process engineers and design teams.

attributes.name: opc_required_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether OPC (Optical Proximity Correction) is mandatory for mask preparation at this process node. True for advanced nodes where lithography effects require computational correction.

attributes.name: pdk_release_date
attributes.description: Date when the current PDK version was officially released and made available to design teams. Tracks PDK maturity and design enablement timeline.

attributes.name: pdk_version
attributes.description: Version identifier of the PDK (Process Design Kit) that defines design rules, device models, and technology files for EDA (Electronic Design Automation) tools. Critical for DFM (Design for Manufacturability) compliance.

attributes.name: power_performance_area_rating
attributes.description: Qualitative assessment of the process node's PPA (Power Performance Area) characteristics relative to industry benchmarks. Excellent indicates best-in-class metrics; Limited indicates mature node with constrained PPA.

attributes.name: qualification_date
attributes.description: Date when the process node achieved full production qualification status and was approved for volume manufacturing. Null if not yet qualified.

attributes.name: qualification_status
attributes.description: Current qualification and readiness state of the process node for production use. Qualified indicates full production readiness; In Qualification indicates active validation; Pre-Production indicates pilot runs; Development indicates early-stage R&D; Deprecated indicates phasing out; Obsolete indicates end-of-life.

attributes.name: supported_device_types
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of device types and IP (Intellectual Property Core) categories supported by this process node (e.g., Logic, SRAM, Analog, RF, High-Voltage, IO). Defines the breadth of design capabilities.

attributes.name: technology_readiness_level
attributes.description: TRL score from 1 (basic research) to 9 (full production deployment) indicating the maturity of the process node technology. Used for R&D planning and risk assessment.

attributes.name: transistor_architecture
attributes.description: The fundamental transistor structure used in this process node. GAA (Gate All Around), FinFET (Fin Field-Effect Transistor), Planar, FDSOI (Fully Depleted Silicon On Insulator), or Other specialized architectures.

attributes.name: wafer_size_mm
attributes.description: Standard wafer diameter in millimeters supported by this process node (e.g., 300mm, 200mm, 150mm). Determines die count per wafer and manufacturing economics.

products.name: product_spec
products.description: Detailed electrical, functional, and PPA (Power-Performance-Area) specifications for each IC product at given operating condition corners. Covers operating voltage range, temperature range, I/O count, interface protocols, memory configuration, security features, functional safety ratings (ISO 26262 ASIL, IEC 61508 SIL), plus target and achieved values for dynamic power, leakage power, maximum frequency, and die area. Supports multi-corner characterization and competitive PPA benchmarking.

attributes.name: product_spec_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the product specification record. Primary key.

attributes.name: characterization_site_id
attributes.description: Foreign key to the site where product characterization was performed.

attributes.name: reference_ic_catalog_id
attributes.description: FK to product.ic_catalog.ic_catalog_id — Product specifications describe a specific IC product. Must reference the catalog entry.

attributes.name: owner_employee_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to workforce.employee. Business justification: Specification Change Control requires a spec owner employee for audit trails and compliance sign‑off.

attributes.name: primary_product_ic_catalog_id
attributes.description: Reference to the parent product (IC, SoC, ASIC, FPGA, IP core, or discrete device) for which this specification applies.

attributes.name: approval_date
attributes.description: Date when this specification was formally approved for release to manufacturing or customers.

attributes.name: approved_by
attributes.description: Name or identifier of the engineering authority who approved this specification for release.

attributes.name: automotive_grade
attributes.description: AEC-Q100 automotive qualification grade indicating temperature range and reliability requirements (Grade 0: -40°C to 150°C, Grade 1: -40°C to 125°C, Grade 2: -40°C to 105°C, Grade 3: -40°C to 85°C).

attributes.name: characterization_date
attributes.description: Date when this specification was characterized and validated through silicon testing or simulation.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this product specification record was first created in the system.

attributes.name: data_retention_years
attributes.description: Guaranteed data retention period in years for non-volatile memory components at specified temperature.

attributes.name: die_area_achieved_mm2
attributes.description: Actual measured silicon die area in square millimeters (mm²) from physical layout. Part of PPA (Power-Performance-Area) metrics.

attributes.name: die_area_target_mm2
attributes.description: Target silicon die area in square millimeters (mm²). Part of PPA (Power-Performance-Area) metrics.

attributes.name: dynamic_power_achieved_mw
attributes.description: Actual measured or characterized dynamic power consumption in milliwatts (mW) during active switching operation at nominal conditions. Part of PPA (Power-Performance-Area) metrics.

attributes.name: dynamic_power_target_mw
attributes.description: Target dynamic power consumption in milliwatts (mW) during active switching operation at nominal conditions. Part of PPA (Power-Performance-Area) metrics.

attributes.name: endurance_cycles
attributes.description: Number of program/erase cycles guaranteed for non-volatile memory components (applicable to flash, EEPROM).

attributes.name: esd_protection_level_kv
attributes.description: Electrostatic discharge protection rating in kilovolts (kV) per JEDEC standards (e.g., HBM, CDM models).

attributes.name: functional_safety_rating
attributes.description: Functional safety certification level achieved by the product. ISO 26262 ASIL (Automotive Safety Integrity Level) A through D for automotive applications; IEC 61508 SIL (Safety Integrity Level) 1 through 4 for industrial applications. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: none|iso_26262_asil_a|iso_26262_asil_b|iso_26262_asil_c|iso_26262_asil_d|iec_61508_sil_1|iec_61508_sil_2|iec_61508_sil_3|iec_61508_sil_4 — 9 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: gate_count
attributes.description: Total number of logic gates (or gate equivalents) in the design, representing design complexity.

attributes.name: interface_protocols
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of supported communication interface protocols (e.g., PCIe, USB, DDR4, MIPI, SPI, I2C, CAN, Ethernet).

attributes.name: io_count
attributes.description: Total number of input/output pins or pads available on the integrated circuit for signal connectivity.

attributes.name: leakage_power_achieved_mw
attributes.description: Actual measured or characterized static leakage power consumption in milliwatts (mW) when the circuit is idle at nominal conditions. Part of PPA (Power-Performance-Area) metrics.

attributes.name: leakage_power_target_mw
attributes.description: Target static leakage power consumption in milliwatts (mW) when the circuit is idle at nominal conditions. Part of PPA (Power-Performance-Area) metrics.

attributes.name: max_frequency_achieved_mhz
attributes.description: Actual measured or characterized maximum operating frequency in megahertz (MHz) at nominal conditions. Part of PPA (Power-Performance-Area) metrics.

attributes.name: max_frequency_target_mhz
attributes.description: Target maximum operating frequency in megahertz (MHz) at nominal conditions. Part of PPA (Power-Performance-Area) metrics.

attributes.name: memory_configuration
attributes.description: Description of on-chip memory architecture including SRAM, cache, ROM, and embedded flash sizes and organization (e.g., 256KB L2 Cache, 2MB SRAM, 512KB ROM).

attributes.name: modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this product specification record was last modified.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Additional notes, caveats, or clarifications regarding this product specification, including test conditions, measurement methodology, or known limitations.

attributes.name: operating_condition_corner
attributes.description: Process-voltage-temperature (PVT) corner at which this specification is characterized. Typical represents nominal conditions; best/worst case represent performance extremes; slow/fast combinations represent process variation corners. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: typical|best_case|worst_case|slow_slow|fast_fast|slow_fast|fast_slow — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: operating_temperature_max_c
attributes.description: Maximum junction temperature in degrees Celsius at which the product is guaranteed to function within specification.

attributes.name: operating_temperature_min_c
attributes.description: Minimum junction temperature in degrees Celsius at which the product is guaranteed to function within specification.

attributes.name: operating_voltage_max_v
attributes.description: Maximum operating voltage in volts (V) at which the product is guaranteed to function within specification.

attributes.name: operating_voltage_min_v
attributes.description: Minimum operating voltage in volts (V) at which the product is guaranteed to function within specification.

attributes.name: operating_voltage_nominal_v
attributes.description: Nominal (typical) operating voltage in volts (V) for standard operation.

attributes.name: package_type
attributes.description: Semiconductor package type and form factor (e.g., BGA, QFN, WLCSP, LGA, SOIC, DIP, CoWoS, InFO).

attributes.name: process_node_nm
attributes.description: Semiconductor fabrication process technology node in nanometers (nm), representing the minimum feature size (e.g., 7, 5, 3).

attributes.name: reach_compliant
attributes.business_glossary_term: Registration Evaluation Authorization and Restriction of Chemicals (REACH) Compliant
attributes.description: Indicates whether the product meets EU REACH regulation requirements for chemical substance registration and restriction.

tag_set.value: Registration Evaluation Authorization and Restriction of Chemicals (REACH) Compliant

attributes.name: rohs_compliant
attributes.description: Indicates whether the product meets EU RoHS directive requirements for restriction of hazardous substances (lead, mercury, cadmium, etc.).

attributes.name: security_features
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of implemented hardware security features (e.g., Secure Boot, TrustZone, AES-256, SHA-256, Hardware Root of Trust, Anti-Tamper).

attributes.name: spec_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of this product specification (Draft: under development, Preliminary: pre-silicon or early silicon, Final: production-qualified, Obsolete: superseded by newer version).

attributes.name: transistor_architecture
attributes.description: Type of transistor structure used in the process technology (Planar, FinFET, GAA - Gate All Around, Nanosheet, Nanowire).

attributes.name: transistor_count
attributes.description: Total number of transistors in the integrated circuit design.

attributes.name: version
attributes.description: Version number of this product specification, following semantic versioning (e.g., 1.0, 2.1, 3.0.1). Incremented with each specification revision.

products.name: bom
products.description: Bill of Materials header records defining the hierarchical component structure of each IC product assembly. Captures BOM revision, effectivity dates, BOM type (engineering, manufacturing, service), approval status, and overall RoHS/REACH compliance rollup. Parent entity for bom_line detail records. Integrates with PLM and ERP systems for manufacturing execution and change management.
products.reference: BOM (Bill of Materials) — SAP PP / Oracle Agile PLM

attributes.name: bom_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the bill of materials header record. Primary key for the BOM entity.

attributes.name: employee_id
attributes.description: User identifier of the engineer or manager who approved this BOM for production use. Part of the approval workflow and audit trail.

attributes.name: internal_order_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.internal_order. Business justification: Manufacturing execution links each BOM to an internal order for cost capture and settlement.

attributes.name: pricing_currency_id
attributes.description: Foreign key to the currency used for material cost pricing on this BOM.

attributes.name: primary_bom_ic_catalog_id
attributes.description: Reference to the parent IC product or assembly that this BOM defines. Links to the product master catalog.

attributes.name: supplier_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to supply.supplier. Business justification: BOMs often designate a contract manufacturer or primary supplier for the overall assembly, needed for production planning.

attributes.name: to_ic_catalog_id
attributes.description: FK to product.ic_catalog.ic_catalog_id — Each BOM defines the component structure of a specific IC product. The BOM header must reference the product it describes.

attributes.name: alternative_bom_indicator
attributes.description: Identifier for alternative BOM configurations for the same product. Used when multiple valid component combinations exist (e.g., different suppliers, different process nodes, or design variants).

attributes.name: approval_date
attributes.description: Date when this BOM was formally approved for use. Marks the transition from draft/review to approved status.

attributes.name: base_quantity
attributes.description: The quantity of the parent product that this BOM defines. Typically 1 for single-unit BOMs, but may be higher for batch or lot-based manufacturing. All component quantities in BOM lines are relative to this base quantity.

attributes.name: base_unit_of_measure
attributes.description: Unit of measure for the base quantity, such as EA (each), LOT, WAFER, or other semiconductor-specific units. Must align with product master UOM.

attributes.name: bom_number
attributes.description: Business identifier for the BOM, typically a human-readable code used across PLM and ERP systems for tracking and reference.

attributes.name: bom_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the BOM. Draft indicates work in progress, in_review indicates pending approval, approved indicates ready for use, active indicates currently in production, frozen indicates locked for manufacturing, obsolete indicates no longer valid, superseded indicates replaced by newer revision. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: draft|in_review|approved|active|frozen|obsolete|superseded — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: bom_type
attributes.description: Classification of the BOM by its intended use: engineering BOM (EBOM) for design, manufacturing BOM (MBOM) for production, service BOM for maintenance, planning BOM for forecasting, as-designed for original specification, or as-built for actual production configuration.

attributes.name: conflict_minerals_compliant_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the BOM and all its components are free from conflict minerals (tin, tantalum, tungsten, gold) sourced from conflict regions, per Dodd-Frank Act Section 1502 requirements.

attributes.name: cost_currency_code
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code for the total material cost. Typically USD for semiconductor industry but may vary by region.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this BOM record was first created in the system. Part of the audit trail for data lineage and compliance.

attributes.name: critical_material_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this BOM contains components classified as critical materials (long lead time, single source, strategic importance). Used for supply chain risk management.

attributes.name: ear_classification
attributes.description: Export Control Classification Number (ECCN) or other EAR classification for this BOM. Determines export licensing requirements and restrictions.

attributes.name: effective_end_date
attributes.description: Date after which this BOM revision is no longer valid for new production orders. Null indicates the BOM is currently active with no planned end date.

attributes.name: effective_start_date
attributes.description: Date from which this BOM revision becomes valid and can be used for manufacturing, procurement, and costing. Critical for managing engineering changes and product transitions.

attributes.name: engineering_change_order_number
attributes.description: Reference to the engineering change order that created or last modified this BOM revision. Critical for change traceability and audit compliance.

attributes.name: eol_date
attributes.description: Planned or actual end-of-life date for this BOM. After this date, the product is no longer manufactured or supported.

attributes.name: explosion_type
attributes.description: Defines how the BOM should be exploded for planning and costing: single-level shows only immediate children, multi-level shows full hierarchy, summarized shows consolidated component totals.

attributes.name: external_bom_reference
attributes.description: Original BOM identifier from the source PLM or ERP system. Maintains traceability to upstream systems and enables cross-system reconciliation.

attributes.name: itar_controlled_flag
attributes.business_glossary_term: International Traffic in Arms Regulations (ITAR) Controlled Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this BOM contains components or technology subject to ITAR export control regulations. Critical for defense and aerospace semiconductor applications.

tag_set.value: International Traffic in Arms Regulations (ITAR) Controlled Flag

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this BOM record was last updated. Tracks the most recent change for change management and audit purposes.

attributes.name: lot_size
attributes.description: Standard production lot size for which this BOM is optimized. Used in material requirements planning (MRP) and capacity planning calculations.

attributes.name: ltb_notification_date
attributes.description: Date when Last Time Buy notification was issued for this BOM, indicating the product is approaching end-of-life and customers should place final orders.

attributes.name: pcn_number
attributes.description: Product Change Notification number issued to customers when this BOM revision represents a material change to the product. Required for customer communication and approval.

attributes.name: plant_code
attributes.description: Manufacturing plant or fabrication facility (FAB) where this BOM is applicable. Different plants may have different BOMs for the same product due to process variations or equipment differences.

attributes.name: production_version
attributes.description: Production version identifier linking this BOM to a specific routing or process flow. Enables coordination between BOM and manufacturing process definitions.

attributes.name: reach_compliant_flag
attributes.business_glossary_term: Registration Evaluation Authorization and Restriction of Chemicals (REACH) Compliant Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the BOM and all its components meet REACH regulation requirements for chemical substance registration and safety. Rolled up from component-level compliance data.

tag_set.value: Registration Evaluation Authorization and Restriction of Chemicals (REACH) Compliant Flag

attributes.name: revision
attributes.description: Revision level or version of the BOM, incremented with each engineering change. Critical for change management and traceability.

attributes.name: rohs_compliant_flag
attributes.business_glossary_term: Restriction of Hazardous Substances (RoHS) Compliant Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the BOM and all its components meet RoHS directive requirements for restriction of hazardous substances. Rolled up from component-level compliance data.

tag_set.value: Restriction of Hazardous Substances (RoHS) Compliant Flag

attributes.name: scrap_percentage
attributes.description: Expected scrap or yield loss percentage at the BOM level. Used to adjust material requirements and costing. Typical semiconductor yield losses are factored here.

attributes.name: total_component_count
attributes.description: Total number of distinct component line items in this BOM. Provides quick visibility into BOM complexity without querying detail records.

attributes.name: total_material_cost
attributes.description: Rolled-up total material cost for all components in this BOM, calculated from component costs and quantities. Used for product costing and margin analysis.

attributes.name: usage
attributes.description: Intended usage context for this BOM: production for manufacturing execution, costing for financial analysis, engineering for design reference, maintenance for service operations, or sales for customer quotations.

products.name: bom_line
products.description: Line items within a product BOM, each representing a component or sub-assembly. Captures component part number, quantity per assembly, UoM, component type (die, package substrate, passive, interposer), approved substitutes, lead time, and compliance attributes (RoHS, REACH, conflict minerals). Supports multi-level BOM explosion for cost rollup and supply chain risk analysis.

attributes.name: bom_line_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the BOM line item. Primary key for the BOM line entity.

attributes.name: line_currency_id
attributes.description: Foreign key to the currency for cost on this BOM line.

attributes.name: parent_line_bom_line_id
attributes.description: Reference to the parent BOM line in a multi-level BOM structure. Null for top-level components. Enables recursive BOM explosion and indented BOM reports.

attributes.name: primary_bom_employee_id
attributes.description: The user ID or system account that created this BOM line record. Supports audit trail and accountability.

attributes.name: primary_bom_id
attributes.description: Reference to the parent BOM header that this line belongs to. Links the line item to the overall product BOM structure.

attributes.name: supplier_id
attributes.description: Reference to the primary supplier or vendor for this component. Links to supplier master data for procurement and supply chain management.

attributes.name: to_bom_header
attributes.description: FK to product.bom.bom_id — BOM lines are detail records belonging to a BOM header. This is a classic header-line pattern that is non-negotiable for BOM explosion and cost rollup.

attributes.name: to_bom_id
attributes.description: FK to product.bom.bom_id — Classic header-line relationship. BOM lines are meaningless without their parent BOM header.

attributes.name: active_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this BOM line is currently active and should be used in production planning and costing. Inactive lines are retained for historical reference but excluded from current operations.

attributes.name: approved_substitute_part_numbers
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of approved alternate or substitute part numbers that can be used in place of the primary component. Supports supply chain flexibility and risk mitigation.

attributes.name: assembly_process_code
attributes.description: Code identifying the assembly or packaging process used to integrate this component (e.g., wirebond, flip-chip, CoWoS, InFO). Links to process routing and manufacturing execution.

attributes.name: bom_level
attributes.description: The hierarchical level of this component in the multi-level BOM structure. Level 0 is the finished product, level 1 is direct sub-assembly, level 2 is sub-component of level 1, and so on. Supports BOM explosion for cost rollup and supply chain analysis.

attributes.name: component_description
attributes.description: Detailed textual description of the component, including technical specifications, material properties, and functional purpose within the assembly.

attributes.name: component_part_number
attributes.description: The unique part number or SKU of the component material used in this BOM line. May reference die, package substrate, passive components, interposer, or other materials.

attributes.name: component_type
attributes.description: Classification of the component by its functional role in the semiconductor assembly. Includes die (silicon chip), package substrate, passive components (resistors, capacitors), interposer, leadframe, wirebond, solder ball, underfill material, and mold compound. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: die|package_substrate|passive|interposer|leadframe|wirebond|solder_ball|underfill|mold_compound — 9 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: conflict_minerals_status
attributes.description: Compliance status for conflict minerals (tin, tantalum, tungsten, gold) sourcing per Dodd-Frank Act Section 1502. Tracks whether component supply chain is free from conflict region sourcing.

attributes.name: cost_currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for the standard cost. Supports multi-currency costing and global supply chain operations.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this BOM line record was first created in the system. Supports audit trail and data lineage tracking.

attributes.name: critical_component_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this component is critical to product functionality, quality, or supply chain continuity. Used for risk assessment and inventory planning.

attributes.name: ear_eccn_code
attributes.business_glossary_term: Export Administration Regulations (EAR) Export Control Classification Number (ECCN)
attributes.description: The ECCN code assigned under US Export Administration Regulations, classifying the component for export control purposes. Required for international trade compliance.

tag_set.value: Export Administration Regulations (EAR) Export Control Classification Number (ECCN)

attributes.name: effectivity_end_date
attributes.description: The date on which this BOM line becomes obsolete or is replaced. Null for currently active components. Supports phase-in/phase-out scenarios and Product Change Notification (PCN) tracking.

attributes.name: effectivity_start_date
attributes.description: The date from which this BOM line becomes effective. Supports date-based BOM versioning and engineering change management.

attributes.name: engineering_change_order_number
attributes.description: The ECO number that introduced or last modified this BOM line. Provides traceability to engineering change management processes.

attributes.name: itar_controlled_flag
attributes.business_glossary_term: International Traffic in Arms Regulations (ITAR) Controlled Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the component is subject to ITAR export controls for defense-related articles and services. Critical for aerospace and defense semiconductor applications.

tag_set.value: International Traffic in Arms Regulations (ITAR) Controlled Flag

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this BOM line record was last updated. Supports change tracking and audit trail.

attributes.name: line_number
attributes.description: Sequential line number within the parent BOM, used for ordering and referencing specific components in the assembly hierarchy.

attributes.name: make_or_buy_indicator
attributes.description: Indicates whether the component is manufactured in-house (make), procured externally (buy), or transferred from another plant (transfer). Drives procurement and production planning logic.

attributes.name: manufacturer_name
attributes.description: The name of the original equipment manufacturer (OEM) or component manufacturer. May differ from the supplier if purchased through distributors.

attributes.name: manufacturer_part_number
attributes.description: The manufacturers original part number for the component. Used for cross-referencing and supplier communication.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text notes or comments providing additional context, assembly instructions, quality requirements, or special handling instructions for this BOM line.

attributes.name: phantom_bom_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this is a phantom or transient sub-assembly that is not stocked or tracked as inventory. Phantom BOMs are exploded through during MRP but not manufactured as discrete items.

attributes.name: procurement_lead_time_days
attributes.description: The typical lead time in days required to procure this component from suppliers. Used for material requirements planning (MRP) and supply chain risk analysis.

attributes.name: quantity_per_assembly
attributes.description: The quantity of this component required to produce one unit of the parent assembly. Supports fractional quantities for materials measured by weight or volume.

attributes.name: reach_compliant_flag
attributes.business_glossary_term: Registration Evaluation Authorization and Restriction of Chemicals (REACH) Compliant Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the component complies with EU REACH Regulation for chemical substance registration and safety. Required for European market access.

tag_set.value: Registration Evaluation Authorization and Restriction of Chemicals (REACH) Compliant Flag

attributes.name: reference_designator
attributes.description: The reference designator or location identifier for the component on the physical layout or assembly drawing (e.g., U1, C23, R45). Links BOM to physical design.

attributes.name: rohs_compliant_flag
attributes.business_glossary_term: Restriction of Hazardous Substances (RoHS) Compliant Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the component complies with EU RoHS Directive restricting hazardous substances (lead, mercury, cadmium, hexavalent chromium, PBB, PBDE). Critical for regulatory compliance and market access.

tag_set.value: Restriction of Hazardous Substances (RoHS) Compliant Flag

attributes.name: scrap_factor_percent
attributes.description: Expected scrap or yield loss percentage for this component during manufacturing. Used to calculate net material requirements accounting for process losses.

attributes.name: single_source_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this component is available from only one supplier, representing a supply chain risk. Triggers dual-sourcing initiatives and risk mitigation strategies.

attributes.name: standard_cost
attributes.description: The standard unit cost of the component in the base currency. Used for BOM cost rollup, product costing, and margin analysis.

attributes.name: unit_of_measure
attributes.description: The unit in which the component quantity is expressed. Common values include EA (each), KG (kilogram), G (gram), L (liter), ML (milliliter), M (meter), MM (millimeter), WAFER, DIE. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: EA|KG|G|L|ML|M|MM|WAFER|DIE — 9 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

products.name: pcn
products.description: Product Change Notification records documenting all planned changes to product specifications, materials, manufacturing processes, or package configurations. Captures PCN number, change type (process, material, package, test), affected SKUs, change rationale, qualification plan, customer notification list, JEDEC JESD46 compliance status, and implementation timeline. Integrates with Oracle Agile PLM change management workflow.

attributes.name: pcn_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the product change notification record. Primary key.

attributes.name: change_notification_id
attributes.business_glossary_term: Agile Product Lifecycle Management (PLM) Change Order ID
attributes.description: Unique identifier from Oracle Agile PLM system linking this PCN to the formal engineering change order (ECO) or manufacturing change order (MCO) that implements the change.

tag_set.value: Agile Product Lifecycle Management (PLM) Change Order ID

attributes.name: change_owner_employee_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to workforce.employee. Business justification: PCN Change Management process mandates linking each change to the responsible engineer employee for regulatory reporting.

attributes.name: originating_site_id
attributes.description: Foreign key to the site where the product change notification originated.

attributes.name: primary_pcn_ic_catalog_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to product.ic_catalog. Business justification: pcn records are change notifications for specific IC products; linking pcn to ic_catalog provides parent relationship and enables traceability.

attributes.name: to_ic_catalog_id
attributes.description: FK to product.ic_catalog.ic_catalog_id — Product Change Notifications affect specific products. Must reference the affected catalog entry (may be multi-valued via junction).

attributes.name: affected_customer_count
attributes.description: Total number of customers who have active orders, design-ins, or inventory of the affected products and must be notified of the change.

attributes.name: affected_product_list
attributes.description: Comma-separated or structured list of product SKUs, part numbers, or device families impacted by this change. May reference specific die revisions, package codes, or product lines.

attributes.name: approval_date
attributes.description: Date when the PCN received final internal approval from engineering, quality, and business stakeholders to proceed with customer notification and implementation.

attributes.name: approved_by_name
attributes.description: Name of the executive or manager who provided final approval for the PCN, typically a VP of Engineering, Quality Director, or Product Line Manager.

attributes.name: automotive_qualification_required_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the change requires re-qualification under automotive quality standards such as IATF 16949 or AEC-Q100/Q200, applicable when affected products are used in automotive applications.

attributes.name: change_category
attributes.description: Severity classification of the change: major (requires customer qualification), minor (limited impact, may require notification), or notification_only (informational, no action required).

attributes.name: change_description
attributes.description: Detailed technical description of the product change, including what is being modified, the scope of the change, and technical specifications affected.

attributes.name: change_owner_email
attributes.description: Email address of the change owner for customer inquiries and internal coordination regarding the PCN.

attributes.name: change_owner_name
attributes.description: Name of the engineer, product manager, or business owner responsible for driving the PCN through approval, customer notification, and implementation.

attributes.name: change_rationale
attributes.description: Business and technical justification for the change, including reasons such as cost reduction, yield improvement, supply chain continuity, obsolescence mitigation, or performance enhancement.

attributes.name: change_title
attributes.description: Brief descriptive title summarizing the nature of the product change for quick identification.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the PCN record was first created in the system, marking the initiation of the change notification process.

attributes.name: customer_approval_count
attributes.description: Number of customers who explicitly approved or acknowledged acceptance of the proposed change.

attributes.name: customer_approval_required_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether explicit customer approval or acknowledgment is required before implementing the change, typically true for major changes affecting form, fit, or function.

attributes.name: customer_objection_count
attributes.description: Number of customers who formally objected to or raised concerns about the proposed change during the notification period.

attributes.name: customer_response_deadline
attributes.description: Date by which customers must provide feedback, objections, or approval for the proposed change. After this date, silence may be interpreted as acceptance per JEDEC guidelines.

attributes.name: effective_date
attributes.description: Date when the product change will be implemented in production and new product shipments will reflect the change. Typically allows customer qualification time after notification.

attributes.name: electrical_impact_assessment
attributes.description: Engineering assessment of how the change affects electrical characteristics such as timing, power consumption, signal integrity, or parametric specifications.

attributes.name: environmental_compliance_impact
attributes.description: Assessment of whether the change affects environmental compliance status, including RoHS, REACH, halogen-free, or conflict minerals declarations.

attributes.name: form_fit_function_impact
attributes.description: Classification of whether the change affects form (physical dimensions/appearance), fit (mechanical interchangeability), function (electrical/performance characteristics), multiple aspects, or none. Critical for customer qualification scope determination.

attributes.name: implementation_date
attributes.description: Actual date when the product change was implemented in production and new shipments began reflecting the change. May differ from planned effective_date.

attributes.name: jedec_compliance_status
attributes.business_glossary_term: Joint Electron Device Engineering Council (JEDEC) Compliance Status
attributes.description: Indicates whether the PCN process and content comply with JEDEC JESD46 standard requirements for product change notification in the semiconductor industry.

tag_set.value: Joint Electron Device Engineering Council (JEDEC) Compliance Status

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp of the most recent update to the PCN record, tracking changes to status, dates, or other attributes throughout the PCN lifecycle.

attributes.name: last_ship_date
attributes.description: Final date by which product manufactured under the old specification will be shipped to customers. Marks the end of old-spec product availability.

attributes.name: last_time_buy_date
attributes.description: Final date by which customers can place orders for product manufactured under the old specification before the change takes effect. Applicable for major changes requiring customer transition planning.

attributes.name: new_specification
attributes.description: Technical specification, process parameters, material composition, or design revision identifier for the product after the change. Defines the target state.

attributes.name: notification_date
attributes.description: Date when the PCN was officially communicated to affected customers, typically via email, customer portal, or formal letter.

attributes.name: old_specification
attributes.description: Technical specification, process parameters, material composition, or design revision identifier for the product before the change. Provides baseline for comparison.

attributes.name: pcn_number
attributes.description: Externally-known unique business identifier for the PCN, typically formatted as PCN-YYYYNNNN. Used for customer communication and tracking.

attributes.name: pcn_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the PCN: draft (being prepared), pending_approval (awaiting internal review), approved (ready for customer notification), customer_notification_sent (communicated to affected customers), in_qualification (customers testing), implemented (change is live in production), cancelled (change abandoned), or superseded (replaced by newer PCN). [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: draft|pending_approval|approved|customer_notification_sent|in_qualification|implemented|cancelled|superseded — 8 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: pcn_type
attributes.description: Classification of the change being notified: process change (fab process modification), material change (substrate or compound change), package change (assembly or form factor), test change (ATE or test flow), design change (die revision), or specification change (datasheet update).

attributes.name: qualification_completion_date
attributes.description: Date when internal qualification testing was successfully completed and the change was validated for production release.

attributes.name: qualification_plan
attributes.description: Description of the testing and validation activities required to qualify the changed product, including reliability tests, electrical characterization, and compatibility verification per JEDEC standards.

attributes.name: qualification_status
attributes.description: Current state of internal qualification testing for the changed product: not_started, in_progress, completed (passed all tests), failed (did not meet criteria), or waived (qualification not required for this change category).

attributes.name: related_pcn_numbers
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of related PCN numbers that are associated with this change, such as dependent changes, parallel changes to related products, or prerequisite notifications.

attributes.name: reliability_impact_assessment
attributes.description: Engineering assessment of how the change affects product reliability, including MTBF, failure modes, stress test results, and long-term performance predictions.

attributes.name: sample_request_deadline
attributes.description: Last date by which customers can request evaluation samples of the changed product for their own qualification testing.

attributes.name: samples_available_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether product samples manufactured with the new change are available for customer evaluation and qualification testing.

attributes.name: superseded_by_pcn_number
attributes.business_glossary_term: Superseded By Product Change Notification (PCN) Number
attributes.description: PCN number that replaces or supersedes this PCN, used when a newer change notification obsoletes or modifies a previous one.

tag_set.value: Superseded By Product Change Notification (PCN) Number

products.name: product_ltb_notification
products.description: Last Time Buy notification records issued when a product reaches EOL, specifying the final order date, final shipment date, recommended replacement product, minimum order quantity for LTB, and customer acknowledgment tracking. Manages the formal LTB process per JEDEC JESD48 standard, ensuring customers have adequate notice to qualify replacement parts or place bridge inventory orders.
products.reference: LTB (Last Time Buy) Notification — JEDEC JESD48

attributes.name: product_ltb_notification_id
attributes.business_glossary_term: Product Last Time Buy (LTB) Notification ID
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the Last Time Buy notification record. Primary key for the product LTB notification entity.

tag_set.value: Product Last Time Buy (LTB) Notification ID

attributes.name: ltb_owner_employee_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to workforce.employee. Business justification: LTB Notification handling is assigned to a product manager employee; required for LTB revenue tracking.

attributes.name: primary_replacement_product_ic_catalog_id
attributes.description: Reference to the recommended replacement product in the product catalog. Identifies the form-fit-function equivalent or next-generation product that customers should transition to. May be null if no direct replacement exists.

attributes.name: revenue_currency_id
attributes.description: Foreign key to the currency for LTB revenue figures.

attributes.name: actual_ltb_revenue
attributes.description: Actual revenue realized from LTB orders. Captured after the final order date to measure forecast accuracy and assess the financial impact of the product discontinuance.

attributes.name: actual_ltb_units
attributes.description: Actual unit volume of LTB orders received. Captured after the final order date to measure demand forecast accuracy and assess inventory disposition requirements.

attributes.name: approved_by
attributes.description: Name or identifier of the business authority who approved the LTB notification for issuance. Typically a product line manager, business unit director, or discontinuance review board representative.

attributes.name: approved_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the LTB notification was approved for issuance. Establishes the audit trail for discontinuance governance and compliance with internal approval processes.

attributes.name: cancellation_reason
attributes.description: Explanation of why the LTB notification was cancelled. Provides business context for discontinuance reversals, such as renewed customer demand, supply chain recovery, or strategic product portfolio changes.

attributes.name: cancelled_by
attributes.description: Name or identifier of the business authority who cancelled the LTB notification. Populated only if the notification is cancelled before completion, typically due to business strategy changes or supply chain recovery.

attributes.name: cancelled_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the LTB notification was cancelled. Establishes the audit trail for notification lifecycle changes and supports customer communication of discontinuance reversals.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the LTB notification record was first created in the system. Establishes the audit trail for notification lifecycle and supports compliance with record retention requirements.

attributes.name: customer_acknowledgment_deadline
attributes.description: Date by which customers must acknowledge the LTB notification if acknowledgment is required. Ensures timely customer response and enables proactive follow-up for non-responsive accounts.

attributes.name: customer_acknowledgment_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether customers are required to formally acknowledge receipt and understanding of the LTB notification. True for high-value or strategic customers; false for standard commercial notifications.

attributes.name: customer_ltb_notification_id
attributes.description: SSOT FK reference to canonical customer.customer_ltb_notification; this table is a secondary view and must not duplicate master data.

attributes.name: discontinuance_reason_code
attributes.description: Primary business reason for product discontinuance and LTB issuance. Categorizes the strategic, operational, or compliance driver behind the End of Life (EOL) decision.

attributes.name: discontinuance_reason_description
attributes.description: Detailed explanation of the business rationale for product discontinuance. Provides context for customers and internal stakeholders on the strategic or operational factors driving the EOL decision.

attributes.name: estimated_ltb_revenue
attributes.description: Projected revenue from LTB orders during the notification period. Used for financial planning, production capacity allocation, and business impact assessment of the product discontinuance.

attributes.name: estimated_ltb_units
attributes.description: Projected unit volume of LTB orders. Used for production planning, wafer start authorization, and supply chain capacity allocation during the LTB period.

attributes.name: final_order_date
attributes.description: Last date on which customers may place orders for the discontinued product. After this date, no new orders will be accepted. Critical milestone for customers planning bridge inventory or transitioning to replacement products.

attributes.name: final_shipment_date
attributes.description: Last date on which the discontinued product will be shipped to customers. Represents the absolute end of product availability and marks the transition to replacement product or alternative sourcing.

attributes.name: issued_by
attributes.description: Name or identifier of the individual who issued the LTB notification to customers. Typically a product marketing manager, customer communications specialist, or PCN coordinator.

attributes.name: issued_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the LTB notification was issued to customers. Marks the official start of the notification period and triggers customer acknowledgment and ordering timelines.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the LTB notification record was last updated. Tracks the most recent change to the notification and supports audit trail requirements for data lineage and compliance.

attributes.name: maximum_order_quantity
attributes.description: Maximum quantity that may be ordered during the LTB period. Caps total available inventory to prevent over-commitment and ensure fair allocation across customer base.

attributes.name: minimum_order_quantity
attributes.description: Minimum quantity that must be ordered during the LTB period. Ensures economically viable production runs for discontinued products and helps customers plan bridge inventory requirements.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-form text field for additional context, special instructions, or customer-specific considerations related to the LTB notification. Supports operational flexibility and captures information not covered by structured fields.

attributes.name: notification_channel
attributes.description: Primary communication channel used to deliver the LTB notification to customers. Tracks the method of notification delivery for compliance and audit purposes.

attributes.name: notification_issue_date
attributes.description: Date when the LTB notification was formally issued to customers. Marks the start of the official notification period and triggers customer acknowledgment requirements per JEDEC JESD48 standard.

attributes.name: notification_language
attributes.description: Primary language in which the LTB notification was issued. Supports multi-lingual customer communication requirements and regulatory compliance in international markets.

attributes.name: notification_number
attributes.description: Business identifier for the LTB notification. Externally communicated reference number used in customer correspondence and Product Change Notifications (PCN).

attributes.name: notification_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the LTB notification. Tracks progression from draft through issuance, customer acknowledgment, and final expiration or cancellation.

attributes.name: notification_type
attributes.description: Classification of the LTB notification based on timeline and business circumstances. Standard LTB follows normal discontinuance timelines; expedited LTB has shortened notice periods; extended LTB provides longer lead times; emergency discontinuance addresses immediate supply chain or compliance issues.

attributes.name: pcn_number
attributes.description: Reference to the associated Product Change Notification that formally communicates the discontinuance to customers. Links the LTB notification to the broader PCN process for traceability.

attributes.name: regulatory_approval_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether the product discontinuance requires regulatory approval or notification in specific jurisdictions. True for products subject to ITAR, EAR, or industry-specific regulations; false for standard commercial products.

attributes.name: regulatory_approval_status
attributes.description: Current status of regulatory approval for the product discontinuance. Tracks compliance with export control, defense, or industry-specific regulations that govern product lifecycle changes.

attributes.name: replacement_product_qualification_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether the replacement product requires customer qualification and design-in activities. True if the replacement is not a drop-in substitute and requires engineering validation; false if it is form-fit-function compatible.

attributes.name: ssot_customer_ltb_notification_id
attributes.description: SSOT reference to canonical customer.customer_ltb_notification (de-duplicates cross-domain concept).

attributes.name: total_customers_acknowledged
attributes.description: Count of customers who have formally acknowledged the LTB notification. Enables tracking of acknowledgment completion rate and identification of customers requiring follow-up.

attributes.name: total_customers_notified
attributes.description: Count of unique customers who received the LTB notification. Tracks the breadth of customer impact and supports acknowledgment tracking and follow-up activities.

products.name: product_ip_core
products.description: Intellectual Property core catalog for reusable silicon IP blocks available for integration into SoC and ASIC designs, including hard IPs (PHYs, memory compilers, analog blocks) and soft IPs (processor cores, interface controllers, security engines). Captures IP name, version, process node compatibility, licensing model (royalty-free, per-unit royalty, NRE), PPA characteristics, verification status, and EDA tool compatibility. References SSOT: design.design_ip_core

attributes.name: product_ip_core_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the IP core product record. Primary key for the IP core catalog.

attributes.name: cost_currency_id
attributes.description: Foreign key to the currency for NRE and royalty costs.

attributes.name: eccn_classification_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to compliance.eccn_classification. Business justification: IP cores require ECCN classification for export; linking each core to its classification supports export license generation.

attributes.name: ic_catalog_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to product.ic_catalog. Business justification: product_ip_core represents reusable IP blocks that belong to a catalog product; adding ic_catalog_id creates the required parent link.

attributes.name: owner_employee_id
attributes.business_glossary_term: Ip Core Owner Employee Id (Foreign Key)
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to workforce.employee. Business justification: IP Core licensing and support are managed by a designated employee; needed for royalty and compliance reporting.

tag_set.value: Ip Core Owner Employee Id (Foreign Key)

attributes.name: profit_center_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.profit_center. Business justification: IP core licensing revenue is tracked against a profit center for financial reporting.

attributes.name: supplier_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to supply.supplier. Business justification: IP core licensing management records the vendor (supplier) that provides each IP core for royalty and support purposes.

attributes.name: area_mm2
attributes.description: Physical silicon area occupied by the IP core in square millimeters. Part of PPA (Power, Performance, Area) metrics.

attributes.name: compliance_certifications
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of industry compliance certifications the IP core meets (e.g., ISO 26262 for automotive, DO-254 for aerospace, FIPS 140-2 for cryptography).

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the IP core record was first created in the system.

attributes.name: design_for_testability
attributes.description: Indicates whether the IP core includes DFT features such as scan chains, BIST (Built-In Self-Test), or ATPG support.

attributes.name: design_ip_core_id
attributes.description: SSOT FK reference to canonical design.design_ip_core; this table is a secondary view and must not duplicate master data.

attributes.name: documentation_package
attributes.description: Reference to the documentation package location or identifier (e.g., datasheet, integration guide, verification plan, user manual).

attributes.name: eda_tool_compatibility
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of EDA tools that support this IP core (e.g., Cadence Virtuoso, Synopsys Design Compiler, Mentor Graphics).

attributes.name: eol_date
attributes.description: Planned or actual end-of-life date for the IP core. After this date, the IP is no longer supported for new designs.

attributes.name: errata_notes
attributes.description: Known issues, limitations, or workarounds for the IP core. Reference to errata document or summary of key issues.

attributes.name: foundry_compatibility
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of foundries whose PDKs this IP core is compatible with (e.g., TSMC, Samsung, GlobalFoundries, Intel).

attributes.name: gate_count
attributes.description: Approximate number of logic gates in the IP core. Used for complexity estimation and area prediction.

attributes.name: integration_complexity
attributes.description: Estimated complexity level for integrating the IP core into an SoC or ASIC design: low (plug-and-play), medium (moderate customization), high (significant integration effort), very high (extensive customization required).

attributes.name: interface_protocol
attributes.description: Standard interface protocol(s) supported by the IP core (e.g., AXI4, AHB, APB, PCIe Gen4, USB 3.2, DDR5). Comma-separated if multiple.

attributes.name: ip_category
