attributes.description: Functional classification of the IP core: processor cores, memory controllers, interface controllers (USB, PCIe, Ethernet), analog blocks, PHYs, security engines, DSP blocks, or hardware accelerators. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: processor|memory_controller|interface|analog|phy|security|dsp|accelerator — 8 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: ip_core_code
attributes.description: Unique business identifier or SKU for the IP core used in PLM and EDA systems.

attributes.name: ip_core_name
attributes.description: Human-readable name of the IP core block (e.g., ARM Cortex-A78, USB 3.2 PHY, DDR5 Memory Controller).

attributes.name: ip_core_to_node
attributes.description: FK to product.product_process_node.product_process_node_id — IP cores have process node compatibility. Must reference which nodes the IP is qualified for.

attributes.name: ip_type
attributes.description: Classification of IP core implementation: hard IP (physical layout fixed), soft IP (RTL synthesizable), or firm IP (netlist with some physical constraints).

attributes.name: licensing_model
attributes.description: Business model for IP core licensing: royalty-free (one-time fee), per-unit royalty (fee per chip manufactured), NRE upfront (non-recurring engineering fee), subscription (annual license), or hybrid (combination).

attributes.name: lifecycle_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the IP core: development (under design), verification (testing phase), production (available for integration), mature (stable and widely used), deprecated (not recommended for new designs), or EOL (end of life).

attributes.name: low_power_modes
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of low-power operating modes supported by the IP core (e.g., sleep, retention, power gating, clock gating).

attributes.name: ltb_notification_date
attributes.description: Date when the last time buy notification was issued for the IP core, alerting customers to place final orders before discontinuation.

attributes.name: modified_by
attributes.description: User identifier or name of the person who last modified the IP core record.

attributes.name: modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the IP core record was last modified.

attributes.name: nre_cost_usd

attributes.description: One-time non-recurring engineering cost in USD for licensing and integrating the IP core into a design.

attributes.name: operating_frequency_mhz
attributes.description: Maximum operating frequency of the IP core in megahertz.

attributes.name: operating_voltage_v
attributes.description: Nominal operating voltage for the IP core in volts (e.g., 0.8V, 1.2V).

attributes.name: per_unit_royalty_usd

attributes.description: Royalty fee in USD charged per manufactured chip that incorporates this IP core. Null if licensing model is royalty-free.

attributes.name: performance_metric
attributes.description: Key performance indicator for the IP core (e.g., clock frequency in MHz, throughput in Gbps, DMIPS for processors). Part of PPA metrics.

attributes.name: power_consumption_mw
attributes.description: Typical power consumption of the IP core in milliwatts under nominal operating conditions. Part of PPA (Power, Performance, Area) metrics.

attributes.name: process_node_compatibility
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of process nodes (technology nodes) that this IP core supports (e.g., 7nm, 5nm, 3nm). Indicates which fabrication processes the IP can be manufactured on.

attributes.name: reference_designs
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of reference design identifiers or links that demonstrate the IP core integration and usage.

attributes.name: release_date
attributes.description: Date when this version of the IP core was officially released for production use.

attributes.name: rtl_language
attributes.description: Hardware description language used for the IP core RTL: Verilog, VHDL, SystemVerilog, Chisel, or not applicable (for hard IPs without RTL).

attributes.name: security_features

attributes.name: support_contact
attributes.description: Contact information for technical support and integration assistance for the IP core.

attributes.name: temperature_range_c
attributes.description: Operating temperature range for the IP core in Celsius (e.g., -40 to 125). Format: min to max.

attributes.name: vendor_name
attributes.description: Name of the IP core vendor or provider (e.g., ARM, Synopsys, Cadence, internal design team).

attributes.name: verification_status
attributes.description: Current verification state of the IP core: not started, in progress (under verification), verified (passed all tests), or silicon proven (validated in actual silicon).

attributes.name: version
attributes.description: Version identifier of the IP core (e.g., v2.1, r1p3). Tracks revisions and updates to the IP block.

attributes.name: created_by
attributes.description: User identifier or name of the person who created the IP core record.

products.name: product_qualification_program
products.description: Product qualification program records defining the reliability and environmental test plan required before production release gate. Captures qualification standard (JEDEC JESD47, AEC-Q100/Q101/Q104, MIL-STD-883, customer-specific), test matrix, sample plan, stress conditions (HTOL, HAST, TC, ESD, latch-up), duration, pass/fail criteria, qualification status, completion date, and any deviations or waivers granted. Gate-keeps product lifecycle transition from NPI to volume production.

attributes.name: product_qualification_program_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the product qualification program record. Primary key.

attributes.name: cost_center_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.cost_center. Business justification: Qualification programs have dedicated budgets; linking to a cost center enables expense tracking.

attributes.name: ic_catalog_id
attributes.description: Reference to the semiconductor product (IC, SoC, ASIC, FPGA, IP core, or discrete device) undergoing qualification testing.

attributes.name: program_manager_employee_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to workforce.employee. Business justification: Qualification Program execution is overseen by a program manager employee; required for qualification status dashboards.

attributes.name: qualification_site_id
attributes.description: Foreign key to the site where the qualification program is conducted.

attributes.name: supplier_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to supply.supplier. Business justification: Supplier Qualification Program tracks qualification status, audits, and risk for each supplier associated with a product line.

attributes.name: acceptance_criteria
attributes.description: Pass/fail criteria for the qualification program, typically expressed as maximum allowable failure rate or zero failures for critical parameters.

attributes.name: actual_completion_date
attributes.description: Actual date when qualification program was completed and final report approved. Gate-keeps product lifecycle transition from NPI to volume production.

attributes.name: actual_start_date
attributes.description: Actual date when qualification testing activities commenced.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the qualification program record was first created in the system.

attributes.name: deviation_description
attributes.description: Detailed description of any approved deviations from the standard qualification test plan, including technical justification and risk assessment.

attributes.name: deviation_granted
attributes.description: Indicates whether any deviations from the standard qualification test matrix were granted by engineering review board.

attributes.name: esd_cdm_enabled
attributes.business_glossary_term: Electrostatic Discharge (ESD) Charged Device Model (CDM) Test Enabled
attributes.description: Indicates whether ESD Charged Device Model stress test is included in the qualification plan. CDM simulates discharge from a charged device to ground.

tag_set.value: Electrostatic Discharge (ESD) Charged Device Model (CDM) Test Enabled

attributes.name: esd_cdm_voltage_v
attributes.description: Target voltage level in volts for ESD Charged Device Model testing, typically 500V minimum for Class C2 devices.

attributes.name: esd_hbm_enabled
attributes.business_glossary_term: Electrostatic Discharge (ESD) Human Body Model (HBM) Test Enabled
attributes.description: Indicates whether ESD Human Body Model stress test is included in the qualification plan. HBM simulates discharge from human contact.

tag_set.value: Electrostatic Discharge (ESD) Human Body Model (HBM) Test Enabled

attributes.name: esd_hbm_voltage_v
attributes.description: Target voltage level in volts for ESD Human Body Model testing, typically 2000V minimum for Class 2 devices.

attributes.name: failure_threshold_ppm
attributes.description: Maximum allowable failure rate expressed in Defective Parts Per Million (DPPM) for the qualification program to pass.

attributes.name: hast_duration_hours
attributes.description: Duration in hours for Highly Accelerated Stress Test, typically 96 to 264 hours.

attributes.name: hast_enabled
attributes.description: Indicates whether Highly Accelerated Stress Test is included in the qualification plan. HAST combines high temperature, high humidity, and voltage bias to accelerate corrosion and moisture-related failures.

attributes.name: hast_relative_humidity_pct
attributes.description: Relative humidity percentage for Highly Accelerated Stress Test, typically 85% RH.

attributes.name: hast_temperature_c
attributes.description: Temperature in degrees Celsius for Highly Accelerated Stress Test, typically 110°C to 130°C.

attributes.name: htol_duration_hours
attributes.description: Duration in hours for High Temperature Operating Life stress test, typically 1000 hours minimum per JEDEC standards.

attributes.name: htol_enabled
attributes.business_glossary_term: High Temperature Operating Life (HTOL) Test Enabled
attributes.description: Indicates whether High Temperature Operating Life stress test is included in the qualification plan. HTOL accelerates time-dependent failure mechanisms under elevated temperature and voltage bias.

tag_set.value: High Temperature Operating Life (HTOL) Test Enabled

attributes.name: htol_temperature_c
attributes.description: Junction temperature in degrees Celsius for High Temperature Operating Life stress testing, typically 125°C to 150°C.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the qualification program record was last updated.

attributes.name: latchup_current_ma
attributes.description: Trigger current in milliamperes for latch-up testing, typically 100mA minimum per JEDEC standards.

attributes.name: latchup_enabled
attributes.description: Indicates whether latch-up susceptibility test is included in the qualification plan. Latch-up is a CMOS failure mode where parasitic thyristor structures create low-impedance paths.

attributes.name: lot_count
attributes.description: Number of independent fabrication lots from which qualification samples must be drawn to ensure manufacturing process representativeness.

attributes.name: planned_completion_date
attributes.description: Planned date for completion of all qualification testing and final report approval.

attributes.name: planned_start_date
attributes.description: Planned date for initiation of qualification testing activities.

attributes.name: program_code
attributes.description: Business identifier for the qualification program, typically combining product family code and qualification standard abbreviation.

attributes.name: program_name
attributes.description: Descriptive name of the qualification program including product identifier and target application domain.

attributes.name: program_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the qualification program. Gate-keeps product lifecycle transition from NPI to volume production.

attributes.name: qualification_standard
attributes.description: Industry or customer-specific reliability qualification standard governing the test plan. JEDEC JESD47 for general semiconductor reliability, AEC-Q100 for automotive ICs, AEC-Q101 for discrete semiconductors, AEC-Q104 for multi-chip modules, MIL-STD-883 for military/aerospace, or customer-specific requirements. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: JEDEC_JESD47|AEC_Q100|AEC_Q101|AEC_Q104|MIL_STD_883|CUSTOMER_SPECIFIC|IEC_60749|IEC_62196 — 8 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: qualification_type
attributes.description: Category of qualification program based on trigger event: new product introduction, process node change, package technology change, supply chain change, periodic requalification, or extended temperature range qualification.

attributes.name: responsible_engineer
attributes.description: Name of the reliability engineer responsible for planning, executing, and reporting the qualification program.

attributes.name: sample_size
attributes.description: Total number of device units required for the complete qualification test plan across all test conditions and lots.

attributes.name: tc_cycle_count
attributes.description: Number of temperature cycles for Temperature Cycling test, typically 500 to 1000 cycles minimum.

attributes.name: tc_enabled
attributes.description: Indicates whether Temperature Cycling stress test is included in the qualification plan. TC accelerates thermal fatigue failures due to coefficient of thermal expansion mismatch.

attributes.name: tc_max_temperature_c
attributes.description: Maximum temperature in degrees Celsius for Temperature Cycling test, typically 125°C to 150°C.

attributes.name: tc_min_temperature_c
attributes.description: Minimum temperature in degrees Celsius for Temperature Cycling test, typically -55°C or -65°C.

attributes.name: test_matrix_version
attributes.description: Version identifier of the qualification test matrix document defining the complete set of reliability and environmental stress tests, sample sizes, and acceptance criteria.

attributes.name: waiver_granted
attributes.description: Indicates whether a waiver was granted to allow production release despite qualification test failures or incomplete testing.

products.name: errata
products.description: Product errata records documenting known silicon bugs, functional deviations, and workarounds for released IC products. Captures errata ID, affected product and revision, silicon stepping, errata title, functional impact description, affected use cases, workaround availability, fix target (next silicon revision or software workaround), customer disclosure status, and severity classification. Critical for customer technical support and design-in risk management.

attributes.name: errata_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the product errata record. Primary key.

attributes.name: account_id
attributes.description: Reference to the customer who first reported this errata, if discovered externally. Null if discovered internally. Used for customer relationship management (CRM) and design-win tracking.

attributes.name: discovered_at_site_id
attributes.description: Foreign key to the site where the errata was discovered.

attributes.name: engineering_owner_employee_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to workforce.employee. Business justification: Errata tracking assigns an engineering owner employee for root‑cause analysis and customer communication.

attributes.name: primary_errata_ic_catalog_id
attributes.description: Reference to the affected integrated circuit (IC) product, system on chip (SoC), application-specific integrated circuit (ASIC), or field-programmable gate array (FPGA) product.

attributes.name: test_case_id
attributes.description: Reference to the automatic test equipment (ATE) test pattern, design verification plan test case, or simulation run that reproduces the errata. Used for regression testing and validation.

attributes.name: to_ic_catalog_id
attributes.description: FK to product.ic_catalog.ic_catalog_id — Errata document bugs in specific IC products. Must reference the affected product and revision.

attributes.name: affected_revisions
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of all silicon revisions affected by this errata (e.g., A0,A1,B0). Used to determine scope of customer impact.

attributes.name: affected_use_cases
attributes.description: Description of customer application scenarios or operating modes impacted by the errata (e.g., high-speed PCIe Gen4 operation, concurrent multi-channel DMA, low-power sleep modes).

attributes.name: business_impact
attributes.description: Assessment of commercial and operational impact including potential revenue risk, customer satisfaction impact, warranty exposure, and time to market (TTM) implications.

attributes.name: closure_reason
attributes.description: Reason for closing the errata record. Fixed in Silicon: corrected in new revision; Fixed in Software: resolved via patch; Workaround Sufficient: mitigation acceptable; Product EOL: end-of-life product; Not Reproducible: cannot verify; Working as Designed: not a defect.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this errata record was first created in the product lifecycle management (PLM) system. Used for audit trail and lifecycle tracking.

attributes.name: customer_disclosure_status
attributes.description: Status of customer communication regarding this errata. Not Disclosed: internal only; Pending Approval: awaiting management approval; Disclosed NDA: shared under non-disclosure agreement; Disclosed Public: published in public errata sheet.

attributes.name: disclosure_date
attributes.description: Date when the errata was first communicated to customers via product change notification (PCN), errata sheet update, or technical advisory. Null if not yet disclosed.

attributes.name: discovered_by
attributes.description: Source or method by which the errata was discovered. Internal Validation: found during wafer testing or quality assurance; Customer Report: reported by design-in customer; Field Failure: observed in production deployment; Design Verification: identified during design for testability (DFT) or automatic test pattern generation (ATPG).

attributes.name: discovered_date
attributes.description: Date when the silicon bug or functional deviation was first identified, either during internal validation, customer testing, or field deployment.

attributes.name: engineering_owner
attributes.description: Name or identifier of the design engineer or engineering team responsible for investigating and resolving this errata. Used for accountability and workload tracking.

attributes.name: errata_number
attributes.description: Business identifier for the errata record, typically formatted as product-family prefix followed by sequential number (e.g., SOC-001234, FPGA-000567). Used in customer communications and product change notifications (PCN).

attributes.name: errata_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the errata record. Draft: initial documentation; Under Review: engineering validation; Confirmed: verified silicon bug; Disclosed: communicated to customers; Resolved: fix available; Closed: no longer applicable.

attributes.name: fix_plan
attributes.description: Planned resolution approach for the errata. Next Silicon Revision: will be corrected in next tapeout; Software Patch: addressable via firmware/driver update; No Fix Planned: low priority or end-of-life (EOL) product; Under Evaluation: fix strategy being assessed.

attributes.name: fix_target_revision
attributes.description: Silicon stepping or revision where the errata will be corrected (e.g., C0, D1). Null if fix is software-only or no fix planned.

attributes.name: functional_block
attributes.description: Name of the intellectual property (IP) core, register transfer level (RTL) module, or functional block where the errata occurs (e.g., PCIe Controller, DDR PHY, CPU Core, DMA Engine).

attributes.name: impacted_customer_count
attributes.description: Estimated or actual number of customers affected by this errata based on product shipments and silicon revision distribution. Used for risk assessment and communication prioritization.

attributes.name: internal_notes
attributes.description: Confidential internal notes for engineering team use only. May contain sensitive technical details, customer names, or business strategy information not suitable for external disclosure.

attributes.name: last_modified_by
attributes.description: User identifier or name of the person who last modified this errata record. Used for audit trail and accountability.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp of the most recent update to this errata record. Used for change tracking and synchronization with downstream systems.

attributes.name: pcn_number
attributes.description: Reference to the product change notification (PCN) document number if this errata was formally communicated to customers. Null if disclosed through other channels or not yet disclosed.

attributes.name: regulatory_impact
attributes.description: Assessment of whether the errata affects compliance with industry standards or regulatory requirements such as automotive IATF 16949, functional safety ISO 26262, or export control ITAR/EAR classifications. Null if no regulatory impact.

attributes.name: related_errata_ids
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of related errata record identifiers that share common root cause, affect the same functional block, or have dependencies. Used for impact analysis and consolidated fixes.

attributes.name: resolution_date
attributes.description: Date when the errata was resolved either through silicon revision fix, software patch release, or closure decision. Null if still open or under evaluation.

attributes.name: root_cause
attributes.description: Engineering analysis of the underlying silicon defect or design flaw causing the errata. May reference RTL logic error, timing violation, or process variation sensitivity.

attributes.name: severity
attributes.description: Business impact severity of the errata. Critical: system failure or data corruption; Major: significant functional impact; Moderate: limited functional impact with workaround; Minor: cosmetic or edge-case issue.

attributes.name: silicon_revision
attributes.description: Silicon stepping or revision identifier where the errata was discovered (e.g., A0, B1, C2). Corresponds to mask revision in the fabrication process.

attributes.name: symptom_description
attributes.description: Detailed technical description of the observable behavior or functional deviation caused by the silicon bug. Includes conditions under which the issue manifests.

attributes.name: title
attributes.description: Concise summary title of the silicon bug or functional deviation. Used in errata lists and customer-facing documentation.

attributes.name: to_revision
attributes.description: FK to product.product_revision.product_revision_id — Errata are specific to a silicon revision/stepping. Must link to the affected revision.

attributes.name: verification_date
attributes.description: Date when engineering verification of the errata was completed and status changed to verified or cannot reproduce. Null if verification still in progress or not started.

attributes.name: verification_status
attributes.description: Engineering validation status of the reported errata. Unverified: initial report not yet investigated; In Progress: under engineering analysis; Verified: confirmed as silicon bug; Cannot Reproduce: unable to replicate reported behavior.

attributes.name: workaround_available
attributes.description: Indicates whether a software, firmware, or operational workaround exists to mitigate the errata impact. True if workaround documented; False if no mitigation available.

attributes.name: workaround_description
attributes.description: Detailed instructions for software, firmware, or operational workaround to avoid or mitigate the errata. May include register configuration changes, driver patches, or usage restrictions. Null if no workaround available.

attributes.name: workaround_performance_impact
attributes.description: Description of any power, performance, or area (PPA) degradation introduced by the workaround (e.g., 5% throughput reduction, 10mW additional power consumption, increased latency). Null if no measurable impact or no workaround.

products.name: configuration_rule
products.description: Rules defining valid combinations of package, speed grade, temperature range, voltage variant, and qualification level for orderable SKU creation. Captures constraint expressions, option dependencies, and effectivity dates. Prevents invalid SKU proliferation and powers customer-facing configurator tools for ASIC/FPGA option selection.

attributes.description: Indicates whether the rule enforces RoHS‑compliant configurations.

attributes.description: Human‑readable name describing the purpose of the rule.

attributes.description: Incremental version number for change management of the rule.

Each record links one ic_catalog to one export_license and stores attributes that are specific to the licensing context, such as authorized commodities, countries, end‑users, and the license validity period.. products.name: customer_design_win
products.description: Unified record tracking the full design-in lifecycle from initial registration through confirmed design-win for semiconductor products selected by customers. SSOT for the complete design-in pipeline from early registration through revenue forecasting — distinct from sales-domain opportunity records which track revenue probability and sales stage. Captures design project name, target end product/application (e.g., smartphone SoC, ADAS ECU, AI accelerator), platform generation, process node, package type, device/part number selected, design-win stage (registered, evaluating, sampling, won, lost, on-hold), registration date, design-win confirmation date, tapeout target date, production ramp date, estimated annual unit volume (AUV), estimated annual revenue, competitive displacement flag, associated distributor (if channel-sourced), FAE owner, and NRE requirements. products.name: sales_nre_agreement
products.description: Master record: Non-Recurring Engineering (NRE) agreement governing custom IC or ASIC development engagements. Captures NRE fee structure, milestone payment schedule with individual billing/delivery milestones (RTL freeze, tapeout, first silicon, qualification), deliverables (RTL, GDS, PDK, tapeout), IP ownership terms, exclusivity clauses, and SAP SD contract reference. Contains milestone detail records tracking milestone name, planned/actual completion dates, milestone amounts, invoice trigger flags, approval status, and completion workflow. Enables NRE revenue recognition scheduling and project tracking. SSOT for all NRE commercial terms and milestone execution.

products.name: price_list
products.description: Master record: Master pricing repository defining standard and customer-specific pricing for semiconductor products by product family, package type, volume tier, and end market. Supports list price, distributor price, OEM price, and spot price variants. Contains price adjustment records capturing negotiated deviations, special bids, volume rebate adjustments, design-win incentives, and distributor markdowns with adjustment type, approved deviation amount, approval authority, validity windows, and SAP SD pricing condition override references. Integrates with SAP SD condition records and Salesforce CRM pricing engine. Tracks effective dates, supersession history, and full adjustment audit trail. SSOT for all semiconductor product pricing and price deviations.

products.name: territory
products.description: Master record: Sales territory definition and quota management assigning geographic regions, end markets, or named accounts to sales representatives and field application engineers (FAEs). Captures territory code, region hierarchy (global→regional→country→district), assigned sales rep, FAE coverage, revenue and unit targets by fiscal period (quarterly, half-year, annual), quota amounts, stretch targets, attainment tracking, and effective dates. Includes account-to-territory assignment details with assignment type (direct, distribution, rep firm), primary/secondary coverage flags, channel tier, and multi-rep coverage models. Supports territory realignment, overlay models (product specialists, strategic account managers), quota assignment workflows, and sales performance management common in semiconductor distribution channels. Used for compensation planning and quarterly business review (QBR) reporting.

products.name: sales_forecast
products.description: Transaction record: Sales demand forecast capturing expected unit volume and revenue by product family, customer, end market, geography, and fiscal period. Supports rolling 12-month and 18-month forecast horizons used in semiconductor S&OP and wafer-start authorization processes. Tracks forecast version (commit, upside, best-case), submission date, confidence level, and variance against actuals. Integrates with SAP APO/IBP demand planning. Enables forecast accuracy KPI tracking (MAPE, bias) critical for fab capacity planning decisions.

products.name: booking
products.description: Transaction record: Confirmed sales booking representing a firm customer purchase order commitment for semiconductor devices. Captures booking date, booked revenue, booked units, device part number, customer account, ship-to location, requested delivery date, backlog status, and SAP SD sales order reference. Represents the commercial booking event — distinct from shipment or invoice. SSOT for bookings-to-billings (B2B) ratio, book-to-ship analysis, and revenue waterfall reporting critical to semiconductor quarterly earnings.

products.name: rebate_program
products.description: Master record: Distributor or customer rebate program definition, accrual tracking, and settlement management. Specifies rebate type (volume rebate, growth rebate, design-win incentive, marketing development fund), eligibility criteria, calculation method (tiered percentage, flat rate), measurement period, payout schedule, and maximum payout cap. attributes.name: qualification_required_flag

attributes.name: target_production_date

attributes.name: target_technology_node_nm

attributes.name: target_volume_units

attributes.name: program_name

attributes.name: campaign_id

attributes.name: employee_id

attributes.name: parent_campaign_id
attributes.description: Self-referencing FK on campaign (parent_campaign_id)

attributes.name: actual_spend
attributes.description: Total spend recorded against the campaign to date.

attributes.name: approval_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the campaign was approved.

attributes.name: approved_by
attributes.description: Identifier of the user who approved the campaign budget and plan.

attributes.name: audience_segment
attributes.description: Defined audience segment or persona targeted by the campaign.

attributes.name: budget_amount
attributes.description: Approved budget allocated for the campaign.

attributes.name: channel
attributes.description: Primary marketing channel used to deliver the campaign.

attributes.name: campaign_code

attributes.name: compliance_flag

attributes.name: created_timestamp

attributes.name: campaign_description

attributes.name: end_date

attributes.name: external_campaign_code

attributes.name: kpi_actual

attributes.name: kpi_target

attributes.name: marketing_platform

attributes.name: campaign_name

attributes.name: objective

attributes.name: region

attributes.name: risk_level

attributes.name: target_market

attributes.name: target_product_family

domains.name: order
domains.description: Customer orders, order fulfillment, delivery schedules, and shipment tracking. SSOT for order-to-cash lifecycle including order entry, wafer start authorizations, die bank orders, allocation, backlog management, and delivery confirmation. Manages MPW orders and production lot assignments.

products.name: order
products.description: Master record for all customer sales orders in the semiconductor order-to-cash lifecycle. Captures order header information including customer identity, order type (standard IC, ASIC, FPGA, MPW, NRE), order date, requested delivery date, priority, incoterms, payment terms, currency, total order value, and order status. SSOT for all customer-placed orders including wafer start authorizations, die bank orders, and production lot assignments. Sourced from SAP S/4HANA SD module.

attributes.name: order_id
attributes.description: Primary key for order

attributes.name: account_id
attributes.description: Reference to the customer who placed the sales order. Links to the customer master data product.

attributes.name: blanket_order_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to order.blanket_order. Business justification: An order may be covered by a blanket purchase agreement; adding FK from order to blanket_order captures this relationship without creating a cycle.

attributes.name: channel_partner_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to sales.channel_partner. Business justification: Orders may be placed via channel partners; the FK enables partner‑attributed revenue and commission reporting.

attributes.name: contact_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to customer.contact. Business justification: Order Management requires a primary sales contact for each order; the Order Confirmation Report pulls contact details, making this link essential.

attributes.name: cost_center_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.cost_center. Business justification: Orders are charged to a cost center for expense tracking and budgeting in the finance system.

attributes.name: eccn_classification_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to compliance.eccn_classification. Business justification: Export compliance reporting requires linking each order to its ECCN classification for customs documentation.

attributes.name: employee_id
attributes.description: Reference to the sales representative or account manager responsible for managing this order and the customer relationship.

attributes.name: export_license_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to compliance.export_license. Business justification: Export License Management: each sales order must reference the approved export license, replacing the free‑text export_license_number.

attributes.name: mpw_shuttle_id
attributes.description: Reference to the Multi-Project Wafer (MPW) run associated with this order. Applicable only for MPW order types where multiple customer designs share a single wafer to reduce Non-Recurring Engineering (NRE) costs.

attributes.name: opportunity_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to sales.opportunity. Business justification: Order creation originates from a closed‑won opportunity; linking enables opportunity‑to‑order conversion reporting.

attributes.name: org_unit_id
attributes.description: Reference to the SAP sales organization responsible for this order, defining the selling entity, pricing, and legal entity context.

attributes.name: payment_term_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to invoice.payment_term. Business justification: Required for order processing: each order references a centrally defined payment term for financial reporting and compliance with contract terms.

attributes.name: price_agreement_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to customer.price_agreement. Business justification: Pricing Governance applies a specific price agreement to an order; the Pricing Audit Report and revenue recognition rely on this relationship.

attributes.name: profit_center_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.profit_center. Business justification: Profit‑center reporting requires each sales order to be linked to the responsible profit center.

attributes.name: quote_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to sales.quote. Business justification: Orders are generated from accepted quotes; the link supports quote‑to‑order tracking and pricing audit.

attributes.name: research_program_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to research.program. Business justification: Program‑driven volume orders must be associated with the research program for financial tracking, budget compliance, and KPI dashboards.

attributes.name: research_project_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to research.project. Business justification: Custom design order fulfillment tracks the originating research project for cost allocation and project KPI reporting.

attributes.name: restricted_party_screening_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to compliance.restricted_party_screening. Business justification: Trade compliance hold process records the screening result for the customer/account on the order.

attributes.name: sales_design_win_id
attributes.description: Reference to the Salesforce CRM design-win opportunity that originated this sales order. Links the order to the customer design-in engagement, enabling design-win to revenue conversion tracking.

attributes.name: shipping_address_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to customer.address. Business justification: Shipping Execution process stores the exact customer address for each order; the Shipping Manifest and compliance checks depend on this link.

attributes.name: actual_delivery_date
attributes.description: The actual date on which the ordered products were delivered to the customer or ship-to location. Used for on-time delivery (OTD) performance analysis and customer satisfaction reporting.

attributes.name: allocation_status
attributes.description: Current inventory or production capacity allocation status of the order. Indicates whether sufficient die, wafer, or finished goods inventory has been reserved to fulfill the order. Critical for backlog management and supply-demand balancing.

attributes.name: backlog_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this order is currently included in the active order backlog. True when the order is open and not yet fully shipped or invoiced. Used for backlog valuation, revenue forecasting, and capacity planning.

attributes.name: cancellation_reason
attributes.description: Business reason code or description for order cancellation. Populated only when order_status is CANCELLED. Used for lost revenue analysis, demand forecasting accuracy, and customer relationship management.

attributes.name: chips_act_eligible
attributes.description: Indicates whether this order is associated with products or programs eligible for US CHIPS and Science Act incentives or reporting requirements. Used for government reporting and subsidy tracking.

attributes.name: confirmed_delivery_date
attributes.description: The delivery date confirmed by the semiconductor manufacturer based on production capacity, wafer fab scheduling, and logistics. May differ from the requested delivery date. Used for backlog management and customer commitment tracking.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the sales order record was first created in the source system (SAP S/4HANA SD). Used for audit trail, data lineage, and order entry performance measurement. Corresponds to SAP VBAK.ERDAT + VBAK.ERZET.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code for the order transaction (e.g., USD, EUR, JPY, TWD, KRW). Defines the currency in which order values, pricing, and invoicing are denominated. Corresponds to SAP VBAK.WAERK.

attributes.name: customer_po_number
attributes.description: The purchase order number provided by the customer at the time of order placement. Used for cross-referencing with the customer's procurement system and required for invoice matching. Corresponds to SAP VBAK.BSTNK.

attributes.name: distribution_channel
attributes.description: The sales channel through which the order was placed. Determines pricing tiers, commission structures, and revenue reporting by channel. Corresponds to SAP VBAK.VTWEG.

attributes.name: end_market_segment
attributes.description: The end-market application segment for which the ordered semiconductor products are destined. Used for market segmentation analysis, revenue reporting by vertical, and strategic planning. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: COMPUTING|MOBILE|AUTOMOTIVE|AI_ML|IOT|INDUSTRIAL|NETWORKING|CONSUMER|DEFENSE|MEDICAL — promote to reference product]

attributes.name: export_license_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether an export license is required for this order based on the destination country, end-user, and product ECCN classification. True triggers export compliance review workflow before shipment authorization.

attributes.name: gross_order_value
attributes.description: Total gross value of the sales order before application of discounts, taxes, or surcharges, expressed in the order currency. Represents the sum of all line item gross values. Used for revenue forecasting and backlog valuation.

attributes.name: hold_reason
attributes.description: Reason code or description for placing the order on hold. Populated when order_status is ON_HOLD. Common reasons include credit hold, export compliance review, customer request, or supply shortage.

attributes.name: incoterms_code
attributes.description: International Commercial Terms (Incoterms) code defining the responsibilities of buyer and seller for delivery, risk transfer, and cost allocation. Corresponds to SAP VBAK.INCO1. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: EXW|FCA|CPT|CIP|DAP|DPU|DDP|FAS|FOB|CFR|CIF — promote to reference product]

attributes.name: incoterms_location
attributes.description: The named place or port associated with the Incoterms code, specifying where risk and cost transfer between buyer and seller (e.g., 'Shanghai Port', 'Customer Dock'). Corresponds to SAP VBAK.INCO2.

attributes.name: itar_controlled
attributes.description: Indicates whether any products in this order are subject to ITAR (International Traffic in Arms Regulations) controls. When True, additional export authorization and end-use certification requirements apply before shipment.

attributes.name: last_updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp of the most recent modification to the sales order record in the source system. Used for change tracking, audit compliance, and incremental data pipeline processing. Corresponds to SAP VBAK.AEDAT.

attributes.name: net_order_value
attributes.description: Net value of the sales order after application of all discounts and pricing conditions but before tax. Represents the contractually agreed revenue amount. Corresponds to SAP VBAK.NETWR. Used for revenue recognition and financial reporting.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text notes or special instructions associated with the sales order, capturing customer-specific requirements, handling instructions, or internal processing notes. Corresponds to SAP order header text.

attributes.name: nre_amount
attributes.description: Non-Recurring Engineering (NRE) charges associated with this order, covering one-time design, mask set, and process development costs. Applicable for ASIC, custom IC, and MPW order types. Reported separately from unit product revenue.

attributes.name: order_date
attributes.description: The calendar date on which the customer placed the sales order. Represents the principal business event date for the order-to-cash lifecycle. Corresponds to SAP VBAK.AUDAT.

attributes.name: order_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the sales order within the order-to-cash process. Drives workflow routing, backlog reporting, and revenue recognition. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: DRAFT|OPEN|IN_FULFILLMENT|SHIPPED|DELIVERED|CLOSED|CANCELLED|ON_HOLD — promote to reference product]

attributes.name: order_type
attributes.description: Classification of the sales order by product or engagement type. Determines order processing rules, pricing, and fulfillment workflow. Values include: STANDARD_IC (standard integrated circuit), ASIC (Application-Specific Integrated Circuit), FPGA (Field-Programmable Gate Array), MPW (Multi-Project Wafer), NRE (Non-Recurring Engineering), DIE_BANK (die bank pull order), WAFER_START (wafer start authorization). [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: STANDARD_IC|ASIC|FPGA|MPW|NRE|DIE_BANK|WAFER_START — promote to reference product]

attributes.name: payment_terms_code
attributes.description: SAP payment terms key defining the payment due date, early payment discount conditions, and cash discount percentages applicable to this order. Corresponds to SAP VBAK.ZTERM (e.g., NT30, NT60, 2/10NET30).

attributes.name: priority
attributes.description: Business priority level assigned to the order, influencing production scheduling, wafer start queue position, and allocation decisions. Critical orders may trigger expedite fees or override standard allocation rules.

attributes.name: reach_compliant
attributes.description: Indicates whether the products ordered comply with the EU REACH (Registration, Evaluation, Authorisation and Restriction of Chemicals) Regulation. Required for EU market access and supply chain chemical safety reporting.

attributes.name: requested_delivery_date
attributes.description: The date by which the customer has requested delivery of the ordered products. Used for delivery scheduling, wafer start planning, and on-time delivery (OTD) performance measurement. Corresponds to SAP VBAK.VDATU.

attributes.name: rohs_compliant
attributes.description: Indicates whether the products ordered comply with the EU RoHS (Restriction of Hazardous Substances) Directive, restricting the use of specific hazardous materials in electronic equipment. Required for EU market access and customer compliance declarations.

attributes.name: ship_to_country_code
attributes.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country code of the destination country for shipment. Critical for export compliance screening (EAR/ITAR/BIS), trade sanctions checks, and logistics routing. Corresponds to SAP ship-to party country.

attributes.name: so_number
attributes.description: Externally visible sales order number as assigned by SAP S/4HANA SD module. Used in all customer-facing communications, shipping documents, and invoices. Corresponds to the VBELN field in SAP VBAK table.

attributes.name: source
attributes.description: The channel or system through which the customer order was received and entered. Used for order entry efficiency analysis and digital transformation tracking.

attributes.name: tax_amount
attributes.description: Total tax amount applicable to the sales order, including VAT, GST, or other applicable taxes, expressed in the order currency. Required for tax reporting and financial compliance.

attributes.name: wafer_start_authorization
attributes.description: Indicates whether this order has triggered a wafer start authorization in the fabrication facility (FAB). When True, the MES (Manufacturing Execution System) has been instructed to initiate wafer lot processing for this order.

products.name: order_line
products.description: Individual line items within a customer sales order, each representing a distinct semiconductor product SKU, quantity, unit price, requested ship date, confirmed ship date, and line-level status. Captures product configuration details such as package type, speed grade, temperature range, and special handling requirements. Supports partial shipments and line-level allocation tracking. Sourced from SAP S/4HANA SD order line items.

attributes.name: order_line_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for each order line item within the Databricks Silver Layer. Serves as the primary key for the order_line data product.

attributes.name: account_id
attributes.description: Reference to the customer placing the order. Used for line-level customer attribution in multi-ship-to or multi-sold-to scenarios. Corresponds to SAP S/4HANA SD KUNNR (Customer Number).

attributes.name: inventory_wafer_lot_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to inventory.inventory_wafer_lot. Business justification: REQUIRED: Order fulfillment report needs to know which wafer lot supplies each order line; linking enables traceability from line to physical wafer lot.

attributes.name: package_type_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to packaging.package_type. Business justification: Needed for Packaging Planning; order line specifies requested package type, linking to package_type enables yield, cost, and compliance analysis per packaging family.

attributes.name: primary_sales_order_id
attributes.description: Reference to the parent sales order header to which this line item belongs. Establishes the header-to-line relationship in the order-to-cash lifecycle. Corresponds to SAP S/4HANA SD VBELN (Sales Document Number).

attributes.name: process_engineer_employee_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to workforce.employee. Business justification: Manufacturing assigns a process engineer to each order line for fab planning and yield optimization.

attributes.name: quote_line_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to sales.quote_line. Business justification: Each order line is derived from a quote line; needed for line‑level margin and fulfillment analysis.

attributes.name: reach_svhc_declaration_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to compliance.reach_svhc_declaration. Business justification: REACH SVHC Declaration is required per SKU on an order line to certify hazardous substance compliance.

attributes.name: research_project_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to research.project. Business justification: Line‑item level tracking of research project origin enables precise billing, milestone status, and project performance analysis.

attributes.name: sku_id
attributes.description: Reference to the semiconductor product (IC, SoC, ASIC, FPGA, or discrete device) being ordered on this line. Links to the product master for SKU-level configuration details including package type, speed grade, and temperature range.

attributes.name: ssot_invoice_line_id
attributes.description: SSOT reference to canonical invoice.invoice_line (de-duplicates cross-domain concept).

attributes.name: supplier_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to supply.supplier. Business justification: Primary supplier for the SKU on each order line, used in procurement planning and supplier performance reporting.

attributes.name: test_program_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to test.test_program. Business justification: Required for Test Program Assignment per SKU during order fulfillment; ensures each order line selects the correct test program for quality validation.

attributes.name: tool_chamber_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to equipment.tool_chamber. Business justification: CHAMBER_TRACEABILITY: Link order line to specific tool chamber used, enabling yield analysis and compliance reporting.

attributes.name: actual_ship_date
attributes.description: The date on which the semiconductor units for this order line were physically shipped from the warehouse or OSAT facility. Populated upon goods issue posting in SAP S/4HANA. Used for on-time delivery (OTD) performance measurement.

attributes.name: allocation_type
attributes.description: Classification of the supply allocation method applied to this order line. Standard = normal backlog allocation; Priority = customer-priority or design-win protected allocation; Strategic = long-term agreement allocation; Spot = spot market fulfillment; Buffer = safety stock draw.

attributes.name: cancellation_reason
attributes.description: Reason code for cancellation of this order line when line_status is 'cancelled'. Supports backlog analysis, demand planning accuracy, and customer relationship management. Populated only for cancelled lines. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: customer_request|supply_constraint|end_of_life|duplicate|pricing_dispute|export_hold|other — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: confirmed_quantity
attributes.description: The quantity of semiconductor units confirmed by supply chain for delivery on this order line, reflecting available inventory, wafer start authorizations, and die bank allocations. May differ from ordered quantity due to allocation constraints.

attributes.name: confirmed_ship_date
attributes.description: The date confirmed by supply chain and manufacturing for shipment of this order line, based on available inventory, die bank status, and OSAT packaging capacity. May differ from requested ship date due to supply constraints.

attributes.name: country_of_origin
attributes.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country code indicating the country where the semiconductor product was manufactured (FAB location). Required for customs declarations, trade compliance, tariff classification, and CHIPS Act domestic content reporting.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: System timestamp when this order line record was first created in the data platform. Used for audit trail, data lineage, and Silver Layer ingestion tracking. Conforms to ISO 8601 format yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code for the transaction currency of this order line (e.g., USD, EUR, JPY, KRW, TWD). Semiconductor industry commonly transacts in USD but supports multi-currency for global customers.

attributes.name: customer_part_number
attributes.description: The customer's own internal part number or cross-reference number for the ordered semiconductor product. Critical for design-win tracking, customer portal integration, and order acknowledgment matching. Sourced from Salesforce CRM design-win records.

attributes.name: date_entered
attributes.description: The business date on which this order line was entered into the SAP S/4HANA SD system. Represents the commercial event date for backlog aging calculations and order-to-cash cycle time measurement.

attributes.name: die_bank_order
attributes.description: Indicates whether this order line is to be fulfilled from the die bank (inventory of known good dies (KGD) awaiting packaging) rather than from finished goods or new wafer starts. True = die bank fulfillment; False = standard finished goods or new production.

attributes.name: export_control_classification
attributes.description: Export Administration Regulations (EAR) Export Control Classification Number (ECCN) for the semiconductor product on this order line (e.g., 3A001 for advanced ICs). Required for export compliance screening, license determination, and ITAR/EAR regulatory reporting.

attributes.name: incoterms_code
attributes.description: International Commercial Terms (Incoterms 2020) code defining the delivery obligations, risk transfer point, and cost responsibilities between the semiconductor company and the customer for this order line (e.g., FOB, DDP, EXW). Corresponds to SAP S/4HANA SD INCO1. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: EXW|FCA|CPT|CIP|DAP|DPU|DDP|FAS|FOB|CFR|CIF — 11 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: item_category
attributes.description: SAP SD item category classification for this order line, indicating the business nature of the line (e.g., standard product sale, consignment fill-up, customer return, engineering sample, NRE charge, MPW service, evaluation unit). Drives pricing, delivery, and billing behavior. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: standard|consignment|returns|sample|nre|mpw|evaluation — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: line_number
attributes.description: Sequential position number of this line item within the parent sales order. Used for ordering, display, and reference in customer-facing documents. Corresponds to SAP S/4HANA SD POSNR (Item Number of the SD Document).

attributes.name: line_status
attributes.description: Current workflow status of this order line item within the order-to-cash lifecycle. Drives backlog management, allocation decisions, and revenue recognition. Corresponds to SAP S/4HANA SD overall delivery status at item level.

attributes.name: lot_number
attributes.description: The manufacturing lot number assigned to the production batch fulfilling this order line. Enables traceability from customer order back to wafer fabrication lot, die bank lot, and OSAT packaging lot. Sourced from Camstar MES lot tracking.

attributes.name: material_number
attributes.description: SAP material number (MATNR) identifying the specific semiconductor product SKU ordered on this line. Includes full part number with package, speed grade, and temperature range encoded per internal part numbering convention.

attributes.name: mpw_order
attributes.description: Indicates whether this order line is associated with a Multi-Project Wafer (MPW) run, where multiple customer designs share a single wafer to reduce NRE costs. True = MPW order; False = dedicated production lot order.

attributes.name: net_value
attributes.description: Total net value of this order line calculated as confirmed quantity multiplied by unit price in the transaction currency. Used for backlog reporting, revenue forecasting, and SOX-compliant revenue recognition. Corresponds to SAP S/4HANA SD NETWR (Net Value of the Order Item).

attributes.name: ordered_quantity
attributes.description: The quantity of semiconductor units (dies, packaged ICs, wafers, or reels) requested by the customer on this order line. Expressed in the sales unit of measure (e.g., pieces, wafers, reels). Corresponds to SAP S/4HANA SD KWMENG (Cumulative Order Quantity).

attributes.name: partial_shipment_allowed
attributes.description: Indicates whether the customer permits partial shipments against this order line. True = partial shipments accepted; False = complete order line quantity must ship together. Drives delivery scheduling and backlog management decisions.

attributes.name: product_revision
attributes.description: The silicon revision or stepping of the ordered semiconductor product (e.g., A0, B1, C2). Critical for tracking product change notifications (PCNs), errata management, and ensuring customers receive the correct silicon revision per their qualification.

attributes.name: reach_compliant
attributes.description: Indicates whether the semiconductor product on this order line is compliant with the EU REACH Regulation (Registration, Evaluation, Authorisation and Restriction of Chemicals). Required for EU chemical safety compliance and customer material declarations.

attributes.name: requested_delivery_date
attributes.description: The date by which the customer requires receipt of the semiconductor units at their facility. Distinct from requested ship date; accounts for transit time. Used for customer SLA compliance tracking.

attributes.name: requested_ship_date
attributes.description: The date on which the customer has requested shipment of this order line. Drives production scheduling, wafer start authorization timelines, and OSAT packaging commitments. Corresponds to SAP S/4HANA SD WUNSK (Customer's Requested Delivery Date at Item Level).

attributes.name: rohs_compliant
attributes.description: Indicates whether the semiconductor product on this order line is compliant with the EU Restriction of Hazardous Substances (RoHS) Directive, restricting use of lead, mercury, cadmium, and other hazardous materials. Required for EU market access.

attributes.name: sap_line_item_number
attributes.business_glossary_term: SAP Sales Order Line Item Number
attributes.description: The native SAP S/4HANA SD six-digit item number (POSNR) for this order line, used for traceability back to the system of record and for EDI/customer portal reconciliation.

tag_set.value: SAP Sales Order Line Item Number

attributes.name: ship_to_country
attributes.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country code for the destination country of this order line shipment. Used for export control screening, customs documentation, tariff determination, and trade compliance reporting.

attributes.name: shipped_quantity
attributes.description: Cumulative quantity of semiconductor units actually shipped against this order line across all partial shipments. Used for backlog calculation and revenue recognition. Sourced from SAP S/4HANA SD delivery documents.

attributes.name: special_handling_code
attributes.description: Code indicating special handling, storage, or shipping requirements for this order line (e.g., ESD-sensitive, moisture-sensitive level (MSL), controlled humidity, ITAR-controlled, hazmat). Drives warehouse and logistics instructions. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: ESD|MSL1|MSL2|MSL3|ITAR|HAZMAT|CONTROLLED_TEMP|FRAGILE — promote to reference product]

attributes.name: speed_grade
attributes.description: The speed or performance grade of the ordered semiconductor product, indicating the maximum operating frequency or timing specification (e.g., -1, -2, -3 for FPGAs; 3200MHz, 4800MHz for memory). Differentiates SKUs within the same product family.

attributes.name: temperature_grade
attributes.description: Operating temperature range classification for the ordered semiconductor product. Commercial (0°C to 70°C), Industrial (-40°C to 85°C), Automotive (-40°C to 125°C, AEC-Q100), Military (-55°C to 125°C). Determines qualification standard and pricing tier.

attributes.name: to_sales_order
attributes.description: FK to order.sales_order.sales_order_id — Fundamental header-to-line relationship. Every order line must belong to exactly one sales order. This is the most critical FK in the domain — without it, order lines are orphaned.

attributes.name: unit_of_measure
attributes.description: Sales unit of measure for the ordered semiconductor product. EA = Each (individual packaged IC), WFR = Wafer, REEL = Tape-and-reel packaging, TRAY = JEDEC tray, TUBE = Tube packaging. Corresponds to SAP S/4HANA SD VRKME (Sales Unit).

attributes.name: unit_price
attributes.description: Agreed net unit selling price for the semiconductor product on this order line, expressed in the transaction currency. Reflects negotiated pricing, volume discounts, and design-win pricing agreements. Corresponds to SAP S/4HANA SD NETPR (Net Price).

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: System timestamp of the most recent update to this order line record in the data platform. Supports change data capture (CDC), audit trail, and incremental processing in the Databricks Lakehouse Silver Layer.

attributes.name: wafer_start_authorization
attributes.description: Indicates whether a wafer start authorization (WSA) has been issued to the fabrication facility (FAB) to initiate production of wafers for fulfilling this order line. True = WSA issued; False = pending or not required (e.g., fulfilled from die bank or finished goods inventory).

products.name: status_history
products.description: Chronological audit trail of all status transitions for a sales order throughout the order-to-cash lifecycle. Records each status change event including prior status, new status, timestamp, reason code, and the user or system that triggered the change. Supports backlog management, escalation tracking, and order lifecycle analytics. Covers statuses such as: entered, confirmed, allocated, wafer_started, in_fab, shipped, invoiced, cancelled.

attributes.name: status_history_id
attributes.description: Primary key for status_history

attributes.name: allocation_record_id
attributes.description: Reference to the die bank or wafer allocation record when the status transitions to allocated. Captures which inventory allocation was committed to fulfill this order.

attributes.name: employee_id
attributes.description: The user login ID or system service account that initiated the status transition. Supports accountability tracking and audit compliance. May be a human user (SAP logon ID) or an automated system process (e.g., MES_AUTO, ERP_BATCH).

attributes.name: fabrication_wafer_lot_id
attributes.description: Reference to the wafer fabrication lot associated with this order status event. Populated when the status transition is triggered by a fab event such as wafer_started or in_fab. Links order lifecycle to WIP (Work in Process) tracking.

attributes.name: osat_vendor_id
attributes.business_glossary_term: Outsourced Semiconductor Assembly and Test (OSAT) Partner ID
attributes.description: Reference to the OSAT (Outsourced Semiconductor Assembly and Test) partner responsible for packaging and final test of the order. Populated when the order transitions to packaging or test phases. Supports OSAT-level delivery tracking.

tag_set.value: Outsourced Semiconductor Assembly and Test (OSAT) Partner ID

attributes.name: primary_status_order_id
attributes.description: FK to order.sales_order.sales_order_id — Status history records track transitions for a specific order. Must reference the parent order.

attributes.name: shipment_id
attributes.description: Reference to the outbound shipment record when the status transitions to shipped. Links the order status history to the physical delivery event for shipment tracking and delivery confirmation.

attributes.name: cancellation_type
attributes.description: Classifies the reason for order cancellation when new_status is cancelled. Values: customer_request (customer-initiated), eol (End of Life product discontinuation), capacity (fab capacity unavailable), yield_fail (unacceptable yield), export_block (export compliance hold), duplicate (duplicate order entry). Null for non-cancellation transitions.

attributes.name: change_sequence_number
attributes.description: Sequential integer representing the ordinal position of this status transition within the complete history of the sales order line. Sequence 1 is the initial entry event. Enables ordered reconstruction of the full order lifecycle.

attributes.name: confirmed_delivery_date
attributes.description: The internally confirmed delivery date at the time of this status transition. May differ from requested_delivery_date due to fab capacity, yield, or supply chain constraints. Tracks delivery commitment evolution across the order lifecycle.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this status history record was first written to the data platform (Silver layer ingestion time). Distinct from transition_timestamp which records the business event time. Supports data lineage and audit trail completeness.

attributes.name: die_bank_order_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this order line is fulfilled from die bank inventory (pre-fabricated, unpackaged dies held in inventory) rather than a new wafer start. Die bank orders have a compressed status lifecycle bypassing wafer_started and in_fab states.

attributes.name: duration_in_prior_status_hours
attributes.description: The number of hours the order line spent in the prior_status before transitioning to new_status. Calculated at ingestion time from the difference between this transition_timestamp and the previous record's transition_timestamp. Supports cycle time and SLA analytics.

attributes.name: escalation_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this status transition was associated with a customer escalation event. When True, the order was under active escalation management at the time of the transition. Supports escalation tracking and priority queue analytics.

attributes.name: escalation_priority
attributes.description: Priority level of the customer escalation active at the time of this status transition. P1 is highest urgency (e.g., automotive line-down risk), P4 is lowest. Populated only when escalation_flag is True.

attributes.name: export_control_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this status transition triggered or was subject to an export control review under EAR or ITAR regulations. When True, the order required compliance screening before proceeding to the next status.

attributes.name: hold_code
attributes.description: Standardized hold code applied to the order at the time of this status transition (e.g., CREDIT_HOLD, EXPORT_REVIEW, YIELD_HOLD, CAPACITY_HOLD). Null when no hold is active. Critical for backlog management and compliance review workflows. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: promote to reference product]

attributes.name: is_current_status
attributes.description: Indicates whether this record represents the most recent (current) status of the order line. True for the latest status transition record; False for all historical records. Enables efficient current-state queries without window functions.

attributes.name: mpw_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the order line is associated with a Multi-Project Wafer (MPW) run. MPW orders share wafer capacity across multiple customers and have distinct status transition rules compared to dedicated production orders.

attributes.name: new_status
attributes.description: The order status assigned as a result of this transition event. Represents the current state after the change. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: entered|confirmed|allocated|wafer_started|in_fab|shipped|invoiced|cancelled — promote to reference product]

attributes.name: order_line_number
attributes.description: The specific line item number within the sales order to which this status transition applies. A single sales order may have multiple lines (e.g., different part numbers or delivery dates) each with independent status histories.

attributes.name: ordered_quantity
attributes.description: The quantity of units (dies, wafers, or packaged devices) on the order line at the time of this status transition. Captured as a snapshot to support backlog quantity analytics across status states.

attributes.name: part_number
attributes.description: The semiconductor part number (IC, SoC, ASIC, or FPGA) associated with the order line at the time of this status event. Denormalized for audit trail completeness and historical accuracy even if the part number changes later.

attributes.name: pcn_reference_number
attributes.description: Reference to a Product Change Notification (PCN) that triggered or is associated with this status transition. Relevant when an order status changes due to a product or process change notification issued to the customer.

attributes.name: prior_status
attributes.description: The order status immediately before this transition event. Together with new_status, defines the state transition vector for lifecycle analytics and backlog management. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: entered|confirmed|allocated|wafer_started|in_fab|shipped|invoiced|cancelled — promote to reference product]

attributes.name: process_node
attributes.description: The semiconductor process technology node (e.g., 5nm, 7nm, 28nm, 65nm) used to fabricate the product on this order line. Captured as a snapshot at the time of the status event for process-level backlog analytics.

attributes.name: quantity_unit_of_measure
attributes.description: Unit of measure for the ordered quantity: EA (each/packaged unit), WFR (wafer), DIE (individual die), or LOT (production lot). Aligns with SAP base unit of measure configuration for semiconductor products.

attributes.name: reason_code
attributes.description: Standardized reason code explaining why the status transition occurred (e.g., CUST_REQUEST, CAPACITY_HOLD, YIELD_FAIL, ALLOC_RELEASE, SHIP_CONFIRM, CANCEL_EOL). Sourced from SAP SD reason code configuration. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: promote to reference product for full enumeration]

attributes.name: reason_description
attributes.description: Free-text narrative providing additional context for the status transition beyond the structured reason code. Captures escalation notes, customer communication references, or fab hold explanations entered by the user or system.

attributes.name: requested_delivery_date
attributes.description: The customer-requested delivery date on the order line at the time of this status event. Snapshot preserved in the history record to track whether delivery commitments changed across status transitions.

attributes.name: sla_breached_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the duration in the prior status exceeded the SLA target hours, constituting an SLA breach. True when duration_in_prior_status_hours > sla_target_hours. Supports escalation triggering and customer reporting.

attributes.name: sla_target_hours
attributes.description: The contracted or internally defined SLA target duration (in hours) for the order to remain in the prior_status before transitioning. Used to assess whether the transition was on-time or breached the SLA threshold.

attributes.name: source_document_number
attributes.description: The reference number of the source business document that triggered this status transition (e.g., a purchase order number, a delivery note number, an invoice number, or a MES lot release number). Provides cross-system traceability.

attributes.name: source_system_event_reference
attributes.description: The unique event or change document identifier from the originating operational system (e.g., SAP Change Document number CDHDR.CHANGENR, Camstar transaction ID, or Salesforce case event ID). Enables end-to-end traceability from the Silver layer back to the system of record.

attributes.name: to_sales_order
attributes.description: FK to order.sales_order.sales_order_id — Status history records belong to a specific sales order. Required for audit trail integrity.

attributes.name: transition_timestamp
attributes.description: The precise date and time (with timezone offset) at which the status transition occurred. This is the principal business event time for this EVENT_LOG record, distinct from record audit timestamps.

attributes.name: transition_type
attributes.description: Classifies the nature of the status transition: forward progression through the order lifecycle, backward reversal (e.g., re-open), cancellation, or data correction. Supports lifecycle analytics and anomaly detection.

attributes.name: triggered_by_system
attributes.description: The operational system of record that originated the status change event. Distinguishes between manual user-driven changes and automated system-driven transitions (e.g., MES wafer start confirmation triggering wafer_started status). [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: SAP_SD|MES_CAMSTAR|MES_SMARTFACTORY|SALESFORCE_CRM|AGILE_PLM|MANUAL|API_INTEGRATION — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this status history record was last modified in the data platform. In an ideal append-only event log this should rarely change; populated to support correction workflows and data quality monitoring.

attributes.name: wafer_start_authorization_number
attributes.description: The wafer start authorization number issued by the fab planning system when the order transitions to wafer_started status. Ties the commercial order to the physical manufacturing release in the MES.

products.name: wafer_start_authorization
products.description: Formal authorization record that triggers wafer fabrication starts in the FAB for a specific customer order or forecast commit. Captures authorized wafer quantity, target process node, fab site, planned start date, priority class (hot lot, standard, MPW), NRE flag, and linkage to the originating sales order or die bank replenishment plan. SSOT for wafer start demand signals passed from order management to manufacturing execution (MES). Bridges order domain to fabrication domain.

attributes.name: wafer_start_authorization_id
attributes.description: Unique system-generated surrogate key identifying a wafer start authorization record. Primary key for this entity in the Silver Layer lakehouse.

attributes.name: account_id
attributes.description: Reference to the customer account on whose behalf the wafer start is authorized. Supports order-to-cash traceability and customer-level fab demand reporting. Fulfills the PARTY_REFERENCE minimum category for TRANSACTION_HEADER.

attributes.name: fab_site_id
attributes.description: Reference to the fabrication facility (FAB) where the authorized wafer starts are to be executed. Determines routing of the demand signal to the correct MES instance.

attributes.name: mpw_shuttle_id
attributes.description: Reference to the MPW run record that groups multiple customer designs sharing this wafer start. Populated only when is_mpw is True. Enables allocation of wafer cost and die yield across participating customers.

attributes.name: primary_wafer_order_id
attributes.description: FK to order.sales_order.sales_order_id — Wafer start authorizations are triggered by customer orders. The WSA must reference the originating sales order for demand traceability.

attributes.name: reticle_set_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the photolithography reticle (mask) set to be used for this wafer start. Critical for EUV/DUV lithography scheduling and mask inventory management. Ensures the correct GDSII-derived mask set is reserved for the lot.

attributes.name: sku_id
attributes.description: Reference to the semiconductor product (IC, SoC, ASIC, FPGA, etc.) for which wafers are being authorized to start fabrication. Links to the product master in PLM.

attributes.name: actual_start_date
attributes.description: Actual calendar date on which wafer fabrication commenced at the fab site, as recorded by the MES. Compared against planned_start_date to measure schedule adherence and on-time start performance.

attributes.name: approval_level
attributes.description: Organizational approval tier required and applied for this wafer start authorization. Higher-value or hot-lot authorizations may require director or VP approval. Supports SOX internal controls and delegation-of-authority compliance.

attributes.name: authorization_number
attributes.description: Externally-known, human-readable business identifier for the wafer start authorization, used across order management, MES, and fab planning systems. Typically formatted as WSA-{SITE}-{SEQUENCE}. This is the BUSINESS_IDENTIFIER category field for this TRANSACTION_HEADER entity.

attributes.name: authorization_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the wafer start authorization record, tracking progression from initial creation through fab release and completion. Fulfills the LIFECYCLE_STATUS minimum category for TRANSACTION_HEADER. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: draft|pending_approval|approved|released_to_fab|in_progress|completed|cancelled|on_hold — promote to reference product]

attributes.name: authorization_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the wafer start authorization was formally approved and issued. This is the principal BUSINESS_EVENT_TIMESTAMP for this TRANSACTION_HEADER — the moment the authorization became binding and the demand signal was created.

attributes.name: authorized_by
attributes.description: Name or employee identifier of the person who formally approved and issued the wafer start authorization. Required for SOX compliance and audit trail. Typically a fab planning manager or order management lead.

attributes.name: authorized_wafer_qty
